question: What is the difference between full truckload (FTL) and part load?
alternate_questions: FTL vs PTL|Full load or part load which is better|Can I book half truck|फुल लोड और पार्ट लोड में क्या फर्क है|आधी गाड़ी बुक हो सकती है क्या|FTL क्या होता है
answer_en: FTL means one shipper books the entire vehicle, so it moves directly from pickup to drop with faster transit and less handling. Part load means your goods share space with other consignments, which costs less but takes longer because of extra stops and transhipment. RoadExpress specialises in FTL; ask support about part-load options on your lane.
answer_hi: FTL का मतलब है पूरी गाड़ी एक ही शिपर बुक करता है, जिससे गाड़ी सीधे पिकअप से ड्रॉप तक जाती है, समय कम लगता है और माल कम उठता-रखता है। पार्ट लोड में आपका माल दूसरे माल के साथ जाता है, जो सस्ता होता है लेकिन बीच के स्टॉप के कारण ज़्यादा समय लेता है। रोडएक्सप्रेस FTL में विशेषज्ञ है; अपनी लेन पर पार्ट लोड के लिए सपोर्ट से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, FTL matlab poori gaadi aapki, seedha maal uthao aur pahunchao, jaldi aur kam tod-phod. Part load me aapka maal dusron ke maal ke saath jaata hai, sasta padta hai par beech me rukta hai to time lagta hai. RoadExpress ka main kaam FTL hai, part load ke liye support se pooch lo.
answer: FTL means one shipper books the entire vehicle, so it moves directly from pickup to drop with faster transit and less handling. Part load means your goods share space with other consignments, which costs less but takes longer because of extra stops and transhipment. RoadExpress specialises in FTL; ask support about part-load options on your lane.

question: What is an LR (Lorry Receipt or bilty) and who issues it?
alternate_questions: What is a bilty|What is lorry receipt|LR kab milega|बिल्टी क्या होती है|LR कौन देता है|लॉरी रसीद क्या है
answer_en: The LR or bilty is the transport document issued by the transporter when goods are handed over for carriage. It records consignor, consignee, origin, destination, vehicle number, package count, weight and freight terms, and it acts as proof of goods received for transport. The LR is generated at loading, and its number is your main reference for tracking, POD and payment.
answer_hi: LR या बिल्टी वह परिवहन दस्तावेज़ है जो माल ढुलाई के लिए सौंपे जाने पर ट्रांसपोर्टर जारी करता है। इसमें भेजने वाले और पाने वाले का नाम, कहाँ से कहाँ, गाड़ी नंबर, पैकेट की गिनती, वज़न और भाड़े की शर्तें लिखी होती हैं, और यह माल प्राप्त होने का सबूत है। LR लोडिंग के समय बनती है और इसका नंबर ट्रैकिंग, POD और पेमेंट के लिए मुख्य संदर्भ है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, LR yaani bilty wo kagaz hai jo maal gaadi me chadhne pe transporter deta hai. Isme kisne bheja, kisko jaana hai, kahan se kahan, gaadi number, kitne nag, wazan aur bhada likha hota hai. Loading pe hi LR banti hai, aur iska number tracking, POD aur payment sab me kaam aata hai, sambhal ke rakho.
answer: The LR or bilty is the transport document issued by the transporter when goods are handed over for carriage. It records consignor, consignee, origin, destination, vehicle number, package count, weight and freight terms, and it acts as proof of goods received for transport. The LR is generated at loading, and its number is your main reference for tracking, POD and payment.

question: When is an e-way bill required and who generates it?
alternate_questions: E-way bill rules|Do I need an e-way bill|E-way bill kaun banayega|ई-वे बिल कब ज़रूरी है|ई-वे बिल कौन बनाता है|बिना ई-वे बिल गाड़ी चल सकती है क्या
answer_en: Under GST, an e-way bill is generally required when goods worth more than ₹50,000 are moved; intra-state thresholds and exemptions vary by state. It is usually generated by the consignor, consignee or transporter on the GST e-way bill portal, and the vehicle number must be updated in Part B before movement. Validity is typically one day per 200 km for normal cargo, and moving without a valid e-way bill can lead to detention of goods and penalties.
answer_hi: GST के तहत ₹50,000 से अधिक मूल्य का माल ले जाने पर आम तौर पर ई-वे बिल ज़रूरी है; राज्य के अंदर की सीमा और छूट हर राज्य में अलग हो सकती है। इसे आम तौर पर भेजने वाला, पाने वाला या ट्रांसपोर्टर GST ई-वे बिल पोर्टल पर बनाता है, और गाड़ी चलने से पहले पार्ट B में गाड़ी नंबर डालना ज़रूरी है। सामान्य माल के लिए वैधता आम तौर पर हर 200 किलोमीटर पर एक दिन होती है, और बिना वैध ई-वे बिल के माल रोका जा सकता है और जुर्माना लग सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ₹50,000 se zyada ka maal ho to aam taur pe e-way bill chahiye, state ke andar ke rules thode alag ho sakte hain. Party ya transporter GST portal pe banata hai, aur Part B me gaadi number zaroor daalna. Normal maal me har 200 km pe ek din ki validity milti hai. Bina e-way bill ke pakde gaye to maal bhi rukega aur jurmana bhi lagega.
answer: Under GST, an e-way bill is generally required when goods worth more than ₹50,000 are moved; intra-state thresholds and exemptions vary by state. It is usually generated by the consignor, consignee or transporter on the GST e-way bill portal, and the vehicle number must be updated in Part B before movement. Validity is typically one day per 200 km for normal cargo, and moving without a valid e-way bill can lead to detention of goods and penalties.

question: Which documents must the driver carry during a trip?
alternate_questions: Documents required in truck|What papers should the gaadi have|Checking me kya kagaz chahiye|गाड़ी में कौन से कागज़ होने चाहिए|ड्राइवर के पास कौन से दस्तावेज़ ज़रूरी हैं|चेकिंग में क्या दिखाना पड़ता है
answer_en: Vehicle papers: RC, valid insurance, fitness certificate, National or state permit, PUC certificate, and road tax receipt. Driver papers: a valid commercial driving licence. Trip papers: LR/bilty, invoice or delivery challan, and e-way bill where applicable. Keep digital copies too; DigiLocker and mParivahan copies of RC and licence are generally accepted at checks.
answer_hi: गाड़ी के कागज़: RC, वैध बीमा, फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट, नेशनल या स्टेट परमिट, PUC सर्टिफिकेट और रोड टैक्स रसीद। ड्राइवर के लिए: वैध कमर्शियल ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस। ट्रिप के कागज़: LR/बिल्टी, इनवॉइस या डिलीवरी चालान और लागू होने पर ई-वे बिल। डिजिटल कॉपी भी रखें; DigiLocker और mParivahan में RC और लाइसेंस आम तौर पर चेकिंग में मान्य होते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ke kagaz: RC, insurance, fitness, permit, PUC aur road tax. Driver ka commercial licence. Maal ke kagaz: bilty, bill ya challan, aur e-way bill. Phone me DigiLocker ya mParivahan me bhi copy rakho, checking me kaam aati hai.
answer: Vehicle papers: RC, valid insurance, fitness certificate, National or state permit, PUC certificate, and road tax receipt. Driver papers: a valid commercial driving licence. Trip papers: LR/bilty, invoice or delivery challan, and e-way bill where applicable. Keep digital copies too; DigiLocker and mParivahan copies of RC and licence are generally accepted at checks.

question: What is e-POD and how do I upload it in the Partner App?
alternate_questions: How to upload e-POD|Digital POD upload|Photo of bilty upload|ई-पीओडी क्या है|ई-पीओडी कैसे अपलोड करें|POD की फोटो कहाँ डालें
answer_en: e-POD is the digital proof of delivery: clear photos of the consignee-signed and stamped POD. In the Partner App, open the trip, go to Documents, and upload photos of all pages, making sure the seal, signature and receiving date are visible. Upload within 24 hours of unloading to trigger provisional clearance and speed up your balance payment.
answer_hi: e-POD डिलीवरी का डिजिटल सबूत है, यानी पाने वाले के हस्ताक्षर और मोहर लगे POD की साफ फोटो। पार्टनर ऐप में ट्रिप खोलें, Documents में जाएं और सभी पन्नों की फोटो अपलोड करें, ध्यान रहे कि मोहर, हस्ताक्षर और प्राप्ति की तारीख साफ दिखे। अनलोडिंग के 24 घंटे के अंदर अपलोड करें ताकि प्रोविज़नल क्लीयरेंस शुरू हो और बैलेंस पेमेंट जल्दी आए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, e-POD matlab party ki mohar aur sign wali POD ki photo. Partner App me trip kholo, Documents me jaao, saare page ki photo daalo, mohar, sign aur date saaf dikhni chahiye. Gaadi khaali hone ke 24 ghante ke andar daal do, balance jaldi aayega.
answer: e-POD is the digital proof of delivery: clear photos of the consignee-signed and stamped POD. In the Partner App, open the trip, go to Documents, and upload photos of all pages, making sure the seal, signature and receiving date are visible. Upload within 24 hours of unloading to trigger provisional clearance and speed up your balance payment.

question: How and when should I submit the physical (hard copy) POD?
alternate_questions: Hard copy POD submission|Original bilty kahan bhejni hai|POD timeline|ओरिजिनल POD कहाँ जमा करें|हार्ड कॉपी POD कब भेजनी है|POD कितने दिन में देनी होती है
answer_en: Send the original signed and stamped POD within 7 to 10 days of unloading, either by hand at the nearest RoadExpress office or by courier, with the trip LR number written clearly on the envelope. Keep the courier receipt. Physical verification takes about 2 to 3 working days after arrival, after which balance clearance begins.
answer_hi: अनलोडिंग के 7 से 10 दिन के अंदर हस्ताक्षर और मोहर लगी ओरिजिनल POD नज़दीकी रोडएक्सप्रेस ऑफिस में दें या कूरियर करें, और लिफाफे पर ट्रिप का LR नंबर साफ लिखें। कूरियर की रसीद संभाल कर रखें। पहुँचने के बाद लगभग 2 से 3 कार्यदिवस में जांच होती है, फिर बैलेंस क्लीयरेंस शुरू होता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi khaali hone ke 7 se 10 din me original POD office me de do ya courier kar do, lifafe pe LR number likhna mat bhoolna. Courier ki parchi sambhal ke rakhna. Office pahunchne ke 2-3 din me check hoti hai, phir balance ka kaam shuru.
answer: Send the original signed and stamped POD within 7 to 10 days of unloading, either by hand at the nearest RoadExpress office or by courier, with the trip LR number written clearly on the envelope. Keep the courier receipt. Physical verification takes about 2 to 3 working days after arrival, after which balance clearance begins.

question: What should the driver do if the consignee unloads but doesn't give the signed POD?
alternate_questions: Consignee not giving POD|Party mohar nahi laga rahi|Unloading done but no POD|पार्टी बिल्टी पर मोहर नहीं लगा रही|माल उतर गया पर POD नहीं मिली|POD पर साइन नहीं कर रहे
answer_en: Don't move the vehicle from the premises. Take photos of the unloaded goods on the bay and the gate entry pass, then call +91-84477-38498 immediately. The RoadExpress commercial team will contact the consignee's management to get the endorsed POD released.
answer_hi: गाड़ी परिसर से न हटाएं। उतरे हुए माल और गेट एंट्री पास की फोटो लें और तुरंत +91-84477-38498 पर कॉल करें। रोडएक्सप्रेस की कमर्शियल टीम पाने वाले के मैनेजमेंट से बात करके POD दिलवाएगी।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi wahan se mat hilana. Utre hue maal aur gate pass ki photo kheencho aur turant +91-84477-38498 pe call karo. Hamari team party ke bade logon se baat karke POD dilwa degi.
answer: Don't move the vehicle from the premises. Take photos of the unloaded goods on the bay and the gate entry pass, then call +91-84477-38498 immediately. The RoadExpress commercial team will contact the consignee's management to get the endorsed POD released.

question: How much advance is paid and when is it credited?
alternate_questions: Advance kitna milta hai|When will I get trip advance|Advance percentage and timing|एडवांस कितना मिलता है|एडवांस कब आएगा|गाड़ी लोड होने के बाद एडवांस कितनी देर में
answer_en: RoadExpress pays 70% to 80% of the agreed freight as advance, split between bank transfer and diesel card depending on the lane agreement. It is sent by IMPS or NEFT to your registered bank account within 3 to 4 hours of loading completion and receipt of the signed loading slip.
answer_hi: रोडएक्सप्रेस तय भाड़े का 70% से 80% एडवांस देता है, जो लेन एग्रीमेंट के अनुसार बैंक ट्रांसफर और डीज़ल कार्ड में बंटा होता है। लोडिंग पूरी होने और साइन की हुई लोडिंग स्लिप मिलने के 3 से 4 घंटे के अंदर यह IMPS या NEFT से आपके रजिस्टर्ड बैंक खाते में भेज दिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, tay bhade ka 70 se 80% advance milta hai, kuch bank me aur kuch diesel card pe, lane ke hisaab se. Loading poori hone aur loading slip milne ke 3-4 ghante me IMPS/NEFT se khaate me aa jaata hai.
answer: RoadExpress pays 70% to 80% of the agreed freight as advance, split between bank transfer and diesel card depending on the lane agreement. It is sent by IMPS or NEFT to your registered bank account within 3 to 4 hours of loading completion and receipt of the signed loading slip.

question: When is the balance freight paid?
alternate_questions: Balance kab aayega|Balance payment cycle|How many days for final payment|बैलेंस कितने दिन में आता है|बाकी भाड़ा कब मिलेगा|फाइनल पेमेंट कब होगा
answer_en: The remaining 20% to 30% is released within 7 to 10 working days after the physical POD is verified and any shortage or damage deductions are settled. Uploading e-POD quickly and sending the original POD on time are the two biggest things that speed this up.
answer_hi: बाकी 20% से 30% भाड़ा फिज़िकल POD की जांच और कमी या नुकसान की कटौती तय होने के बाद 7 से 10 कार्यदिवस में जारी होता है। e-POD जल्दी अपलोड करना और ओरिजिनल POD समय पर भेजना, ये दो चीज़ें पेमेंट सबसे ज़्यादा जल्दी करवाती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, baaki 20-30% balance original POD check hone ke 7 se 10 working din me aata hai, agar koi katoti ho to wo adjust karke. e-POD jaldi daalo aur original POD time pe bhejo, balance jaldi aayega.
answer: The remaining 20% to 30% is released within 7 to 10 working days after the physical POD is verified and any shortage or damage deductions are settled. Uploading e-POD quickly and sending the original POD on time are the two biggest things that speed this up.

question: Why haven't I received my balance even though the POD reached the office?
alternate_questions: POD pahunch gayi phir bhi payment nahi aaya|Balance pending after POD|Payment delay reason|POD पहुँचने के बाद भी पेमेंट क्यों नहीं आया|बैलेंस रुका हुआ है|पेमेंट में देरी क्यों
answer_en: Common reasons are an unclear or unverified consignee stamp or signature, a pending customer debit note for shortage or damage, a mismatch in bank details, or the payment batch date not yet reached. Share your LR number, vehicle number and POD courier receipt with +91-84477-38498 or connect@roadexpressfreight.com to check the exact status.
answer_hi: आम कारण हैं: पाने वाले की मोहर या हस्ताक्षर साफ न होना या सत्यापित न होना, कमी या नुकसान का ग्राहक डेबिट नोट लंबित होना, बैंक विवरण में गड़बड़ी, या पेमेंट बैच की तारीख अभी न आना। सही स्थिति जानने के लिए अपना LR नंबर, गाड़ी नंबर और POD कूरियर रसीद +91-84477-38498 या connect@roadexpressfreight.com पर भेजें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aksar mohar ya sign saaf nahi hota, party ki taraf se shortage ka debit note atka hota hai, bank detail galat hoti hai, ya payment batch ki date abhi nahi aayi. LR number, gaadi number aur courier parchi +91-84477-38498 pe ya mail pe bhejo, exact wajah pata chal jayegi.
answer: Common reasons are an unclear or unverified consignee stamp or signature, a pending customer debit note for shortage or damage, a mismatch in bank details, or the payment batch date not yet reached. Share your LR number, vehicle number and POD courier receipt with +91-84477-38498 or connect@roadexpressfreight.com to check the exact status.

question: What deductions (katoti) can be made from my freight settlement?
alternate_questions: Katoti kya kya hoti hai|Deductions from freight|Why is my payment less|भाड़े में से क्या-क्या कटता है|कटौती कितनी लगी|पेमेंट कम क्यों आया
answer_en: Allowed deductions are statutory TDS (if applicable), verified shortage or damage endorsed on the POD, advances already paid in cash or diesel, and pre-agreed charges such as hamali if your agreement says so. Every deduction is itemised in your payment voucher. Unauthorised commissions or informal munshiana are not deducted.
answer_hi: मान्य कटौतियाँ हैं: कानूनी TDS (अगर लागू हो), POD पर दर्ज और सत्यापित कमी या नुकसान, पहले दिया गया नकद या डीज़ल एडवांस, और एग्रीमेंट में तय हमाली जैसे चार्ज। हर कटौती आपके पेमेंट वाउचर में अलग-अलग दिखाई जाती है। बिना अनुमति का कमीशन या मुंशियाना नहीं काटा जाता।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, katoti sirf ye hoti hai: TDS agar lagta ho, POD pe likhi aur check ki hui shortage ya damage, jo advance ya diesel pehle mil chuka, aur agreement me likhi hamali. Har katoti voucher me alag dikhegi. Munshiana ya koi upar ka commission nahi katta.
answer: Allowed deductions are statutory TDS (if applicable), verified shortage or damage endorsed on the POD, advances already paid in cash or diesel, and pre-agreed charges such as hamali if your agreement says so. Every deduction is itemised in your payment voucher. Unauthorised commissions or informal munshiana are not deducted.

question: Is TDS deducted on freight payments, and can transporters get an exemption?
alternate_questions: TDS on transport payment|TDS kitna katega|Section 194C exemption for transporters|भाड़े पर TDS कटता है क्या|TDS से छूट कैसे मिले|ट्रांसपोर्टर के लिए TDS नियम
answer_en: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, TDS on freight is generally 1% for individuals and HUFs and 2% for firms and companies. A transporter owning 10 or fewer goods carriages at any time in the year can get nil TDS by submitting PAN and a self-declaration. Submit the declaration to RoadExpress before payment, and request your quarterly Form 16A for any TDS deducted.
answer_hi: आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 194C के तहत भाड़े पर TDS आम तौर पर व्यक्ति और HUF के लिए 1% और फर्म और कंपनी के लिए 2% है। साल में किसी भी समय 10 या उससे कम माल वाहन रखने वाला ट्रांसपोर्टर PAN और स्व-घोषणा पत्र देकर शून्य TDS ले सकता है। पेमेंट से पहले यह घोषणा रोडएक्सप्रेस को दें, और कटे हुए TDS के लिए तिमाही Form 16A मांगें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, 194C ke hisaab se TDS aam taur pe akele aadmi ya HUF pe 1% aur firm pe 2% katta hai. Agar aapke paas saal bhar 10 ya kam gaadi hain, to PAN aur ek declaration de do, TDS nahi katega. Ye declaration payment se pehle jama karo, aur jo TDS kata uska Form 16A har teen mahine maang lo.
answer: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, TDS on freight is generally 1% for individuals and HUFs and 2% for firms and companies. A transporter owning 10 or fewer goods carriages at any time in the year can get nil TDS by submitting PAN and a self-declaration. Submit the declaration to RoadExpress before payment, and request your quarterly Form 16A for any TDS deducted.

question: What is munshiana and does RoadExpress deduct it?
alternate_questions: Munshiana kya hai|Munshiana kat ta hai kya|Munshiana policy|मुंशियाना क्या होता है|क्या भाड़े से मुंशियाना कटता है|मुंशियाना कैसे कटता है
answer_en: Munshiana is a traditional deduction taken by booking agents or brokers from the truck's freight for clerical and booking work, often done informally and without receipts. RoadExpress has a zero-tolerance policy: no munshiana or unauthorised commission is deducted, and your agreed freight is shown transparently. If anyone demands munshiana in RoadExpress's name, report it to +91-84477-38498.
answer_hi: मुंशियाना एक पारंपरिक कटौती है जो बुकिंग एजेंट या दलाल लिखा-पढ़ी और बुकिंग के नाम पर गाड़ी के भाड़े से काटते हैं, अक्सर बिना रसीद के। रोडएक्सप्रेस की ज़ीरो-टॉलरेंस नीति है: कोई मुंशियाना या बिना अनुमति का कमीशन नहीं कटता और तय भाड़ा पारदर्शी रूप से दिखाया जाता है। अगर कोई रोडएक्सप्रेस के नाम पर मुंशियाना मांगे तो +91-84477-38498 पर शिकायत करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, munshiana wo paisa hai jo booking agent ya dalaal likha-padhi ke naam pe bhade me se kaat lete hain, bina parchi ke. RoadExpress me munshiana bilkul nahi katta, jo bhada tay hua wahi saaf dikhega. Koi RoadExpress ke naam pe munshiana maange to turant +91-84477-38498 pe batao.
answer: Munshiana is a traditional deduction taken by booking agents or brokers from the truck's freight for clerical and booking work, often done informally and without receipts. RoadExpress has a zero-tolerance policy: no munshiana or unauthorised commission is deducted, and your agreed freight is shown transparently. If anyone demands munshiana in RoadExpress's name, report it to +91-84477-38498.

question: How do I change the bank account for freight payments?
alternate_questions: Bank account change|Update bank details|New cheque for payment|बैंक खाता कैसे बदलें|बैंक डिटेल अपडेट करनी है|नया चेक जमा करना है
answer_en: Submit a signed request letter on your letterhead (or a signed letter for individuals) with a fresh cancelled cheque showing your name or firm name, by verified email to connect@roadexpressfreight.com or in person. Changes are applied only after verification, so do this before your next trip to avoid payment holds. RoadExpress will never ask you to change bank details over a phone call.
answer_hi: अपने लेटरहेड पर हस्ताक्षर किया हुआ अनुरोध पत्र (व्यक्ति हों तो हस्ताक्षरित पत्र) और नाम या फर्म के नाम वाला नया कैंसल चेक सत्यापित ईमेल से connect@roadexpressfreight.com पर भेजें या खुद जमा करें। बदलाव जांच के बाद ही लागू होता है, इसलिए अगली ट्रिप से पहले करें। रोडएक्सप्रेस कभी फोन कॉल पर बैंक डिटेल बदलने को नहीं कहता।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, letterhead pe sign kiya hua letter aur naya cancel cheque jispe aapka ya firm ka naam ho, registered email se connect@roadexpressfreight.com pe bhejo ya office me de do. Check hone ke baad hi badlega, isliye agli trip se pehle karwa lo. Dhyan rakho, RoadExpress kabhi phone pe bank detail badalne ko nahi bolta, aisa call aaye to fraud hai.
answer: Submit a signed request letter on your letterhead (or a signed letter for individuals) with a fresh cancelled cheque showing your name or firm name, by verified email to connect@roadexpressfreight.com or in person. Changes are applied only after verification, so do this before your next trip to avoid payment holds. RoadExpress will never ask you to change bank details over a phone call.

question: How do I file a claim for damaged or short-delivered goods?

question: How do I choose the right vehicle for my load?
alternate_questions: Which truck for my goods|Kaunsi gaadi lagegi|Truck size guide|मेरे माल के लिए कौन सी गाड़ी सही है|कितने टन की गाड़ी चाहिए|गाड़ी का साइज़ कैसे चुनें
answer_en: Match weight and volume first: LCVs for up to about 2 to 3 tonnes, 19 to 24 ft trucks for mid loads, 10 to 14-wheelers for heavy loads, and 32 ft containers for light but bulky cargo. Use closed containers for weather-sensitive or high-value goods, open bodies for construction material and machinery, and trailers for long or oversized items. Share dimensions, weight and packaging with support for an exact recommendation.
answer_hi: पहले वज़न और आयतन मिलाएं: लगभग 2 से 3 टन तक के लिए LCV, मध्यम लोड के लिए 19 से 24 फीट ट्रक, भारी लोड के लिए 10 से 14 पहिया, और हल्के लेकिन ज़्यादा जगह वाले माल के लिए 32 फीट कंटेनर। मौसम से खराब होने वाले या कीमती माल के लिए बंद कंटेनर, निर्माण सामग्री और मशीनरी के लिए ओपन बॉडी, और लंबे या बड़े सामान के लिए ट्रेलर लें। सटीक सलाह के लिए नाप, वज़न और पैकिंग सपोर्ट को बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, pehle wazan aur jagah dekho: 2-3 ton tak chhoti gaadi, beech ke load ke liye 19-24 ft, bhaari ke liye 10-14 chakka, aur halka par bada maal ho to 32 ft container. Baarish se kharab hone wala ya mehnga maal container me, sariya-cement-machine open body me, lamba maal trailer pe. Naap aur wazan support ko batao, sahi gaadi bata denge.
answer: Match weight and volume first: LCVs for up to about 2 to 3 tonnes, 19 to 24 ft trucks for mid loads, 10 to 14-wheelers for heavy loads, and 32 ft containers for light but bulky cargo. Use closed containers for weather-sensitive or high-value goods, open bodies for construction material and machinery, and trailers for long or oversized items. Share dimensions, weight and packaging with support for an exact recommendation.

question: What is the policy if the truck is loaded beyond its legal weight (overloading)?

answer_en: RoadExpress follows the legal gross vehicle weight (GVW) printed on the RC. answer_hinglish: Bhai, RC pe jo GVW likha hai usse zyada maal nahi. Kanta parchi me overweight aaye to extra maal utarwao, tabhi gaadi nikalo, warna bhaari challan aur accident ka khatra. Factory zabardasti kare to turant +91-84477-38498 pe batao, bina permission ke overload challan RoadExpress nahi bharega.
answer: RoadExpress follows the legal gross vehicle weight (GVW) printed on the RC. If forced to move, report immediately to +91-84477-38498; RoadExpress does not reimburse unauthorised overloading fines.

question: Who pays the unloading labour (hamali) charges?

question: What is the difference between detention and demurrage?
alternate_questions: Detention vs demurrage|What is demurrage|Demurrage charges meaning|डिटेंशन और डेमरेज में क्या फर्क है|डेमरेज क्या होता है|डेमरेज चार्ज कब लगता है
answer_en: In Indian road freight, detention (also called haltage) is the charge paid to the truck owner when the vehicle is held at loading or unloading beyond the free time. Demurrage, strictly, is the charge for cargo or containers held beyond free time at a port, rail yard or terminal, though many operators use the two words interchangeably. At RoadExpress, truck waiting time is claimed as detention.
answer_hi: भारतीय रोड फ्रेट में डिटेंशन (जिसे हॉल्टेज भी कहते हैं) वह चार्ज है जो गाड़ी को लोडिंग या अनलोडिंग पर छूट के समय से ज़्यादा रोकने पर गाड़ी मालिक को मिलता है। डेमरेज असल में पोर्ट, रेलवे यार्ड या टर्मिनल पर माल या कंटेनर को छूट के समय से ज़्यादा रखने का चार्ज है, हालाँकि कई लोग दोनों शब्द एक ही अर्थ में बोलते हैं। रोडएक्सप्रेस में गाड़ी के इंतज़ार का पैसा डिटेंशन के रूप में क्लेम होता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, detention ya haltage wo paisa hai jo gaadi loading-unloading pe zyada der khadi rahe to gaadi maalik ko milta hai. Demurrage asal me port, railway ya terminal pe maal ya container zyada din padा rehne ka charge hai, par bahut log dono ko ek hi bolte hain. RoadExpress me gaadi khadi rehne ka paisa detention me claim hota hai.
answer: In Indian road freight, detention (also called haltage) is the charge paid to the truck owner when the vehicle is held at loading or unloading beyond the free time. Demurrage, strictly, is the charge for cargo or containers held beyond free time at a port, rail yard or terminal, though many operators use the two words interchangeably. At RoadExpress, truck waiting time is claimed as detention.

question: What is the difference between an invoice, a delivery challan and an LR?
alternate_questions: Invoice vs challan vs LR|Bill aur bilty me fark|What is delivery challan|बिल, चालान और बिल्टी में क्या फर्क है|डिलीवरी चालान क्या होता है|इनवॉइस और LR अलग हैं क्या
answer_en: The invoice is the seller's tax bill for the goods, showing value and GST. A delivery challan is issued instead of an invoice when goods move without a sale, such as job work, stock transfer or returns. The LR or bilty is the transporter's receipt for carrying the goods. A truck usually needs the invoice or challan, the LR, and an e-way bill where applicable.
answer_hi: इनवॉइस माल का विक्रेता द्वारा जारी टैक्स बिल है, जिसमें कीमत और GST होता है। डिलीवरी चालान इनवॉइस की जगह तब जारी होता है जब माल बिना बिक्री के जाता है, जैसे जॉब वर्क, स्टॉक ट्रांसफर या वापसी। LR या बिल्टी माल ढोने के लिए ट्रांसपोर्टर की रसीद है। गाड़ी में आम तौर पर इनवॉइस या चालान, LR और लागू होने पर ई-वे बिल चाहिए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, invoice yaani maal ka pakka bill jisme keemat aur GST hota hai. Delivery challan tab banta hai jab maal bina bikri ke jaata hai, jaise job work, stock transfer ya wapsi. LR ya bilty transporter ki raseed hai ki maal gaadi me chadha. Gaadi me bill ya challan, bilty aur e-way bill hona chahiye.
answer: The invoice is the seller's tax bill for the goods, showing value and GST. A delivery challan is issued instead of an invoice when goods move without a sale, such as job work, stock transfer or returns. The LR or bilty is the transporter's receipt for carrying the goods. A truck usually needs the invoice or challan, the LR, and an e-way bill where applicable.

question: What if the e-way bill expires before the truck reaches the destination?
alternate_questions: E-way bill expired on road|Extend e-way bill validity|E-way bill time khatam ho gaya|ई-वे बिल की वैधता खत्म हो गई|ई-वे बिल कैसे बढ़ाएं|रास्ते में ई-वे बिल एक्सपायर
answer_en: The generator of the e-way bill can extend validity on the GST portal, generally within a window around the expiry time, if the delay is due to breakdown, accident, traffic or other genuine reasons. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] early with your Trip ID so the team can coordinate with the consignor. Driving with an expired e-way bill risks detention of goods and penalties.
answer_hi: ई-वे बिल बनाने वाला व्यक्ति ब्रेकडाउन, दुर्घटना, ट्रैफिक या अन्य सही कारण से देरी होने पर GST पोर्टल पर वैधता बढ़ा सकता है, आम तौर पर समाप्ति के समय के आसपास की एक अवधि में। ट्रिप ID के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर जल्दी बताएं ताकि टीम भेजने वाले से बात कर सके। समाप्त ई-वे बिल के साथ चलने पर माल रोका जा सकता है और जुर्माना लग सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, e-way bill ka time khatam hone wala ho to jisne banaya wo GST portal pe badha sakta hai, agar gaadi kharab hui, accident hua ya jam me fasi. Trip ID leke jaldi [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, team party se badhwa degi. Expire e-way bill pe chaloge to maal rukega aur jurmana lagega.
answer: The generator of the e-way bill can extend validity on the GST portal, generally within a window around the expiry time, if the delay is due to breakdown, accident, traffic or other genuine reasons. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] early with your Trip ID so the team can coordinate with the consignor. Driving with an expired e-way bill risks detention of goods and penalties.

question: What is a loading slip and why is it important?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, loading slip wo parchi hai jo maal chadhne ke baad party sign karti hai, gaadi number, nag, wazan aur loading ka time likha hota hai. Isi se trip chalu hoti hai aur advance aata hai, to loading hote hi Partner App me iski saaf photo daal do.
answer: The loading slip is the document signed at the consignor's end confirming the vehicle number, packages, weight and loading completion time. RoadExpress uses it to start the trip and release your advance, so upload a clear photo in the Partner App right after loading.

question: What KYC documents do I need to join as a carrier partner?

answer: You need PAN, Aadhaar, a cancelled cheque, GST certificate if registered, and for each truck the RC, valid insurance, fitness certificate and National Permit. Upload clear scans in the Partner App or email them to [SUPPORT_EMAIL]. Verification takes about [VERIFICATION_HOURS] working hours once everything is correct.

question: How do I update expired insurance, fitness or permit documents?
alternate_questions: Insurance renew upload|Update fitness certificate|Expired documents update|बीमा रिन्यू होने के बाद कैसे अपलोड करें|फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट अपडेट|एक्सपायर कागज़ अपडेट करने हैं

answer: Upload the renewed document in the Partner App under Fleet Hub for that vehicle, or email a clear PDF with the vehicle number to [SUPPORT_EMAIL]. Do it before expiry, because trucks with expired documents are blocked from new loads until updated.

question: What should I do if the LR or original POD is lost?

answer_en: Inform [SUPPORT_EMAIL] immediately with the Trip ID and vehicle number. If you have photos or an e-POD, upload them. A lost POD can delay payment, so always photograph it before couriering.

answer_hinglish: Bhai, Trip ID aur gaadi number leke turant [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe batao. Photo ya e-POD hai to daal do. Team party se duplicate copy mangwayegi, kabhi-kabhi indemnity letter bhi dena padta hai. POD khone se balance atakta hai, isliye courier se pehle hamesha photo kheench lena.
answer: Inform [SUPPORT_EMAIL] immediately with the Trip ID and vehicle number. If you have photos or an e-POD, upload them. RoadExpress will request a duplicate or certified copy from the consignee, and in some cases an indemnity letter may be needed before balance release. A lost POD can delay payment, so always photograph it before couriering.

Contract wale ko [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] din ka udhaar mil sakta hai. Bank transfer se payment hota hai, aur har trip ka GST bill milta hai.
answer: Payment terms are agreed at booking. New shippers usually pay [SHIPPER_ADVANCE_TERMS] before dispatch and the rest after delivery, while contract shippers may get a credit period of [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] days. question: How does GST apply to road freight?
alternate_questions: GST on freight|GTA GST rate|RCM on transport|भाड़े पर GST कितना लगता है|GTA पर GST|ट्रांसपोर्ट पर रिवर्स चार्ज
answer_en: Freight services by a Goods Transport Agency (GTA) that issues a consignment note attract GST either under reverse charge at [GST_GTA_RCM_RATE], paid by the registered recipient, or under forward charge at [GST_GTA_FCM_RATE] if the GTA opts for it. Hiring of a truck directly from an individual owner without a consignment note is generally exempt. Your RoadExpress invoice shows which applies; check with your tax advisor for your case.
answer_hi: कंसाइनमेंट नोट जारी करने वाली गुड्स ट्रांसपोर्ट एजेंसी (GTA) की भाड़ा सेवा पर GST या तो रिवर्स चार्ज में [GST_GTA_RCM_RATE] लगता है, जिसे रजिस्टर्ड प्राप्तकर्ता भरता है, या GTA के चुनने पर फॉरवर्ड चार्ज में [GST_GTA_FCM_RATE] लगता है। बिना कंसाइनमेंट नोट के किसी व्यक्तिगत मालिक से सीधे गाड़ी किराए पर लेना आम तौर पर छूट में है। आपके रोडएक्सप्रेस इनवॉइस में लिखा होता है कि कौन सा लागू है; अपने मामले के लिए टैक्स सलाहकार से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bilty dene wali transport agency (GTA) ke bhade pe GST ya to reverse charge me [GST_GTA_RCM_RATE] lagta hai jo party bharti hai, ya forward charge me [GST_GTA_FCM_RATE] agar agency ne chuna ho. Akele gaadi maalik se seedha bina bilty ke gaadi lo to aam taur pe GST nahi lagta. RoadExpress ke bill me likha hota hai, apne CA se bhi confirm kar lo.
answer: Freight services by a Goods Transport Agency (GTA) that issues a consignment note attract GST either under reverse charge at [GST_GTA_RCM_RATE], paid by the registered recipient, or under forward charge at [GST_GTA_FCM_RATE] if the GTA opts for it. Hiring of a truck directly from an individual owner without a consignment note is generally exempt. Your RoadExpress invoice shows which applies; check with your tax advisor for your case.

answer_hinglish: Bhai, Partner App me Trip Status Dashboard pe trip kholo, advance aur balance ka status Pending, Processing ya Credited dikhega, aur paisa jaane ke baad UTR number bhi. Paisa chhutne pe message bhi aata hai.

question: How does the diesel card advance work?

answer_en: Part of your trip advance may be loaded as fuel credit on a diesel card usable at partner fuel stations on the route. answer_hi: आपके ट्रिप एडवांस का एक हिस्सा डीज़ल कार्ड पर फ्यूल क्रेडिट के रूप में डाला जा सकता है, जो रूट पर पार्टनर पेट्रोल पंपों पर चलता है। डाली गई रकम ट्रिप सेटलमेंट में दिखती है और कुल भाड़े में एडजस्ट होती है। कार्ड का PIN किसी को न बताएं, और कार्ड खोने पर तुरंत [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं ताकि उसे ब्लॉक किया जा सके।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, advance ka kuch hissa diesel card pe daal dete hain, route ke partner pump pe chalta hai. Jitna diesel daala wo hisaab me dikhega aur bhade me adjust hoga. Card ka PIN kisi ko mat batana, aur card kho jaye to turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, block kar denge.
answer: Part of your trip advance may be loaded as fuel credit on a diesel card usable at partner fuel stations on the route. The loaded amount appears in your trip settlement and is adjusted against total freight. Keep the card PIN private, and report a lost card to [SUPPORT_PHONE] immediately so it can be blocked.

question: What is a payment voucher or settlement statement?
alternate_questions: Settlement statement meaning|Payment voucher details|Hisaab ki parchi|पेमेंट वाउचर क्या होता है|सेटलमेंट स्टेटमेंट में क्या होता है|हिसाब की पर्ची कहाँ मिलेगी
answer_en: The settlement voucher is the trip-wise statement showing agreed freight, advance paid in cash and diesel, detention or other additions, each deduction such as TDS or verified shortage, and the net balance paid. Download it from the trip in the Partner App or request it at [SUPPORT_EMAIL]. Check it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days and raise any mismatch.
answer_hi: सेटलमेंट वाउचर ट्रिप के हिसाब से बयान है जिसमें तय भाड़ा, नकद और डीज़ल में दिया गया एडवांस, डिटेंशन या अन्य जोड़, TDS या सत्यापित कमी जैसी हर कटौती और भुगतान किया गया शुद्ध बैलेंस दिखता है। इसे पार्टनर ऐप में ट्रिप से डाउनलोड करें या [SUPPORT_EMAIL] से मांगें। [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] दिन के अंदर जांचें और कोई गड़बड़ हो तो बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, voucher matlab trip ka poora hisaab: tay bhada, advance cash aur diesel me kitna mila, detention kitna juda, TDS ya shortage ki katoti kitni hui, aur aakhir me kitna balance aaya. Partner App me trip se download karo ya [SUPPORT_EMAIL] se maango. [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] din me check karke galti ho to batao.
answer: The settlement voucher is the trip-wise statement showing agreed freight, advance paid in cash and diesel, detention or other additions, each deduction such as TDS or verified shortage, and the net balance paid. Download it from the trip in the Partner App or request it at [SUPPORT_EMAIL]. Check it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days and raise any mismatch.

question: My truck is loaded but the advance hasn't come. What should I do?
alternate_questions: Advance nahi aaya|Advance pending after loading|Truck loaded advance missing|गाड़ी लोड हो गई एडवांस नहीं आया|एडवांस अटका हुआ है|लोडिंग के बाद भी पैसा नहीं आया
answer_en: First check that the signed loading slip is uploaded and the trip shows as loaded in the app. Delays usually come from a missing or unclear loading slip, unverified bank details, or a bank-side hold. If [ADVANCE_TAT_HOURS] hours have passed, send the truck number, Trip ID and loading slip to [SUPPORT_PHONE].
answer_hi: पहले जांचें कि साइन की हुई लोडिंग स्लिप अपलोड हुई है और ऐप में ट्रिप लोडेड दिख रही है। देरी आम तौर पर लोडिंग स्लिप न होने या साफ न होने, बैंक विवरण सत्यापित न होने या बैंक की तरफ से रुकावट से होती है। अगर [ADVANCE_TAT_HOURS] घंटे हो गए हैं, तो गाड़ी नंबर, ट्रिप ID और लोडिंग स्लिप [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर भेजें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, pehle dekho loading slip app me daali hai ya nahi aur trip loaded dikh rahi hai ya nahi. Aksar slip nahi hoti, photo saaf nahi hoti, ya bank detail verify nahi hoti, isliye advance atakta hai. [ADVANCE_TAT_HOURS] ghante ho gaye to gaadi number, Trip ID aur loading slip [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bhejo.
tags: advance pending,loading slip,bank verification,advance nahi aaya
answer: First check that the signed loading slip is uploaded and the trip shows as loaded in the app. Delays usually come from a missing or unclear loading slip, unverified bank details, or a bank-side hold. If [ADVANCE_TAT_HOURS] hours have passed, send the truck number, Trip ID and loading slip to [SUPPORT_PHONE].

question: Is my cargo insured during transit?
alternate_questions: Transit insurance for goods|Does RoadExpress insure cargo|Goods in transit insurance|क्या माल का बीमा होता है|ट्रांज़िट बीमा मिलेगा क्या|रास्ते में माल का इंश्योरेंस
answer_en: The truck's motor insurance covers the vehicle and third-party liability, not the full value of your goods. For cargo protection, shippers should have their own goods-in-transit or marine inland policy, or opt for transit insurance through RoadExpress where available via [INSURANCE_PARTNER]. Ask support for coverage details and premium before dispatch.
answer_hi: गाड़ी का मोटर बीमा गाड़ी और थर्ड-पार्टी देनदारी को कवर करता है, आपके माल की पूरी कीमत को नहीं। माल की सुरक्षा के लिए शिपर के पास अपनी गुड्स-इन-ट्रांज़िट या मरीन इनलैंड पॉलिसी होनी चाहिए, या जहाँ उपलब्ध हो वहाँ [INSURANCE_PARTNER] के ज़रिए रोडएक्सप्रेस से ट्रांज़िट बीमा लें। गाड़ी निकलने से पहले कवरेज और प्रीमियम की जानकारी सपोर्ट से लें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ka insurance sirf gaadi aur third party ko cover karta hai, aapke maal ki poori keemat ko nahi. Maal ke liye apni transit insurance policy rakho, ya jahan milta ho wahan RoadExpress se [INSURANCE_PARTNER] ke through le lo. Gaadi nikalne se pehle support se cover aur premium pooch lo.
tags: transit insurance,cargo insurance,goods in transit,marine inland,insurance
answer: The truck's motor insurance covers the vehicle and third-party liability, not the full value of your goods. For cargo protection, shippers should have their own goods-in-transit or marine inland policy, or opt for transit insurance through RoadExpress where available via [INSURANCE_PARTNER]. Ask support for coverage details and premium before dispatch.

question: What should be done if cargo is stolen or pilfered during transit?
alternate_questions: Maal chori ho gaya|Cargo theft in transit|Pilferage on the way|रास्ते में माल चोरी हो गया|माल गायब है|चोरी हो गई क्या करें
answer_en: The driver should immediately file an FIR at the nearest police station and get a copy, then call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID and location. Preserve the seal, photos and GPS trail. RoadExpress informs the consignor and supports the insurance claim, which normally needs the FIR, LR, invoice, survey report and POD remarks.
answer_hi: ड्राइवर तुरंत नज़दीकी पुलिस स्टेशन में FIR दर्ज कराए और उसकी कॉपी ले, फिर ट्रिप ID और लोकेशन के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करे। सील, फोटो और GPS रिकॉर्ड संभाल कर रखें। रोडएक्सप्रेस भेजने वाले को सूचित करता है और बीमा क्लेम में मदद करता है, जिसमें आम तौर पर FIR, LR, इनवॉइस, सर्वे रिपोर्ट और POD पर टिप्पणी चाहिए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chori hui to driver turant paas ke thane me FIR likhwaye aur copy le, phir Trip ID aur location leke [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call kare. Seal, photo aur GPS record sambhal ke rakho. Team party ko batayegi aur insurance claim me madad karegi, jisme FIR, bilty, bill, survey report aur POD chahiye hote hain.
answer: The driver should immediately file an FIR at the nearest police station and get a copy, then call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID and location. Preserve the seal, photos and GPS trail. RoadExpress informs the consignor and supports the insurance claim, which normally needs the FIR, LR, invoice, survey report and POD remarks.

question: How are late delivery penalties applied?
alternate_questions: Late delivery penalty|Gaadi late pahunchi katoti|Transit delay fine|देर से पहुँचने पर पेनल्टी|गाड़ी लेट हुई तो कटौती कितनी|डिलीवरी में देरी का जुर्माना
answer_en: Late delivery penalties apply only when the truck exceeds the agreed transit time without a valid reason such as a logged breakdown, accident, road closure or force majeure. Penalties are capped as per the lane agreement at [LATE_PENALTY_CAP]. To avoid unfair katoti, report every delay to [SUPPORT_PHONE] when it happens so it is recorded.
answer_hi: देर से डिलीवरी की पेनल्टी तभी लगती है जब गाड़ी बिना सही कारण के तय ट्रांज़िट समय से ज़्यादा ले, जैसे दर्ज ब्रेकडाउन, दुर्घटना, सड़क बंद या अप्रत्याशित घटना न हो। पेनल्टी लेन एग्रीमेंट के अनुसार [LATE_PENALTY_CAP] तक सीमित है। गलत कटौती से बचने के लिए हर देरी को उसी समय [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं ताकि वह दर्ज हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, late ki katoti tabhi lagti hai jab gaadi bina wajah tay time se zyada le. Breakdown, accident, rasta band jaisi wajah record me ho to nahi lagti. Katoti agreement ke hisaab se [LATE_PENALTY_CAP] tak hi. Jab bhi late ho raha ho, usi waqt [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do, record me aa jayega.
answer: Late delivery penalties apply only when the truck exceeds the agreed transit time without a valid reason such as a logged breakdown, accident, road closure or force majeure. Penalties are capped as per the lane agreement at [LATE_PENALTY_CAP]. To avoid unfair katoti, report every delay to [SUPPORT_PHONE] when it happens so it is recorded.

question: Who is responsible if goods get wet due to rain in an open truck?
alternate_questions: Rain damage in open truck|Tirpal phat gaya maal bheeg gaya|Water damage claim|बारिश से माल भीग गया|तिरपाल फट गया|पानी से नुकसान किसकी ज़िम्मेदारी
answer_en: Carriers must provide intact, waterproof tarpaulins (tirpal) and secure lashing for open-body trucks. If goods get wet because of a torn or poorly tied tarpaulin, the damage may be deducted from freight after verification. Shippers should book closed containers for moisture-sensitive goods. Check and photograph the tarpaulin condition at loading.
answer_hi: ओपन बॉडी गाड़ियों में गाड़ी मालिक को सही, वाटरप्रूफ तिरपाल और मज़बूत रस्सी बंधाई देनी होती है। अगर फटे या ढीले बंधे तिरपाल से माल भीगता है, तो जांच के बाद नुकसान भाड़े से काटा जा सकता है। नमी से खराब होने वाले माल के लिए शिपर बंद कंटेनर बुक करें। लोडिंग के समय तिरपाल की हालत जांचें और फोटो लें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, open gaadi me tirpal bina chhed ka aur rassi achhi tarah bandhi honi chahiye. Phate tirpal ya dheeli rassi se maal bheega to check karke nuksaan bhade se kat sakta hai. Baarish se kharab hone wala maal ho to container lo. Loading pe tirpal ki photo zaroor le lo.
answer: Carriers must provide intact, waterproof tarpaulins (tirpal) and secure lashing for open-body trucks. If goods get wet because of a torn or poorly tied tarpaulin, the damage may be deducted from freight after verification. Shippers should book closed containers for moisture-sensitive goods. Check and photograph the tarpaulin condition at loading.

question: What condition must a truck be in when placed for loading?
alternate_questions: Vehicle placement rules|Truck condition for loading|Gaadi kaisi honi chahiye loading pe|लोडिंग के लिए गाड़ी कैसी होनी चाहिए|गाड़ी प्लेसमेंट के नियम|लोडिंग से पहले क्या जांचें
answer_en: The truck must have a clean, dry cargo bed without holes or nails, intact waterproof tarpaulins and good lashing ropes for open bodies, working doors and locks for containers, valid documents, and a driver with a licence. The driver should supervise loading, check weight distribution and report any damaged cartons before signing.
answer_hi: गाड़ी का माल रखने वाला हिस्सा साफ, सूखा और बिना छेद या कील के होना चाहिए, ओपन बॉडी में सही वाटरप्रूफ तिरपाल और अच्छी रस्सी, कंटेनर में ठीक दरवाज़े और ताले, वैध कागज़ और लाइसेंस वाला ड्राइवर होना चाहिए। ड्राइवर लोडिंग की निगरानी करे, वज़न का बंटवारा देखे और साइन करने से पहले कोई टूटा कार्टन हो तो बताए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ki body saaf, sookhi, bina chhed aur keel ke ho. Open gaadi me achha tirpal aur rassi, container me darwaze aur taale theek. Kagaz poore aur driver ke paas licence. Loading ke time driver khada rahe, wazan barabar baante, aur toota carton dikhe to sign se pehle bata de.
answer: The truck must have a clean, dry cargo bed without holes or nails, intact waterproof tarpaulins and good lashing ropes for open bodies, working doors and locks for containers, valid documents, and a driver with a licence. The driver should supervise loading, check weight distribution and report any damaged cartons before signing.

question: What are the requirements for a truck to join the RoadExpress network?
alternate_questions: Truck eligibility|Kaunsi gaadi attach ho sakti hai|Vehicle age limit|कौन सी गाड़ी जुड़ सकती है|गाड़ी अटैच करने की शर्तें|गाड़ी कितनी पुरानी चलेगी
answer_en: The truck must have a valid RC, commercial insurance, fitness certificate, National or relevant permit and PUC, be roadworthy, and generally be no older than [MAX_VEHICLE_AGE_YEARS] years. GPS through the driver app or a fitted device is required for tracking. Upload the documents in the Partner App for verification.
answer_hi: गाड़ी के पास वैध RC, कमर्शियल बीमा, फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट, नेशनल या संबंधित परमिट और PUC होना चाहिए, सड़क पर चलने लायक हो, और आम तौर पर [MAX_VEHICLE_AGE_YEARS] साल से ज़्यादा पुरानी न हो। ट्रैकिंग के लिए ड्राइवर ऐप या लगे हुए डिवाइस से GPS ज़रूरी है। जांच के लिए पार्टनर ऐप में दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ka RC, commercial insurance, fitness, permit aur PUC sab valid ho, gaadi chalne laayak ho, aur aam taur pe [MAX_VEHICLE_AGE_YEARS] saal se purani na ho. Tracking ke liye driver app ya GPS device chahiye. Kagaz Partner App me daal do, check ho jayega.
answer: The truck must have a valid RC, commercial insurance, fitness certificate, National or relevant permit and PUC, be roadworthy, and generally be no older than [MAX_VEHICLE_AGE_YEARS] years. GPS through the driver app or a fitted device is required for tracking. Upload the documents in the Partner App for verification.

question: Are temperature-controlled (reefer) trucks available?
alternate_questions: Reefer truck booking|Cold chain transport|Refrigerated truck|ठंडे माल के लिए गाड़ी मिलेगी क्या|रीफर ट्रक|कोल्ड चेन ट्रांसपोर्ट
answer_en: Refrigerated trucks for perishables, dairy, frozen food and pharma can be arranged on selected lanes, subject to availability. Share the required temperature range, product type, weight and transit time with support at [SUPPORT_PHONE], and book early because reefer capacity is limited.
answer_hi: चुनिंदा रूट पर उपलब्धता के अनुसार जल्दी खराब होने वाले सामान, डेयरी, फ्रोज़न फूड और दवाइयों के लिए रेफ्रिजरेटेड गाड़ियाँ लगाई जा सकती हैं। ज़रूरी तापमान, माल का प्रकार, वज़न और ट्रांज़िट समय [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं, और जल्दी बुक करें क्योंकि रीफर गाड़ियाँ कम होती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, sabzi-phal, doodh, frozen maal ya dawai ke liye thandi gaadi kuch routes pe mil jaati hai. Kitna temperature chahiye, kya maal hai, wazan aur kitne din, [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, aur jaldi book karo kyunki aisi gaadi kam hoti hain.
answer: Refrigerated trucks for perishables, dairy, frozen food and pharma can be arranged on selected lanes, subject to availability. Share the required temperature range, product type, weight and transit time with support at [SUPPORT_PHONE], and book early because reefer capacity is limited.

question: What should I know about godown entry, gate passes and city no-entry timings?
alternate_questions: Godown gate entry process|No entry timing for trucks|City me gaadi kab ghus sakti hai|गोदाम में एंट्री कैसे होती है|शहर में नो एंट्री का समय|गेट पास कैसे मिलता है
answer_en: Most warehouses need the driver to register at the gate with the LR, invoice and driver ID to get an entry token or gate pass, so keep documents ready. Many cities restrict heavy vehicles during set daytime hours, so the arrival time is planned around no-entry windows. If your truck is held outside due to no-entry, inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the consignee is updated and waiting time is recorded.
answer_hi: ज़्यादातर गोदामों में ड्राइवर को LR, इनवॉइस और ड्राइवर ID के साथ गेट पर रजिस्टर करके एंट्री टोकन या गेट पास लेना होता है, इसलिए कागज़ तैयार रखें। कई शहरों में दिन के तय समय में भारी गाड़ियों पर रोक होती है, इसलिए पहुँचने का समय नो-एंट्री के हिसाब से तय होता है। अगर नो-एंट्री की वजह से गाड़ी बाहर रुकी है तो [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं ताकि पाने वाले को जानकारी मिले और इंतज़ार का समय दर्ज हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, godown ke gate pe bilty, bill aur driver ki ID dikhake entry karwani padti hai, token ya gate pass milta hai, kagaz tayyar rakho. Bahut shehron me din me bhaari gaadi ki no entry hoti hai, to pahunchne ka time usi hisaab se rakho. No entry me bahar khadi ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, party ko khabar ho jayegi aur time record ho jayega.
answer: Most warehouses need the driver to register at the gate with the LR, invoice and driver ID to get an entry token or gate pass, so keep documents ready. Many cities restrict heavy vehicles during set daytime hours, so the arrival time is planned around no-entry windows. If your truck is held outside due to no-entry, inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the consignee is updated and waiting time is recorded.

question: What if the driver changes during the trip?
alternate_questions: Driver change mid trip|New driver details update|Driver badal gaya|रास्ते में ड्राइवर बदल गया|नए ड्राइवर की जानकारी कैसे दें|ड्राइवर चेंज
answer_en: Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before or as soon as the driver changes, and update the new driver's name, mobile number and licence in the trip in the Partner App. The new driver must log into the driver app so tracking continues, and the consignee is updated for security at delivery.
answer_hi: ड्राइवर बदलने से पहले या तुरंत बाद [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं, और पार्टनर ऐप में ट्रिप में नए ड्राइवर का नाम, मोबाइल नंबर और लाइसेंस अपडेट करें। नया ड्राइवर ड्राइवर ऐप में लॉगिन करे ताकि ट्रैकिंग चलती रहे, और डिलीवरी पर सुरक्षा के लिए पाने वाले को भी जानकारी दी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, driver badalna ho to pehle hi ya turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, aur Partner App me trip me naye driver ka naam, number aur licence daal do. Naya driver app me login kare taaki tracking chalti rahe, party ko bhi bata denge.
answer: Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before or as soon as the driver changes, and update the new driver's name, mobile number and licence in the trip in the Partner App. The new driver must log into the driver app so tracking continues, and the consignee is updated for security at delivery.

question: What should be done if the seal is broken or tampered with?
alternate_questions: Seal toot gaya|Seal tampered on arrival|Broken seal at delivery|सील टूटी हुई है|सील से छेड़छाड़ हुई|डिलीवरी पर सील टूटी मिली
answer_en: Don't open or unload further. Photograph the seal and seal number, compare it with the number on the LR, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE] immediately. The consignee should note the seal condition on the POD and do a joint count. If tampering happened in transit, an FIR and insurance survey may be needed.
answer_hi: माल न खोलें और आगे न उतारें। सील और सील नंबर की फोटो लें, LR पर लिखे नंबर से मिलाएं, और तुरंत [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें। पाने वाला POD पर सील की हालत लिखे और साथ मिलकर गिनती करे। अगर रास्ते में छेड़छाड़ हुई है तो FIR और बीमा सर्वे की ज़रूरत पड़ सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, maal mat kholo aur mat utaaro. Seal aur seal number ki photo lo, bilty pe likhe number se milao, aur turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo. Party POD pe seal ki halat likhe aur saath me ginti ho. Raste me chhedchhad hui ho to FIR aur insurance survey lag sakta hai.
answer: Don't open or unload further. Photograph the seal and seal number, compare it with the number on the LR, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE] immediately. The consignee should note the seal condition on the POD and do a joint count. If tampering happened in transit, an FIR and insurance survey may be needed.

question: What is transhipment and when does it happen?
alternate_questions: Transhipment meaning|Maal dusri gaadi me shift|Goods shifted to another truck|ट्रांसशिपमेंट क्या होता है|माल दूसरी गाड़ी में बदलना|गाड़ी बदलनी पड़ी
answer_en: Transhipment is shifting cargo from one vehicle to another during the trip, usually because of a major breakdown or accident. RoadExpress arranges a replacement truck, supervises the shift with photos and a fresh count, updates the LR with the new vehicle number, and informs the consignor and consignee.
answer_hi: ट्रांसशिपमेंट का मतलब है ट्रिप के दौरान माल को एक गाड़ी से दूसरी गाड़ी में बदलना, आम तौर पर बड़े ब्रेकडाउन या दुर्घटना की वजह से। रोडएक्सप्रेस दूसरी गाड़ी लगाता है, फोटो और नई गिनती के साथ माल बदलवाता है, LR में नया गाड़ी नंबर अपडेट करता है, और भेजने वाले और पाने वाले को सूचित करता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, transhipment matlab raste me maal ek gaadi se dusri gaadi me shift karna, jab gaadi bilkul kharab ho jaye ya accident ho. RoadExpress dusri gaadi lagata hai, photo aur ginti ke saath maal badalwata hai, bilty me naya gaadi number daalta hai, aur dono party ko batata hai.
answer: Transhipment is shifting cargo from one vehicle to another during the trip, usually because of a major breakdown or accident. RoadExpress arranges a replacement truck, supervises the shift with photos and a fresh count, updates the LR with the new vehicle number, and informs the consignor and consignee.

question: I'm not receiving the OTP to log into the Partner App. What should I do?
alternate_questions: OTP nahi aa raha|App login problem|Can't log in to partner app|OTP नहीं आ रहा|ऐप में लॉगिन नहीं हो रहा|पार्टनर ऐप खुल नहीं रहा
answer_en: Check network signal, make sure you're using the registered mobile number, and wait a minute before tapping Resend. Clear the app cache or update the app from the Play Store. If it still fails, contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] from your registered number.
answer_hi: नेटवर्क सिग्नल जांचें, पक्का करें कि रजिस्टर्ड मोबाइल नंबर डाल रहे हैं, और Resend दबाने से पहले एक मिनट रुकें। ऐप का कैश साफ करें या Play Store से ऐप अपडेट करें। फिर भी न हो तो रजिस्टर्ड नंबर से [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, network dekho, wahi number daalo jo register hai, aur Resend dabane se pehle ek minute ruko. App ka cache saaf karo ya Play Store se update karo. Phir bhi na ho to registered number se [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo.
answer: Check network signal, make sure you're using the registered mobile number, and wait a minute before tapping Resend. Clear the app cache or update the app from the Play Store. If it still fails, contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] from your registered number.

question: Can shippers book and manage shipments online?
alternate_questions: Book truck online|Shipper app booking|Online freight booking|ऑनलाइन ट्रक बुक कर सकते हैं क्या|शिपर ऐप से बुकिंग|माल भेजने के लिए ऑनलाइन बुकिंग
answer_en: Yes. Shippers can request quotes, book trucks, track trips live, download LR, e-POD and invoices, and view payment history through the RoadExpress website or shipper app. For help setting up a business account, contact [SUPPORT_EMAIL].
answer_hi: हाँ। शिपर्स रोडएक्सप्रेस वेबसाइट या शिपर ऐप से कोटेशन मांग सकते हैं, गाड़ी बुक कर सकते हैं, ट्रिप लाइव ट्रैक कर सकते हैं, LR, e-POD और इनवॉइस डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं और पेमेंट हिस्ट्री देख सकते हैं। बिज़नेस अकाउंट बनाने में मदद के लिए [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Haan bhai, website ya shipper app se rate maango, gaadi book karo, live tracking dekho, bilty, e-POD aur bill download karo, payment ka hisaab bhi dekho. Business account banwana ho to [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe likho.
answer: Yes. Shippers can request quotes, book trucks, track trips live, download LR, e-POD and invoices, and view payment history through the RoadExpress website or shipper app. For help setting up a business account, contact [SUPPORT_EMAIL].

question: How does AI route optimisation in the app help me?
alternate_questions: Route optimization feature|Best route suggestion|Fuel saving route|ऐप में सबसे अच्छा रास्ता कैसे दिखता है|रूट ऑप्टिमाइज़ेशन क्या है|डीज़ल बचाने वाला रास्ता
answer_en: The Partner App suggests efficient routes using real-time traffic, weather and road conditions, which helps reduce fuel cost, tolls and transit time. Drivers should still follow legal truck routes, city no-entry rules and any consignor-specified route.
answer_hi: पार्टनर ऐप रियल-टाइम ट्रैफिक, मौसम और सड़क की स्थिति के आधार पर अच्छे रास्ते सुझाता है, जिससे डीज़ल, टोल और समय की बचत होती है। फिर भी ड्राइवर को ट्रकों के लिए कानूनी रास्ते, शहर के नो-एंट्री नियम और भेजने वाले के बताए रास्ते का पालन करना चाहिए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, Partner App traffic, mausam aur sadak dekh ke achha rasta batata hai, diesel, toll aur time bachta hai. Par truck ke liye jo legal rasta hai, shehar ki no entry aur party ka bataya rasta, wo zaroor maanna.
answer: The Partner App suggests efficient routes using real-time traffic, weather and road conditions, which helps reduce fuel cost, tolls and transit time. Drivers should still follow legal truck routes, city no-entry rules and any consignor-specified route.

question: How do I escalate if my issue isn't resolved?
alternate_questions: Complaint escalation|Issue not resolved|Senior se baat karni hai|शिकायत आगे कैसे बढ़ाएं|मेरी समस्या हल नहीं हुई|सीनियर से बात करनी है
answer_en: First note the ticket or complaint number from your earlier call. Escalations go to the department head for operations, finance or onboarding as relevant.
answer_hi: पहले अपनी पिछली कॉल का टिकट या शिकायत नंबर नोट करें। अगर [ESCALATION_TAT_HOURS] घंटे में हल न हो, तो टिकट नंबर, ट्रिप ID, गाड़ी नंबर और छोटे विवरण के साथ [ESCALATION_EMAIL] पर ईमेल करें। शिकायत संबंधित विभाग, यानी ऑपरेशंस, फाइनेंस या ऑनबोर्डिंग के प्रमुख तक जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, pehli call ka ticket number likh lo. [ESCALATION_TAT_HOURS] ghante me kaam na ho to ticket number, Trip ID, gaadi number aur chhoti si baat likh ke [ESCALATION_EMAIL] pe bhejo. Shikayat seedha department ke head tak jayegi.
answer: First note the ticket or complaint number from your earlier call. If it isn't resolved within [ESCALATION_TAT_HOURS] hours, email [ESCALATION_EMAIL] with the ticket number, Trip ID, vehicle number and a short description. Escalations go to the department head for operations, finance or onboarding as relevant.

question: What does katoti mean?
alternate_questions: Katoti meaning|What is katoti in transport|Katoti kya hoti hai|कटौती का मतलब क्या है|ट्रांसपोर्ट में कटौती क्या होती है|कटौती किसे कहते हैं
answer_en: Katoti is trucker slang for any deduction from the agreed freight, such as TDS, shortage or damage, late delivery penalty, or advance already paid. At RoadExpress, every katoti must be documented and shown item by item in your settlement voucher.
answer_hi: कटौती ट्रक वालों की भाषा में तय भाड़े से होने वाली किसी भी कटौती को कहते हैं, जैसे TDS, कमी या नुकसान, देर की पेनल्टी, या पहले दिया गया एडवांस। रोडएक्सप्रेस में हर कटौती का सबूत होना ज़रूरी है और वह आपके सेटलमेंट वाउचर में एक-एक करके दिखाई जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, katoti matlab bhade me se jo bhi kata: TDS, shortage, toot-phoot, late ki penalty ya pehle mila advance. RoadExpress me har katoti ka saboot hota hai aur voucher me ek-ek karke dikhti hai.
answer: Katoti is trucker slang for any deduction from the agreed freight, such as TDS, shortage or damage, late delivery penalty, or advance already paid. At RoadExpress, every katoti must be documented and shown item by item in your settlement voucher.

question: What is a kanta parchi?
alternate_questions: Kanta parchi meaning|Weighbridge slip|What is dharam kanta|कांटा पर्ची क्या होती है|धर्म कांटा पर्ची|वज़न की पर्ची
answer_en: A kanta parchi is the weighbridge slip showing the truck's gross weight, tare weight and net cargo weight, usually taken at a dharam kanta (public weighbridge). Keep the loading and unloading slips, because they prove weight consistency in shortage disputes and show you weren't overloaded.
answer_hi: कांटा पर्ची वज़न कांटे की पर्ची है जिसमें गाड़ी का कुल वज़न, खाली वज़न और माल का शुद्ध वज़न लिखा होता है, आम तौर पर धर्म कांटे पर ली जाती है। लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग दोनों की पर्ची संभाल कर रखें, क्योंकि कमी के विवाद में ये वज़न बराबर होने का सबूत हैं और यह भी दिखाती हैं कि गाड़ी ओवरलोड नहीं थी।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kanta parchi matlab dharam kante ki parchi, jisme gaadi ka bhara wazan, khaali wazan aur maal ka wazan likha hota hai. Loading aur unloading dono ki parchi sambhal ke rakho, shortage ke jhagde me yahi saboot hai aur overload nahi tha ye bhi dikhata hai.
answer: A kanta parchi is the weighbridge slip showing the truck's gross weight, tare weight and net cargo weight, usually taken at a dharam kanta (public weighbridge). Keep the loading and unloading slips, because they prove weight consistency in shortage disputes and show you weren't overloaded.

question: What do hamali, khalasi and tirpal mean?
alternate_questions: Hamali meaning|Who is khalasi|Tirpal meaning|हमाली क्या होती है|खलासी कौन होता है|तिरपाल का मतलब
answer_en: Hamali is the labour charge for loading or unloading goods, paid to porters or hamals. A khalasi is the driver's helper or cleaner who assists with loading, tying tarpaulins and the journey. Tirpal is the tarpaulin sheet used to cover goods on open-body trucks to protect them from rain and dust.
answer_hi: हमाली माल चढ़ाने या उतारने की मज़दूरी है, जो हम्मालों को दी जाती है। खलासी ड्राइवर का सहायक या क्लीनर होता है जो लोडिंग, तिरपाल बांधने और सफर में मदद करता है। तिरपाल वह चादर है जिससे ओपन बॉडी गाड़ी में माल को बारिश और धूल से बचाने के लिए ढका जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, hamali matlab maal chadhane-utaarne ki mazdoori. Khalasi matlab driver ka helper ya cleaner jo loading, tirpal baandhne aur raste me madad karta hai. Tirpal matlab wo chadar jisse open gaadi me maal dhakte hain, baarish aur dhool se bachane ke liye.
answer: Hamali is the labour charge for loading or unloading goods, paid to porters or hamals. A khalasi is the driver's helper or cleaner who assists with loading, tying tarpaulins and the journey. Tirpal is the tarpaulin sheet used to cover goods on open-body trucks to protect them from rain and dust.

question: Who pays the loading labour (hamali) at the pickup point?
alternate_questions: Loading hamali kaun dega|Who pays loading charges|Loading labour cost at factory|लोडिंग की हमाली कौन देगा|लोडिंग मज़दूरी किसकी ज़िम्मेदारी|फैक्ट्री पर माल चढ़ाने का पैसा कौन देगा
answer_en: Unless the booking says otherwise, loading labour at the pickup point is arranged and paid by the consignor. If the driver is asked to pay, he should take an official receipt and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before paying, so the amount can be verified and reimbursed as per the agreement.
answer_hi: जब तक बुकिंग में अलग न लिखा हो, पिकअप पॉइंट पर लोडिंग की मज़दूरी भेजने वाला लगाता और देता है। अगर ड्राइवर से पैसा मांगा जाए, तो देने से पहले [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं और आधिकारिक रसीद लें, ताकि एग्रीमेंट के अनुसार जांचकर पैसा लौटाया जा सके।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, booking me alag na likha ho to maal chadhane ki hamali party (bhejne wala) deti hai. Driver se maange to dene se pehle [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do aur pakki parchi le lo, agreement ke hisaab se paisa wapas mil jayega.
answer: Unless the booking says otherwise, loading labour at the pickup point is arranged and paid by the consignor. If the driver is asked to pay, he should take an official receipt and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before paying, so the amount can be verified and reimbursed as per the agreement.

question: The factory isn't letting my truck inside and it's waiting outside the gate. How do I prove reporting time?
alternate_questions: Gaadi gate ke bahar khadi hai|Reporting proof outside factory|Truck not allowed inside plant|गाड़ी फैक्ट्री के बाहर खड़ी है|अंदर नहीं घुसने दे रहे|रिपोर्टिंग का सबूत कैसे दें
answer_en: Ask the gate security to write the arrival time on your LR or a gate register and stamp it. Also take a timestamped photo of the truck at the gate and keep the driver app on so GPS records the location. Send these to [SUPPORT_PHONE]; the waiting time counts toward detention once the free period ends.
answer_hi: गेट सिक्योरिटी से अपनी LR या गेट रजिस्टर पर पहुँचने का समय लिखवाकर मोहर लगवाएं। गेट पर खड़ी गाड़ी की समय वाली फोटो भी लें और ड्राइवर ऐप चालू रखें ताकि GPS लोकेशन दर्ज हो। ये सब [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर भेजें; छूट का समय खत्म होने के बाद इंतज़ार का समय डिटेंशन में गिना जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gate wale se bilty ya register pe pahunchne ka time likhwa ke mohar lagwao. Gate pe khadi gaadi ki photo kheencho aur driver app on rakho taaki GPS me location aaye. Sab [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bhejo, free time ke baad ka intezaar detention me judega.
answer: Ask the gate security to write the arrival time on your LR or a gate register and stamp it. Also take a timestamped photo of the truck at the gate and keep the driver app on so GPS records the location. Send these to [SUPPORT_PHONE]; the waiting time counts toward detention once the free period ends.

question: What should the driver do if the cargo packaging is weak or damaged at loading?
alternate_questions: Packing kharab hai|Damaged cartons at loading|Weak packaging what to do|पैकिंग कमज़ोर है क्या करें|लोडिंग पर कार्टन फटे हुए हैं|खराब पैकिंग का माल
answer_en: Point it out to the consignor before loading and ask for repacking. If they still load it, get a remark such as packing damaged or said to contain written on the LR and loading slip, and take photos. This protects the carrier from damage katoti later. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] for high-value cargo.
answer_hi: लोडिंग से पहले भेजने वाले को बताएं और दोबारा पैकिंग करवाने को कहें। अगर फिर भी माल चढ़ाया जाए, तो LR और लोडिंग स्लिप पर पैकिंग खराब जैसी टिप्पणी लिखवाएं और फोटो लें। इससे बाद में नुकसान की कटौती से गाड़ी मालिक बचता है। कीमती माल हो तो [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, packing kamzor ya phati ho to chadhane se pehle party ko bolo, dobara pack karwao. Phir bhi chadhaye to bilty aur loading slip pe 'packing kharab' likhwao aur photo kheencho. Isse baad me toot-phoot ki katoti se bachoge. Mehnga maal ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do.
answer: Point it out to the consignor before loading and ask for repacking. If they still load it, get a remark such as packing damaged or said to contain written on the LR and loading slip, and take photos. This protects the carrier from damage katoti later. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] for high-value cargo.

question: What if the package count doesn't match the invoice at loading?
alternate_questions: Nag kam hain|Count mismatch at loading|Packages less than bill|नग कम हैं|बिल से कम पेटी चढ़ी|लोडिंग पर गिनती नहीं मिल रही
answer_en: The driver should count the packages himself and sign the LR only for the actual count. If there's a mismatch, get the correct count written on the LR and loading slip, and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before departure. Never sign for packages you haven't counted, because the carrier is held responsible for shortage at delivery.
answer_hi: ड्राइवर खुद पैकेट गिने और LR पर केवल असली गिनती के लिए साइन करे। गिनती में फर्क हो तो LR और लोडिंग स्लिप पर सही गिनती लिखवाएं और गाड़ी निकलने से पहले [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं। बिना गिने पैकेट के लिए कभी साइन न करें, क्योंकि डिलीवरी पर कमी की ज़िम्मेदारी गाड़ी मालिक की होती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, nag driver khud gine aur bilty pe utne hi ka sign kare jitne chadhe. Bill se kam hain to sahi ginti bilty aur loading slip pe likhwao aur nikalne se pehle [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao. Bina gine sign mat karna, warna utarte waqt shortage ki katoti aap pe aayegi.
answer: The driver should count the packages himself and sign the LR only for the actual count. If there's a mismatch, get the correct count written on the LR and loading slip, and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] before departure. question: How should heavy machinery, steel coils or long items be secured?

answer_en: Use a trailer or vehicle rated for the weight, place heavy items over the axles, use wooden chocks or cradles for coils and round items, and secure with chains or rated belts rather than only ropes. answer_hi: वज़न के हिसाब से सही ट्रेलर या गाड़ी लें, भारी सामान एक्सल के ऊपर रखें, कॉइल और गोल सामान के लिए लकड़ी के गुटके या पालना लगाएं, और सिर्फ रस्सी की जगह चेन या मज़बूत बेल्ट से बांधें। पहले [RECHECK_KM] किलोमीटर के बाद और हर स्टॉप पर बंधाई दोबारा जांचें। कमज़ोर बंधाई दुर्घटना और नुकसान के क्लेम की बड़ी वजह है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, wazan ke hisaab se sahi trailer lo, bhaari maal axle ke upar rakho, coil ke neeche lakdi ke gutke lagao, aur sirf rassi nahi, chain ya mazboot belt se baandho. answer: Use a trailer or vehicle rated for the weight, place heavy items over the axles, use wooden chocks or cradles for coils and round items, and secure with chains or rated belts rather than only ropes. answer_hinglish: Bhai, ye godown ki timing pe depend karta hai. Kuch jagah 24 ghante kaam hota hai, kuch sirf din me gaadi lete hain. Booking pe timing bata do taaki gaadi sahi time pe pahunche. Late pahunchi to intezaar agreement ke detention rule ke hisaab se ginega.
answer: It depends on the warehouse's working hours. Many plants and DCs work round the clock, while others accept vehicles only during the day. Share the site's timings at booking so the truck arrives on time. If a truck reaches after hours, the waiting time follows the detention rules in your agreement.

question: The consignee wants the goods delivered to a different address. What should the driver do?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, sirf zubaani baat pe gaadi dusri jagah mat le jaana. [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo, team party se likhit me haan legi, bilty aur e-way bill badlegi, aur extra kilometer ka bhada tay karegi. Bina permission dusre pate pe maal diya to zimmedari aap pe aayegi.
answer: Don't divert on verbal instructions. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] so RoadExpress can get written approval from the consignor, update the LR and e-way bill, and confirm any extra freight for additional distance. Delivering to an unapproved address can make the carrier liable for the goods.

question: What if the truck reaches when the consignee is closed for Sunday or a holiday?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, party band hai to gaadi wahin ya paas me safe jagah khadi karo, ho sake to gate pe pahunchne ka time likhwa lo, aur [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao. Team party se agla unloading time fix karegi. Party band hone ka intezaar detention me record hoga.
answer: Park the truck safely at or near the consignee site, get the gate security to note your arrival time if possible, and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE]. The team confirms the next unloading slot with the consignee. Waiting caused by consignee closure is recorded for detention as per the agreement.

question: How do I complain about a driver's behaviour?

answer: Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] or email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID, vehicle number, time and what happened, plus any photos or recordings. RoadExpress investigates with the fleet owner, and repeated or serious issues lead to the driver or vehicle being blocked from the platform.

question: The driver is asking me for extra money. Should I pay?

answer: No. Don't pay the driver anything beyond what's written in your booking confirmation. All freight, detention and approved extras are settled through RoadExpress. Report the demand to [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID; unauthorised cash demands are treated as a serious violation.

question: How many hours should a driver drive, and are night halts allowed?

answer_en: Drivers should take regular rest breaks and avoid long continuous driving; fatigue is a major cause of highway accidents. Avoid stopping on highway shoulders, and keep the driver app on during halts.
answer_hi: ड्राइवर को नियमित आराम लेना चाहिए और लगातार लंबे समय तक गाड़ी चलाने से बचना चाहिए; थकान हाईवे दुर्घटनाओं की बड़ी वजह है। सुरक्षित, रोशनी वाली जगहों जैसे पार्किंग वाले ढाबे या पेट्रोल पंप पर रात को रुकना ठीक है और यह ETA में जोड़ा जाता है। हाईवे के किनारे रुकने से बचें, और रुकते समय भी ड्राइवर ऐप चालू रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, driver thoda-thoda aaram karta rahe, lagatar bahut der gaadi na chalaye, neend me hi accident hote hain. Raat ko roshni wale dhaabe ya petrol pump pe rukna theek hai, ETA me ye juda hota hai. Highway ke kinare gaadi mat rokna, aur rukte waqt bhi app on rakhna.
answer: Drivers should take regular rest breaks and avoid long continuous driving; fatigue is a major cause of highway accidents. Planned night halts at safe, lit places such as dhabas with parking or fuel stations are fine and are factored into the ETA. Avoid stopping on highway shoulders, and keep the driver app on during halts.

question: What should I do if FASTag balance is low or the tag isn't working?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, har trip se pehle FASTag me balance daal ke rakho, bina chalte tag ke toll pe zyada paisa katta hai. Balance hai phir bhi tag nahi chala to toll wale se raseed lo aur FASTag wale bank me complaint karo. Toll kaun bharega ye agreement pe depend karta hai.
answer: Keep enough FASTag balance before every trip, because vehicles without a valid working tag are charged a higher toll at plazas. If the tag fails to read despite balance, ask the toll staff for a receipt and raise a complaint with your FASTag issuing bank. Toll responsibility depends on your freight agreement.

question: What happens at state border check posts during interstate trips?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, GST ke baad border ke naake zyada tar hat gaye, par mobile squad, RTO ya police abhi bhi e-way bill, bill, bilty, permit aur gaadi ke kagaz check karte hain. Sab kagaz tayyar rakho aur e-way bill me sahi gaadi number ho. Bina wajah roka to Trip ID leke [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo.
answer: Since GST, most state border tax barriers have been removed, but mobile squads and transport or police checks still verify the e-way bill, invoice, LR, permit and vehicle documents. Keep all papers ready and the e-way bill updated with the correct vehicle number. If held without valid reason, call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with your Trip ID.

question: What happens during transport strikes, chakka jam or festival disruptions?

answer_hi: कंट्रोल सेंटर हड़ताल, बंद और त्योहार की पाबंदियों पर नज़र रखता है और ड्राइवरों को आवाजाही शुरू होने तक सुरक्षित जगह रुकने की सलाह देता है। हड़ताल या अन्य अप्रत्याशित घटनाओं से हुई देरी दर्ज की जाती है और आम तौर पर इस पर देर की पेनल्टी नहीं लगती। शिपर्स को ऐप में नया ETA बताया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chakka jam, bandh ya tyohaar ki rok ho to control room batata hai kahan safe jagah rukna hai jab tak rasta na khule. Aisi wajah se late hua to record me jaata hai aur aam taur pe late ki katoti nahi lagti. Party ko app me naya ETA dikh jata hai.
answer: The control centre tracks strikes, bandhs and festival restrictions and advises drivers to halt at safe locations until movement resumes. Delays due to strikes or other force majeure events are recorded and normally don't attract late delivery penalties. Shippers are updated on revised ETAs through the app.

question: What should be done if a route is closed due to floods, landslides or bad weather?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, safe jagah gaadi roko aur [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo. Team dusra rasta dekhegi, dono party ko batayegi, aur ETA aur e-way bill ka time badhwa degi. Paani bhari sadak ya band ghat se gaadi mat nikalna. Mausam ki wajah se late hua to aapki galti nahi maani jayegi.
answer: Stop at a safe place and call [SUPPORT_PHONE]. The team checks alternate routes, informs the consignor and consignee, and updates the ETA and e-way bill validity if needed. answer_hinglish: Bhai, no entry me ghusna, tez chalana ya kagaz na hona, driver ki galti ka challan gaadi maalik ko hi bharna hota hai. Agar party ne likhit me andar bulaya tha to wo saboot [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bhejo, check karenge.
