answer_hi: पाने वाले को भेजने वाले से अपने पेमेंट की समस्या के कारण आपकी POD नहीं रोकनी चाहिए। रोके तो गाड़ी परिसर में रखें, उतरे माल और गेट पास की फोटो लें और [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें। कमर्शियल टीम पाने वाले से बात करती है ताकि गाड़ी ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा न रुके।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, party ko apne payment ke jhagde me aapki POD nahi rokni chahiye. Roke to gaadi wahin rakho, utre maal aur gate pass ki photo lo aur [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo. Team party se baat karegi taaki gaadi zyada der na ruke.
answer: A consignee shouldn't hold your POD because of its own payment issues with the consignor. If it does, keep the truck at the premises, photograph the unloaded goods and gate pass, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE]. The commercial team escalates with the consignee so the vehicle isn't held longer than necessary.

question: What if the consignee asks me to take the goods back after I've unloaded?
alternate_questions: Maal utarne ke baad wapas lene ko bola|Goods returned after unloading|Consignee wants return after delivery|माल उतरने के बाद वापस ले जाने को कहा|डिलीवरी के बाद वापसी|पार्टी माल वापस मांग रही है
answer_en: Don't take goods back without written instructions from the consignor or RoadExpress. Return movement is a separate trip with its own LR, e-way bill and freight. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE], and wait for the instruction and revised documents before loading anything again.
answer_hi: भेजने वाले या रोडएक्सप्रेस के लिखित निर्देश के बिना माल वापस न लें। वापसी की ढुलाई अलग ट्रिप है जिसका अपना LR, ई-वे बिल और भाड़ा होता है। [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें, और दोबारा कुछ भी लादने से पहले निर्देश और नए कागज़ का इंतज़ार करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bina likhit order ke maal wapas mat lena. Wapsi ki trip alag hoti hai, uski alag bilty, e-way bill aur bhada. [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo aur naya order aur kagaz aane ke baad hi kuch dobara chadhana.
answer: Don't take goods back without written instructions from the consignor or RoadExpress. Return movement is a separate trip with its own LR, e-way bill and freight. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE], and wait for the instruction and revised documents before loading anything again.

question: Which documents does the consignee need to sign when receiving goods?
alternate_questions: Party kis kagaz pe sign karegi|Receiving documents|What to sign at delivery|डिलीवरी पर कौन से कागज़ पर साइन करवाएं|रिसीविंग के कागज़|माल लेते समय पार्टी को क्या देना है
answer_en: Get the consignee's stamp, signature, name, date and receiving time on the LR copy and the invoice or challan copy. Make sure any shortage or damage is written with quantities, and that no vague remarks like goods received in bad condition are added without details. This is your POD.
answer_hi: पाने वाले की मोहर, हस्ताक्षर, नाम, तारीख और माल लेने का समय LR की कॉपी और इनवॉइस या चालान की कॉपी पर लिखवाएं। कमी या नुकसान मात्रा के साथ लिखा हो, और माल खराब हालत में मिला जैसी अस्पष्ट टिप्पणी बिना विवरण के न जोड़ी जाए। यही आपकी POD है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, party ki mohar, sign, naam, date aur maal lene ka time bilty ki copy aur bill ya challan ki copy pe likhwao. Shortage ya damage likhna ho to nag ke saath saaf likhwao, 'maal kharab mila' jaisa bina detail ka remark mat likhne do. Yahi aapki POD hai.
answer: Get the consignee's stamp, signature, name, date and receiving time on the LR copy and the invoice or challan copy. Make sure any shortage or damage is written with quantities, and that no vague remarks like goods received in bad condition are added without details. This is your POD.

question: How do I get a clean POD without remarks?
alternate_questions: Clean POD kaise milega|POD bina remark ke|Clear acknowledgement tips|साफ POD कैसे मिलेगी|बिना टिप्पणी की POD|POD पर रिमार्क से कैसे बचें
answer_en: Take photos of cargo condition at loading, avoid overloading, secure packaging, use good tarpaulins, and count and document everything. At delivery, do a joint inspection and ask the consignee to record only factual remarks with quantities. Clean PODs speed up balance payment and avoid disputes.
answer_hi: लोडिंग पर माल की हालत की फोटो लें, ओवरलोडिंग न करें, पैकिंग सुरक्षित रखें, अच्छा तिरपाल इस्तेमाल करें, और सब कुछ गिनकर दर्ज करें। डिलीवरी पर साथ मिलकर जांच करें और पाने वाले से केवल तथ्य वाली, मात्रा के साथ टिप्पणी लिखवाएं। साफ POD से बैलेंस पेमेंट जल्दी होता है और विवाद नहीं होते।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, loading pe maal ki halat ki photo lo, overload mat karo, packing theek rakho, achha tirpal lagao aur sab gin ke likho. Delivery pe party ke saath jaanch karo aur sirf asli baat nag ke saath likhwao. Saaf POD se balance jaldi aata hai aur jhagda nahi hota.
answer: Take photos of cargo condition at loading, avoid overloading, secure packaging, use good tarpaulins, and count and document everything. At delivery, do a joint inspection and ask the consignee to record only factual remarks with quantities. Clean PODs speed up balance payment and avoid disputes.

question: What happens if the POD is rejected or flagged?
alternate_questions: POD reject ho gayi|POD flagged status|POD me kami|POD रिजेक्ट हो गई|POD पर आपत्ति आई|POD में गड़बड़ी
answer_en: The app shows the reason, such as a missing stamp, unclear signature, wrong date, torn pages or vague remarks. Re-upload corrected photos or get the consignee to correct the document, then resubmit. For help, share the Trip ID and LR with [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Balance payment waits until the POD is cleared.
answer_hi: ऐप में कारण दिखता है, जैसे मोहर न होना, हस्ताक्षर साफ न होना, गलत तारीख, फटे पन्ने या अस्पष्ट टिप्पणी। सही फोटो दोबारा अपलोड करें या पाने वाले से दस्तावेज़ ठीक करवाकर फिर जमा करें। मदद के लिए ट्रिप ID और LR [SUPPORT_PHONE] को भेजें। POD क्लियर होने तक बैलेंस पेमेंट रुका रहता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, app me wajah dikhti hai, jaise mohar nahi, sign saaf nahi, galat date, phate pannay ya aspasht remark. Sahi photo dobara daalo ya party se kagaz theek karwa ke phir jama karo. Madad ke liye Trip ID aur bilty number [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko bhejo. POD clear hone tak balance ruka rehta hai.
answer: The app shows the reason, such as a missing stamp, unclear signature, wrong date, torn pages or vague remarks. Re-upload corrected photos or get the consignee to correct the document, then resubmit. For help, share the Trip ID and LR with [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Balance payment waits until the POD is cleared.

question: Can I submit e-POD if the consignee doesn't have a stamp?
alternate_questions: Party ke paas mohar nahi|No stamp consignee|Stamp ke bina POD|पार्टी के पास मोहर नहीं है|बिना मोहर की POD|स्टैम्प नहीं मिल रहा
answer_en: Ask for a signature with the receiver's full name, date, time and ID or phone number, plus the gate pass or unloading slip, and a photo of the unloaded goods. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] about the missing stamp so the team can verify with the consignee. For businesses, a stamp is strongly preferred.
answer_hi: पाने वाले से पूरे नाम, तारीख, समय और पहचान या फोन नंबर के साथ हस्ताक्षर लें, साथ में गेट पास या अनलोडिंग स्लिप और उतरे माल की फोटो रखें। मोहर न होने की सूचना [SUPPORT_PHONE] को दें ताकि टीम पाने वाले से पुष्टि कर सके। व्यावसायिक पार्टी के लिए मोहर ज़रूरी मानी जाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, mohar na ho to receiver se poora naam, date, time aur phone ya ID ke saath sign lo, saath me gate pass ya unloading slip aur utre maal ki photo. Mohar na hone ki baat [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao, team party se confirm kar legi. Business party ho to mohar hi theek rehti hai.
answer: Ask for a signature with the receiver's full name, date, time and ID or phone number, plus the gate pass or unloading slip, and a photo of the unloaded goods. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] about the missing stamp so the team can verify with the consignee. For businesses, a stamp is strongly preferred.

question: How do I reach the right person for my issue?
alternate_questions: Kisse baat karni hai|Who to contact for payment|Right department for my problem|अपनी समस्या के लिए किससे बात करें|पेमेंट के लिए किसे कॉल करें|सही अधिकारी कौन है
answer_en: For trip-level issues like loading, unloading, detention, POD and breakdowns, contact the Operations team at [OPERATIONS_CONTACT]. For payments, advances, TDS and deductions, contact Finance at [FINANCE_CONTACT]. For onboarding, KYC and fleet contracts, contact Supply at [SUPPLY_CONTACT]. For shipper contracts and bookings, contact Sales at [SALES_CONTACT].
answer_hi: लोडिंग, अनलोडिंग, डिटेंशन, POD और ब्रेकडाउन जैसी ट्रिप की समस्याओं के लिए ऑपरेशंस टीम से [OPERATIONS_CONTACT] पर संपर्क करें। पेमेंट, एडवांस, TDS और कटौती के लिए फाइनेंस से [FINANCE_CONTACT] पर। ऑनबोर्डिंग, KYC और फ्लीट कॉन्ट्रैक्ट के लिए सप्लाई से [SUPPLY_CONTACT] पर। शिपर कॉन्ट्रैक्ट और बुकिंग के लिए सेल्स से [SALES_CONTACT] पर।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, loading, unloading, detention, POD ya breakdown ho to Operations se [OPERATIONS_CONTACT] pe baat karo. Payment, advance, TDS ya katoti ho to Finance se [FINANCE_CONTACT] pe. Onboarding, KYC ya fleet contract ho to Supply se [SUPPLY_CONTACT] pe. Shipper contract ya booking ho to Sales se [SALES_CONTACT] pe.
answer: For trip-level issues like loading, unloading, detention, POD and breakdowns, contact the Operations team at [OPERATIONS_CONTACT]. For payments, advances, TDS and deductions, contact Finance at [FINANCE_CONTACT]. For onboarding, KYC and fleet contracts, contact Supply at [SUPPLY_CONTACT]. For shipper contracts and bookings, contact Sales at [SALES_CONTACT].

question: What departments does RoadExpress have and what does each handle?
alternate_questions: RoadExpress departments|Which team handles what|Department responsibilities|रोडएक्सप्रेस में कौन-कौन से विभाग हैं|कौन सा विभाग क्या देखता है|टीमें और उनका काम
answer_en: Operations handles live tracking, loading, unloading, detention and POD processing. Finance handles advances, balance settlements, diesel cards and TDS. Supply handles fleet onboarding, KYC verification and carrier contracts. Sales handles shipper enterprise contracts and lane pricing.
answer_hi: ऑपरेशंस लाइव ट्रैकिंग, लोडिंग, अनलोडिंग, डिटेंशन और POD प्रोसेसिंग देखता है। फाइनेंस एडवांस, बैलेंस सेटलमेंट, डीज़ल कार्ड और TDS संभालता है। सप्लाई फ्लीट ऑनबोर्डिंग, KYC जांच और कैरियर कॉन्ट्रैक्ट संभालता है। सेल्स शिपर के एंटरप्राइज़ कॉन्ट्रैक्ट और लेन प्राइसिंग देखता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, Operations live tracking, loading-unloading, detention aur POD dekhta hai. Finance advance, balance, diesel card aur TDS. Supply gaadi attach, KYC aur carrier contract. Sales shipper ke bade contract aur route ka rate.
answer: Operations handles live tracking, loading, unloading, detention and POD processing. Finance handles advances, balance settlements, diesel cards and TDS. Supply handles fleet onboarding, KYC verification and carrier contracts. Sales handles shipper enterprise contracts and lane pricing.

question: How do I give feedback or a suggestion about RoadExpress?
alternate_questions: Feedback dena hai|Suggestion for improvement|Rate my experience|सुझाव कैसे दें|फीडबैक देना है|अनुभव के बारे में बताना है
answer_en: Share feedback from the app's Help or Feedback section, or email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with your suggestion. You can also rate trips and provide comments after delivery. Feedback on payments, process, app issues and driver behaviour helps improve the service.
answer_hi: ऐप के Help या Feedback सेक्शन से फीडबैक दें, या अपने सुझाव के साथ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर ईमेल करें। डिलीवरी के बाद ट्रिप को रेटिंग और टिप्पणी भी दे सकते हैं। पेमेंट, प्रक्रिया, ऐप की समस्या और ड्राइवर के व्यवहार पर आपका फीडबैक सेवा सुधारने में मदद करता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, app ke Help ya Feedback section se likh do, ya [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe mail karo. Delivery ke baad trip ko rating aur comment bhi de sakte ho. Payment, process, app ya driver ke baare me aapki baat se service sudharti hai.
answer: Share feedback from the app's Help or Feedback section, or email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with your suggestion. You can also rate trips and provide comments after delivery. Feedback on payments, process, app issues and driver behaviour helps improve the service.

question: What is the process to temporarily deactivate or exit the platform?
alternate_questions: Account band karna hai|Delete my account|Exit from RoadExpress|अकाउंट बंद करना है|प्लेटफॉर्म से बाहर निकलना|अकाउंट डिलीट
answer_en: Complete or hand back any active trips and clear pending settlements, then email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] from your registered email to request deactivation or deletion. Records required by law, such as invoices, TDS and trip data, are retained for the statutory period even after your account is closed.
answer_hi: चल रही ट्रिप पूरी करें या लौटा दें और बकाया सेटलमेंट निपटा लें, फिर अपने रजिस्टर्ड ईमेल से [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर अकाउंट बंद या डिलीट करने का अनुरोध भेजें। कानून के अनुसार ज़रूरी रिकॉर्ड, जैसे इनवॉइस, TDS और ट्रिप डेटा, अकाउंट बंद होने के बाद भी तय अवधि तक रखे जाते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chalti trip poori ya wapas kar do aur pending hisaab nipta lo, phir registered email se [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe account band ya delete ka request bhejo. Kanoon ke hisaab se zaroori record jaise bill, TDS aur trip ka data account band hone ke baad bhi tay samay tak rakha jaata hai.
answer: Complete or hand back any active trips and clear pending settlements, then email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] from your registered email to request deactivation or deletion. Records required by law, such as invoices, TDS and trip data, are retained for the statutory period even after your account is closed.

question: How are accidents and injuries to drivers handled?
alternate_questions: Driver ko chot lagi|Driver injury accident|Driver accident insurance|ड्राइवर घायल हो गया|ड्राइवर का एक्सीडेंट|चोट लगने पर क्या करें
answer_en: Get medical help immediately by calling 112 or 108 and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID and location. The team supports with coordination, arranging replacement vehicle or driver and informing the consignor. Driver injury cover depends on the vehicle owner's insurance and any personal accident policy, so keep policy details handy.
answer_hi: तुरंत 112 या 108 पर कॉल करके चिकित्सा मदद लें और ट्रिप ID और लोकेशन के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं। टीम तालमेल, दूसरी गाड़ी या ड्राइवर का इंतज़ाम और भेजने वाले को सूचना देने में मदद करती है। ड्राइवर की चोट का कवर गाड़ी मालिक के बीमा और किसी व्यक्तिगत दुर्घटना पॉलिसी पर निर्भर करता है, इसलिए पॉलिसी की जानकारी पास रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, turant 112 ya 108 pe call karke ilaaj karwao aur Trip ID aur location ke saath [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao. Team dusri gaadi ya driver ka intezaam karegi aur party ko bata degi. Driver ki chot ka cover gaadi maalik ke insurance aur accident policy pe depend karta hai, policy ki detail paas rakho.
answer: Get medical help immediately by calling 112 or 108 and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID and location. The team supports with coordination, arranging replacement vehicle or driver and informing the consignor. Driver injury cover depends on the vehicle owner's insurance and any personal accident policy, so keep policy details handy.

question: What happens if my truck is seized or detained by authorities?
alternate_questions: Gaadi pakdi gayi|Truck seized by RTO police|Vehicle detained|गाड़ी ज़ब्त हो गई|अधिकारियों ने गाड़ी रोक ली|गाड़ी थाने में खड़ी है
answer_en: Stay calm, cooperate, ask for the reason in writing, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID immediately. The team informs the consignor and consignee. Where the cause is documentation of goods, such as the invoice or e-way bill, the consignor is asked to resolve it; if the cause is vehicle papers or violations, the owner must resolve it.
answer_hi: शांत रहें, सहयोग करें, कारण लिखित में मांगें और तुरंत ट्रिप ID के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें। टीम भेजने और पाने वाले को सूचित करती है। अगर कारण माल के कागज़, जैसे इनवॉइस या ई-वे बिल हैं, तो भेजने वाले से सुलझाने को कहा जाता है; अगर कारण गाड़ी के कागज़ या नियम तोड़ना है, तो मालिक को सुलझाना होगा।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, shaant raho, sahyog karo, wajah likhit me maango aur turant Trip ID leke [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo. Team dono party ko batayegi. Maal ke kagaz (bill ya e-way bill) ki dikkat ho to party ko solve karna hota hai, gaadi ke kagaz ya niyam tode ho to gaadi maalik ko.
answer: Stay calm, cooperate, ask for the reason in writing, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID immediately. The team informs the consignor and consignee. Where the cause is documentation of goods, such as the invoice or e-way bill, the consignor is asked to resolve it; if the cause is vehicle papers or violations, the owner must resolve it.

question: What is a trip advance deposit or security amount, and is any taken from carriers?
alternate_questions: Security deposit lagta hai kya|Registration fee for carrier|Load ke liye paise dene hain kya|क्या सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट देना पड़ता है|रजिस्ट्रेशन फीस|लोड के बदले पैसे
answer_en: RoadExpress does not charge carriers a registration fee or take payment to give loads. Any deposit, if applicable to specific contracts, is documented in writing and paid through official channels only. Never pay anyone claiming to be from RoadExpress for loads; report such requests to [SUPPORT_PHONE].
answer_hi: रोडएक्सप्रेस कैरियर्स से रजिस्ट्रेशन फीस नहीं लेता और लोड देने के बदले पैसे नहीं लेता। किसी खास कॉन्ट्रैक्ट पर कोई जमा राशि लागू हो तो वह लिखित में होती है और केवल आधिकारिक माध्यम से ही ली जाती है। रोडएक्सप्रेस का नाम लेकर लोड के बदले पैसे मांगने वाले को कभी पैसे न दें; ऐसी मांग की शिकायत [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, RoadExpress gaadi walon se registration fees ya load ke badle paisa nahi leta. Kisi khaas contract me deposit ho to wo likhit me hoga aur sirf official tareeke se jayega. RoadExpress ke naam pe load ke liye koi paise maange to mat dena, [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe report karo.
answer: RoadExpress does not charge carriers a registration fee or take payment to give loads. Any deposit, if applicable to specific contracts, is documented in writing and paid through official channels only. Never pay anyone claiming to be from RoadExpress for loads; report such requests to [SUPPORT_PHONE].

question: How can I trust that RoadExpress will pay me on time?
alternate_questions: Payment ka bharosa|Is RoadExpress payment safe|Time pe paisa milega kya|समय पर पेमेंट का भरोसा कैसे|पेमेंट सुरक्षित है क्या|पैसा डूबेगा तो नहीं
answer_en: RoadExpress follows defined payment timelines: advance after loading and balance after POD verification, with every payment shown in the app with a UTR and settlement voucher. Fast, clean documents help you get paid quickly. If there's a delay, escalate through [SUPPORT_PHONE] or [ESCALATION_EMAIL].
answer_hi: रोडएक्सप्रेस तय पेमेंट समय का पालन करता है: लोडिंग के बाद एडवांस और POD जांच के बाद बैलेंस, और हर पेमेंट UTR और सेटलमेंट वाउचर के साथ ऐप में दिखता है। तेज़ और साफ कागज़ से आपका पैसा जल्दी आता है। देरी हो तो [SUPPORT_PHONE] या [ESCALATION_EMAIL] से आगे बढ़ाएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, RoadExpress ka tay time hai: loading ke baad advance aur POD check ke baad balance, aur har payment app me UTR aur voucher ke saath dikhta hai. Saaf aur jaldi kagaz doge to paisa jaldi aayega. Der ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] ya [ESCALATION_EMAIL] pe aage badhao.
answer: RoadExpress follows defined payment timelines: advance after loading and balance after POD verification, with every payment shown in the app with a UTR and settlement voucher. Fast, clean documents help you get paid quickly. If there's a delay, escalate through [SUPPORT_PHONE] or [ESCALATION_EMAIL].

question: How do I get my balance faster?
alternate_questions: Balance jaldi kaise aaye|Faster payment tips|Payment speed up|बैलेंस जल्दी कैसे मिले|पेमेंट जल्दी कैसे आएगा|भुगतान तेज़ करने के तरीके
answer_en: Upload a clear e-POD within [EPOD_UPLOAD_HOURS] hours of unloading, send the original POD quickly with the LR number on the envelope, keep stamps and remarks clean, keep bank details and PAN correct, and submit GST invoice if registered. Any missing detail pauses settlement.
answer_hi: अनलोडिंग के [EPOD_UPLOAD_HOURS] घंटे के अंदर साफ e-POD अपलोड करें, लिफाफे पर LR नंबर लिखकर ओरिजिनल POD जल्दी भेजें, मोहर और टिप्पणी साफ रखवाएं, बैंक विवरण और PAN सही रखें, और GST रजिस्टर्ड हों तो GST इनवॉइस जमा करें। कोई भी कमी सेटलमेंट रोक देती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi khaali hone ke [EPOD_UPLOAD_HOURS] ghante me saaf e-POD daalo, original POD jaldi bhejo lifafe pe bilty number likh ke, mohar aur remark saaf rakho, bank detail aur PAN sahi rakho, GST ho to GST bill do. Koi bhi kami hui to hisaab ruk jaata hai.
answer: Upload a clear e-POD within [EPOD_UPLOAD_HOURS] hours of unloading, send the original POD quickly with the LR number on the envelope, keep stamps and remarks clean, keep bank details and PAN correct, and submit GST invoice if registered. Any missing detail pauses settlement.

question: Why was my payment placed on hold?
alternate_questions: Payment hold kyun hai|Settlement on hold|Paisa ruka hua hai|मेरा पेमेंट होल्ड पर क्यों है|सेटलमेंट रुका हुआ है|पेमेंट अटका क्यों
answer_en: Holds usually occur due to an unverified or flagged POD, pending shortage or damage claim, bank detail mismatch, missing PAN or invoice, or an open dispute. The settlement page or [SUPPORT_PHONE] can tell you the exact reason. Resolve the item and payment resumes in the next batch.
answer_hi: होल्ड आम तौर पर असत्यापित या आपत्ति वाली POD, लंबित कमी या नुकसान के क्लेम, बैंक विवरण में गड़बड़ी, PAN या इनवॉइस की कमी, या चल रहे विवाद की वजह से होता है। सटीक कारण सेटलमेंट पेज या [SUPPORT_PHONE] से पता चलेगा। वह बात सुलझाएं तो पेमेंट अगले बैच में शुरू हो जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, payment aksar tab rukta hai jab POD me kami ho, shortage ya damage ka claim baaki ho, bank detail galat ho, PAN ya bill nahi diya ho ya koi dispute chal raha ho. Exact wajah settlement page ya [SUPPORT_PHONE] se pata chalegi. Wo theek karo, agle batch me paisa chala jayega.
answer: Holds usually occur due to an unverified or flagged POD, pending shortage or damage claim, bank detail mismatch, missing PAN or invoice, or an open dispute. The settlement page or [SUPPORT_PHONE] can tell you the exact reason. Resolve the item and payment resumes in the next batch.

question: Can I get an advance on a trip where the destination is very far?
alternate_questions: Door ke trip pe zyada advance|Long haul advance|Advance for long distance|लंबी दूरी पर एडवांस ज़्यादा मिलेगा क्या|दूर के रूट का एडवांस|लॉन्ग हॉल एडवांस
answer_en: Advance is based on the agreed freight and lane terms, generally [ADVANCE_PERCENT]. For very long routes, a larger portion may be given as a diesel card so fuel needs are covered on the way. Ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] about advance structure for your lane before accepting the load.
answer_hi: एडवांस तय भाड़े और रूट की शर्तों पर आधारित होता है, आम तौर पर [ADVANCE_PERCENT]। बहुत लंबे रूट पर बड़ा हिस्सा डीज़ल कार्ड में दिया जा सकता है ताकि रास्ते में ईंधन का खर्च निकल जाए। लोड स्वीकार करने से पहले अपने रूट के एडवांस ढांचे के बारे में [SUPPORT_PHONE] से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, advance tay bhade aur route ki shart pe hota hai, aam taur pe [ADVANCE_PERCENT]. Bahut lambe route pe bada hissa diesel card me mil sakta hai taaki raste ka diesel nikal jaye. Load lene se pehle apne route ka advance kaise milega, [SUPPORT_PHONE] se pooch lo.
answer: Advance is based on the agreed freight and lane terms, generally [ADVANCE_PERCENT]. For very long routes, a larger portion may be given as a diesel card so fuel needs are covered on the way. Ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] about advance structure for your lane before accepting the load.

question: Is advance given if the truck loads late at night or on a holiday?
alternate_questions: Raat ko loading advance kab|Holiday loading advance|Advance weekend|रात को लोडिंग पर एडवांस कब|छुट्टी के दिन एडवांस|वीकेंड पर एडवांस
answer_en: Advance is triggered once loading is complete, the signed loading slip is uploaded and checks are passed. IMPS can go any time, but processing depends on the finance desk's operating hours for verification, so late-night or holiday loads may see a short delay. Upload documents immediately after loading.
answer_hi: एडवांस तब जारी होता है जब लोडिंग पूरी हो, साइन की हुई लोडिंग स्लिप अपलोड हो और जांच पास हो जाए। IMPS कभी भी जा सकता है, लेकिन जांच के लिए फाइनेंस डेस्क के काम के समय पर निर्भर होने से रात या छुट्टी की लोडिंग में थोड़ी देरी हो सकती है। लोडिंग के तुरंत बाद कागज़ अपलोड करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, advance tab chalta hai jab loading poori ho, sign wali loading slip upload ho aur check pass ho jaye. IMPS kabhi bhi jaa sakta hai par check finance desk ke time pe hota hai, to raat ya chhutti ki loading me thodi der ho sakti hai. Loading hote hi kagaz upload kar do.
answer: Advance is triggered once loading is complete, the signed loading slip is uploaded and checks are passed. IMPS can go any time, but processing depends on the finance desk's operating hours for verification, so late-night or holiday loads may see a short delay. Upload documents immediately after loading.

question: Can I get an advance for toll and driver expenses separately?
alternate_questions: Toll ka paisa alag|Driver kharcha advance|Expense advance|टोल का पैसा अलग से मिलेगा क्या|ड्राइवर के खर्च का एडवांस|रास्ते के खर्च का पैसा
answer_en: Trip advance is meant to cover fuel, toll and driver expenses. FASTag or toll payments are normally handled by the vehicle owner from the advance, unless your booking states tolls are paid separately or reimbursed. Check the inclusions on your booking confirmation.
answer_hi: ट्रिप एडवांस ईंधन, टोल और ड्राइवर के खर्च को कवर करने के लिए होता है। फास्टैग या टोल का भुगतान आम तौर पर गाड़ी मालिक एडवांस से करता है, जब तक आपकी बुकिंग में न लिखा हो कि टोल अलग से दिया या लौटाया जाएगा। बुकिंग कन्फर्मेशन में शामिल चीज़ें देख लें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, advance isiliye hota hai ki usse diesel, toll aur driver ka kharcha chale. FASTag ya toll aam taur pe gaadi maalik advance se bharta hai, jab tak booking me na likha ho ki toll alag se milega. Booking confirmation me dekh lo.
answer: Trip advance is meant to cover fuel, toll and driver expenses. FASTag or toll payments are normally handled by the vehicle owner from the advance, unless your booking states tolls are paid separately or reimbursed. Check the inclusions on your booking confirmation.

question: What is the difference between shortage and damage?
alternate_questions: Shortage aur damage me fark|Shortage vs damage|Kam maal aur toot-phoot|कमी और नुकसान में क्या फर्क है|शॉर्टेज और डैमेज|माल कम और माल खराब
answer_en: Shortage means fewer packages or less quantity delivered than loaded, such as missing cartons or reduced weight. Damage means goods arrived but are broken, wet, spoiled or otherwise spoiled in condition. Both should be recorded on the POD with details and photos, and both can lead to deductions after verification.
answer_hi: शॉर्टेज का मतलब लादे गए माल से कम पैकेट या कम मात्रा पहुँची, जैसे कार्टन गायब या वज़न कम। डैमेज का मतलब माल पहुँचा लेकिन टूटा, भीगा या किसी और तरह से खराब है। दोनों को विवरण और फोटो के साथ POD पर दर्ज करना चाहिए, और जांच के बाद दोनों पर कटौती हो सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, shortage matlab jitna chadha tha usse kam pahuncha, carton gaayab ya wazan kam. Damage matlab maal pahuncha par toota, bheega ya kharab hai. Dono POD pe detail aur photo ke saath likhwane chahiye, aur check ke baad dono me katoti ho sakti hai.
answer: Shortage means fewer packages or less quantity delivered than loaded, such as missing cartons or reduced weight. Damage means goods arrived but are broken, wet, spoiled or otherwise spoiled in condition. Both should be recorded on the POD with details and photos, and both can lead to deductions after verification.

question: What is a debit note from the customer?
alternate_questions: Debit note kya hota hai|Customer debit note meaning|Party ne debit note bheja|डेबिट नोट क्या होता है|ग्राहक का डेबिट नोट|पार्टी ने नोट काटा
answer_en: A debit note is a document the shipper or consignee raises to claim a deduction for shortage, damage, late delivery or other loss. RoadExpress verifies it against the POD, photos and weighbridge records before passing it to your settlement. If it looks wrong, dispute it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days.
answer_hi: डेबिट नोट वह दस्तावेज़ है जो शिपर या पाने वाला कमी, नुकसान, देर से डिलीवरी या अन्य नुकसान के लिए कटौती मांगने को जारी करता है। रोडएक्सप्रेस इसे POD, फोटो और कांटा रिकॉर्ड से मिलाकर जांचता है और फिर आपके सेटलमेंट में लगाता है। गलत लगे तो [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] दिन के अंदर विवाद करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, debit note wo kagaz hai jo party shortage, toot-phoot ya late delivery ke badle katoti maangne ke liye bhejti hai. RoadExpress POD, photo aur kanta parchi se milake check karta hai aur phir hisaab me lagata hai. Galat lage to [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] din ke andar dispute karo.
answer: A debit note is a document the shipper or consignee raises to claim a deduction for shortage, damage, late delivery or other loss. RoadExpress verifies it against the POD, photos and weighbridge records before passing it to your settlement. If it looks wrong, dispute it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days.

question: What is the maximum a carrier can be charged for shortage or damage?
alternate_questions: Katoti ki limit|Maximum deduction for damage|Carrier liability cap|नुकसान पर अधिकतम कटौती कितनी|कैरियर की ज़िम्मेदारी की सीमा|कितना पैसा कट सकता है
answer_en: Liability follows the contract and LR terms, usually limited to the verified invoice value of the missing or damaged goods, subject to [CARRIER_LIABILITY_LIMIT]. Normal wastage or transit loss allowances may apply to some commodities. Check your agreement, and keep loading photos and clean documents to protect yourself.
answer_hi: ज़िम्मेदारी कॉन्ट्रैक्ट और LR की शर्तों के अनुसार होती है, आम तौर पर गायब या खराब माल के सत्यापित इनवॉइस मूल्य तक, [CARRIER_LIABILITY_LIMIT] के अधीन। कुछ माल पर सामान्य छीजन या ट्रांज़िट हानि की छूट लागू हो सकती है। अपना एग्रीमेंट देखें, और अपने बचाव के लिए लोडिंग की फोटो और साफ कागज़ रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kitna kat sakta hai ye contract aur bilty ki sharton pe hai, aam taur pe gayab ya kharab maal ke bill ki keemat tak, [CARRIER_LIABILITY_LIMIT] ke andar. Kuch maal me thodi chhijan ki chhoot hoti hai. Apna agreement dekho aur bachav ke liye loading ki photo aur saaf kagaz rakho.
answer: Liability follows the contract and LR terms, usually limited to the verified invoice value of the missing or damaged goods, subject to [CARRIER_LIABILITY_LIMIT]. Normal wastage or transit loss allowances may apply to some commodities. Check your agreement, and keep loading photos and clean documents to protect yourself.

question: What is transit wastage or chhijan?
alternate_questions: Chhijan kya hota hai|Transit wastage allowance|Maal me natural loss|छीजन क्या होती है|ट्रांज़िट वेस्टेज|रास्ते में माल कम होना
answer_en: Chhijan or transit wastage is the small natural loss of weight in certain goods during carriage, such as grains, chemicals, salt or liquids, from moisture, handling or evaporation. Contracts may allow a small percentage as acceptable, beyond which shortage claims apply. Check the allowance in your booking.
answer_hi: छीजन या ट्रांज़िट वेस्टेज ढुलाई के दौरान कुछ माल, जैसे अनाज, केमिकल, नमक या तरल, के वज़न में नमी, हैंडलिंग या वाष्पीकरण से होने वाली छोटी स्वाभाविक कमी है। कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में थोड़ा प्रतिशत स्वीकार्य हो सकता है, उससे ऊपर कमी का क्लेम लगता है। अपनी बुकिंग में छूट देखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chhijan matlab raste me kuch maal, jaise anaaj, chemical, namak ya tarl, ka thoda wazan apne aap kam ho jaana, nami ya hawa lagne se. Contract me thoda percent maaf hota hai, usse upar shortage ka claim lagta hai. Apni booking me dekh lo kitna maaf hai.
answer: Chhijan or transit wastage is the small natural loss of weight in certain goods during carriage, such as grains, chemicals, salt or liquids, from moisture, handling or evaporation. Contracts may allow a small percentage as acceptable, beyond which shortage claims apply. Check the allowance in your booking.

question: How are cash on delivery (COD) or collection on delivery shipments handled?
alternate_questions: COD maal kaise hota hai|Cash on delivery truck|Delivery pe paisa lena|कैश ऑन डिलीवरी का माल|डिलीवरी पर पैसा लेना|COD शिपमेंट

answer_hi: जब तक बुकिंग और दस्तावेज़ों में साफ न लिखा हो, ड्राइवर पाने वाले से नकद न ले। डिलीवरी पर वसूली केवल रोडएक्सप्रेस के साथ लिखित व्यवस्था में, रसीद और जमा प्रक्रिया के साथ होती है। लिखित निर्देश के बिना नकद न लें और न रखें; [SUPPORT_PHONE] से पक्का करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, jab tak booking aur kagaz me saaf na likha ho, driver party se naqad paisa na le. Delivery pe paisa lena tabhi hota hai jab RoadExpress se likhit me tay ho, raseed aur jama karne ki prakriya ke saath. Bina likhit order ke cash mat lena, [SUPPORT_PHONE] se confirm kar lo.
answer: Drivers should not collect cash from consignees unless the booking and documents clearly require it. Collection on delivery is only handled under a documented arrangement with RoadExpress, with a receipt and deposit procedure. Never accept or hold cash without written instructions; confirm with [SUPPORT_PHONE].

question: How does RoadExpress verify trucks and drivers?
alternate_questions: Gaadi verify kaise hoti hai|Driver verification process|Verified vehicles meaning|गाड़ी की जांच कैसे होती है|ड्राइवर वेरिफिकेशन|वेरिफाइड गाड़ी का मतलब
answer_en: Vehicles are verified through RC, insurance, fitness certificate and permit checks, and owners through PAN, Aadhaar and bank details. Drivers submit licence and ID, and GPS tracking is mandatory during trips. Ongoing performance, ratings and compliance are monitored to keep the network reliable.
answer_hi: गाड़ियों की जांच RC, बीमा, फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट और परमिट से और मालिकों की PAN, आधार और बैंक विवरण से होती है। ड्राइवर लाइसेंस और पहचान जमा करते हैं, और ट्रिप के दौरान GPS ट्रैकिंग ज़रूरी है। नेटवर्क भरोसेमंद रखने के लिए लगातार प्रदर्शन, रेटिंग और नियमों के पालन की निगरानी होती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ki RC, insurance, fitness aur permit se aur maalik ki PAN, Aadhaar aur bank se jaanch hoti hai. Driver licence aur ID deta hai, aur trip me GPS chalu rehna zaroori hai. Network bharosemand rahe iske liye kaam, rating aur niyam ki nigrani hoti rehti hai.
answer: Vehicles are verified through RC, insurance, fitness certificate and permit checks, and owners through PAN, Aadhaar and bank details. Drivers submit licence and ID, and GPS tracking is mandatory during trips. Ongoing performance, ratings and compliance are monitored to keep the network reliable.

question: Why do shippers choose RoadExpress over traditional transporters or brokers?
alternate_questions: RoadExpress ke fayde|Why use RoadExpress|Broker se behtar kaise|रोडएक्सप्रेस क्यों चुनें|दलाल से बेहतर कैसे|पारंपरिक ट्रांसपोर्टर बनाम रोडएक्सप्रेस

answer_hi: शिपर्स को सत्यापित गाड़ियाँ, पारदर्शी कीमत, लाइव GPS ट्रैकिंग, e-POD, 24/7 सपोर्ट और कई दलालों के पीछे भागने की जगह एक जवाबदेह संपर्क मिलता है। इनवॉइस, POD और पेमेंट का डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड विवाद कम करता है और ऑडिट आसान बनाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, party ko verified gaadi, saaf rate, live tracking, e-POD, 24 ghante support aur ek hi jawabdeh contact milta hai, kai dalaalon ke peeche nahi bhaagna padta. Bill, POD aur payment ka digital record rehta hai to jhagde kam aur audit aasaan.
answer: Shippers get verified vehicles, transparent pricing, live GPS tracking, e-POD, 24/7 support, and a single point of accountability instead of chasing multiple brokers. Digital records for invoices, PODs and payments reduce disputes and make audits easy.

question: Why do truck owners prefer RoadExpress to traditional brokers?
alternate_questions: Gaadi maalik ko fayda|Benefits for fleet owners|Dalaal ke bina load|गाड़ी मालिकों को क्या फायदा|दलाल के बिना सीधा लोड|रोडएक्सप्रेस पार्टनर के लाभ
answer_en: Truck owners see real loads and freight directly in the app, avoid informal munshiana, get quick advances, find return loads to reduce empty running, and receive payment to their own bank account with clear settlement vouchers. Digital records help with accounts and tax.
answer_hi: गाड़ी मालिक ऐप में असली लोड और भाड़ा सीधे देखते हैं, मुंशियाना जैसी बेहिसाब कटौती से बचते हैं, जल्दी एडवांस पाते हैं, वापसी लोड ढूंढकर खाली चलना कम करते हैं और साफ सेटलमेंट वाउचर के साथ अपने बैंक खाते में पैसा पाते हैं। डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड हिसाब और टैक्स में मदद करता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi maalik ko app me asli load aur bhada seedha dikhta hai, munshiana jaisi katoti nahi, advance jaldi, wapsi load mil jaata hai to khaali nahi chalna padta, aur paisa seedha apne khaate me voucher ke saath. Digital hisaab se accounts aur tax bhi aasaan.
answer: Truck owners see real loads and freight directly in the app, avoid informal munshiana, get quick advances, find return loads to reduce empty running, and receive payment to their own bank account with clear settlement vouchers. Digital records help with accounts and tax.

question: What is first-mile pickup and who does it?
alternate_questions: First mile pickup kya hai|Factory se hub tak pickup|Pickup service|फर्स्ट माइल पिकअप क्या है|फैक्ट्री से हब तक माल|माल उठाने की सेवा
answer_en: First-mile pickup moves goods from the consignor's factory, farm, mill or warehouse to a transport hub or directly onto the main line-haul truck. It uses suitable vehicles from the network based on volume and access, such as mini trucks or LCVs for tight locations.
answer_hi: फर्स्ट-माइल पिकअप माल को भेजने वाले की फैक्ट्री, खेत, मिल या गोदाम से ट्रांसपोर्ट हब तक या सीधे मुख्य लाइन-हॉल ट्रक तक पहुँचाता है। मात्रा और पहुँच के हिसाब से नेटवर्क की उपयुक्त गाड़ियाँ लगती हैं, जैसे तंग जगहों के लिए मिनी ट्रक या LCV।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, first-mile pickup matlab party ki factory, khet, mill ya godown se maal uthake hub tak ya seedha badi gaadi tak le jaana. Volume aur jagah ke hisaab se gaadi lagti hai, tang gali ho to chhota haathi ya LCV.
answer: First-mile pickup moves goods from the consignor's factory, farm, mill or warehouse to a transport hub or directly onto the main line-haul truck. It uses suitable vehicles from the network based on volume and access, such as mini trucks or LCVs for tight locations.

question: What is last-mile delivery and which vehicles are used?
alternate_questions: Last mile delivery kya hai|Hub se dukaan tak maal|Final delivery trucks|लास्ट माइल डिलीवरी क्या है|हब से दुकान तक माल|आखिरी डिलीवरी की गाड़ियाँ
answer_en: Last-mile delivery is the final movement from a local hub or warehouse to the dealer, retailer or end customer. Mini trucks, pickups and LCVs are typically used, with multi-drop routes and appointment timings. e-POD is collected at each drop.
answer_hi: लास्ट-माइल डिलीवरी स्थानीय हब या गोदाम से डीलर, रिटेलर या अंतिम ग्राहक तक की आखिरी ढुलाई है। आम तौर पर मिनी ट्रक, पिकअप और LCV इस्तेमाल होते हैं, जिनमें कई जगह उतारने के रूट और अपॉइंटमेंट समय होते हैं। हर डिलीवरी पर e-POD लिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, last-mile matlab local godown se dealer, dukaan ya customer tak aakhri delivery. Chhota haathi, pickup, LCV chalte hain, kai jagah utarte hue, time ke hisaab se. Har jagah ki e-POD li jaati hai.
answer: Last-mile delivery is the final movement from a local hub or warehouse to the dealer, retailer or end customer. Mini trucks, pickups and LCVs are typically used, with multi-drop routes and appointment timings. e-POD is collected at each drop.

question: What is line haul?
alternate_questions: Line haul kya hota hai|Trunk route meaning|Hub to hub transport|लाइन हॉल क्या होता है|हब से हब की ढुलाई|ट्रंक रूट का मतलब
answer_en: Line haul is the long-distance trunk movement of freight between cities, hubs or major warehouses, usually in large vehicles such as 32 ft containers or multi-axle trucks. It forms the main part of the transport chain between first-mile and last-mile.
answer_hi: लाइन हॉल शहरों, हब या बड़े गोदामों के बीच माल की लंबी दूरी की मुख्य ढुलाई है, आम तौर पर 32 फीट कंटेनर या मल्टी-एक्सल ट्रक जैसी बड़ी गाड़ियों में। यह फर्स्ट-माइल और लास्ट-माइल के बीच की मुख्य कड़ी है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, line haul matlab ek shehar se dusre shehar ya hub se hub badi gaadi me lambi doori ka maal, aam taur pe 32 ft container ya multi-axle truck. Ye first-mile aur last-mile ke beech ka sabse bada hissa hai.
answer: Line haul is the long-distance trunk movement of freight between cities, hubs or major warehouses, usually in large vehicles such as 32 ft containers or multi-axle trucks. It forms the main part of the transport chain between first-mile and last-mile.

question: What is a lane?
alternate_questions: Lane ka matlab|What is a freight lane|Lane meaning in transport|लेन का मतलब क्या है|फ्रेट लेन क्या होती है|रूट को लेन क्यों कहते हैं
answer_en: A lane is a specific origin-to-destination route used for pricing and planning, for example Delhi to Mumbai. Rates, demand, transit time and vehicle availability are all lane-specific, which is why quotes differ by lane.
answer_hi: लेन एक खास कहाँ से कहाँ तक का रूट है जिसका इस्तेमाल कीमत और योजना के लिए होता है, जैसे दिल्ली से मुंबई। रेट, मांग, ट्रांज़िट समय और गाड़ी की उपलब्धता सब लेन के हिसाब से होते हैं, इसीलिए कोटेशन लेन के अनुसार अलग होते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, lane matlab ek tay route, jaise Delhi se Mumbai. Rate, demand, kitne din aur gaadi milna, sab lane ke hisaab se alag hota hai, isliye quote lane ke hisaab se badalta hai.
answer: A lane is a specific origin-to-destination route used for pricing and planning, for example Delhi to Mumbai. Rates, demand, transit time and vehicle availability are all lane-specific, which is why quotes differ by lane.

question: What is TAT or turnaround time?
alternate_questions: TAT kya hota hai|Turnaround time meaning|Gaadi ka TAT|TAT का मतलब क्या है|टर्नअराउंड टाइम|ट्रक का TAT
answer_en: TAT (turnaround time) is the total time a truck takes to complete a trip cycle or the agreed time to deliver from loading to unloading. Contracts often set a TAT per lane, and late delivery penalties apply only when the TAT is exceeded without a valid reason.
answer_hi: TAT (टर्नअराउंड टाइम) एक गाड़ी को ट्रिप पूरी करने में लगने वाला कुल समय या लोडिंग से अनलोडिंग तक डिलीवरी का तय समय है। कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में अक्सर हर लेन का TAT तय होता है, और देर की पेनल्टी तभी लगती है जब बिना सही कारण TAT पार हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, TAT matlab gaadi ko trip poori karne me kitna time lagna chahiye, ya loading se unloading tak tay samay. Contract me har lane ka TAT hota hai, aur late ki katoti tabhi lagti hai jab bina wajah TAT paar ho jaye.
answer: TAT (turnaround time) is the total time a truck takes to complete a trip cycle or the agreed time to deliver from loading to unloading. Contracts often set a TAT per lane, and late delivery penalties apply only when the TAT is exceeded without a valid reason.

question: What does GVW or GVWR mean?
alternate_questions: GVW kya hota hai|Gross vehicle weight meaning|Gaadi ka total weight|GVW का मतलब|ग्रॉस व्हीकल वेट|गाड़ी की क्षमता का वज़न
answer_en: GVW (gross vehicle weight) is the maximum total weight of the vehicle including the truck itself, fuel and cargo, as permitted on its RC. Payload is GVW minus the truck's own (unladen) weight. Exceeding GVW is overloading and attracts fines.
answer_hi: GVW (ग्रॉस व्हीकल वेट) गाड़ी का वह अधिकतम कुल वज़न है जो उसकी RC पर अनुमत है, जिसमें ट्रक खुद, ईंधन और माल शामिल है। पेलोड यानी माल की क्षमता GVW में से ट्रक का खुद का (खाली) वज़न घटाकर निकलती है। GVW से ज़्यादा होना ओवरलोडिंग है और जुर्माना लगता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, GVW matlab gaadi ka kul wazan jo RC pe allowed hai, gaadi, diesel aur maal sab milake. Maal ki capacity = GVW minus gaadi ka apna khaali wazan. GVW se upar gaye to overload hai aur challan lagta hai.
answer: GVW (gross vehicle weight) is the maximum total weight of the vehicle including the truck itself, fuel and cargo, as permitted on its RC. Payload is GVW minus the truck's own (unladen) weight. Exceeding GVW is overloading and attracts fines.

question: What are the tonnage ranges for common truck types?

answer_en: Approximate payloads vary by model and legal limits: mini trucks and pickups carry up to a few tonnes, medium trucks around 6 to 10 tonnes, and heavy multi-axle trucks and trailers can carry [HEAVY_TRUCK_PAYLOAD_TONNES] tonnes or more. answer_hinglish: Bhai, kitna maal aayega ye gaadi ke model aur kanooni limit pe depend karta hai: chhota haathi aur pickup kuch ton tak, medium truck lagbhag 6 se 10 ton, aur bhaari multi-axle ya trailer [HEAVY_TRUCK_PAYLOAD_TONNES] ton ya zyada. Apni gaadi ki sahi capacity RC se aur support se confirm kar lo.
answer: Approximate payloads vary by model and legal limits: mini trucks and pickups carry up to a few tonnes, medium trucks around 6 to 10 tonnes, and heavy multi-axle trucks and trailers can carry [HEAVY_TRUCK_PAYLOAD_TONNES] tonnes or more. Always confirm exact capacity of your specific vehicle from its RC and with support.

question: Can I use a different truck than the one assigned?
alternate_questions: Dusri gaadi bhej sakte hain|Vehicle substitution|Gaadi badalna|तय गाड़ी की जगह दूसरी गाड़ी भेज सकते हैं क्या|गाड़ी बदलनी है|ट्रक सब्स्टीट्यूट
answer_en: Substitute only after informing RoadExpress through [SUPPORT_PHONE], because documents, LR, e-way bill and tracking are linked to the registered vehicle. The new truck must be verified, equal or better in size and carry its own valid papers. Sending an unverified vehicle can cause rejection and penalties.
answer_hi: पहले [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर रोडएक्सप्रेस को बताकर ही गाड़ी बदलें, क्योंकि कागज़, LR, ई-वे बिल और ट्रैकिंग रजिस्टर्ड गाड़ी से जुड़े होते हैं। नई गाड़ी सत्यापित, बराबर या बड़ी और अपने वैध कागज़ों वाली होनी चाहिए। बिना सत्यापन की गाड़ी भेजने पर रिजेक्शन और पेनल्टी लग सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi badalni ho to pehle [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do, kyunki kagaz, bilty, e-way bill aur tracking us gaadi se jude hote hain. Nayi gaadi verified ho, size me barabar ya badi ho aur uske kagaz valid hon. Bina bataye gaadi bhejoge to reject aur penalty ho sakti hai.
answer: Substitute only after informing RoadExpress through [SUPPORT_PHONE], because documents, LR, e-way bill and tracking are linked to the registered vehicle. The new truck must be verified, equal or better in size and carry its own valid papers. Sending an unverified vehicle can cause rejection and penalties.

question: What is the policy for driver and vehicle cleanliness and conduct?
alternate_questions: Driver ka behaviour rule|Truck cleanliness rule|Code of conduct|ड्राइवर के आचरण के नियम|गाड़ी की साफ-सफाई|कोड ऑफ कंडक्ट
answer_en: Drivers must be sober, courteous and in proper condition to drive, avoid mobile use while driving, wear seatbelts, follow traffic laws and not carry unauthorised passengers or goods. Vehicles should be clean, well-maintained and roadworthy at placement. Violations can lead to penalties or blocking from the platform.
answer_hi: ड्राइवर नशे में न हों, विनम्र रहें और गाड़ी चलाने की सही हालत में हों, चलाते समय मोबाइल इस्तेमाल न करें, सीट बेल्ट लगाएं, ट्रैफिक नियम मानें और अनधिकृत सवारी या माल न रखें। प्लेसमेंट पर गाड़ी साफ, ठीक से मेंटेन और सड़क पर चलने लायक हो। उल्लंघन पर पेनल्टी या प्लेटफॉर्म से ब्लॉक हो सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, driver nasha na kare, tameez se pesh aaye, chalate waqt phone na chalaye, seat belt lagaye, niyam maane aur koi sawari ya side ka maal na rakhe. Gaadi saaf, theek aur chalne layak ho. Galti pe penalty ya platform se block ho sakta hai.
answer: Drivers must be sober, courteous and in proper condition to drive, avoid mobile use while driving, wear seatbelts, follow traffic laws and not carry unauthorised passengers or goods. Vehicles should be clean, well-maintained and roadworthy at placement. Violations can lead to penalties or blocking from the platform.

question: How does RoadExpress support carbon or fuel-efficiency goals?
alternate_questions: Diesel bachat kaise|Fuel efficient routing|Lower emission transport|डीज़ल की बचत कैसे होती है|कम ईंधन वाला रूट|ग्रीन ट्रांसपोर्ट
answer_en: AI route optimisation, return-load matching to cut empty running and consolidation of loads reduce fuel burn and emissions per tonne-kilometre. Good driving habits such as steady speed, proper tyre pressure and avoiding idling further reduce diesel cost for owners.
answer_hi: AI रूट ऑप्टिमाइज़ेशन, खाली चलना कम करने वाला वापसी लोड मैचिंग और माल का एकत्रीकरण प्रति टन-किलोमीटर ईंधन खपत और उत्सर्जन घटाते हैं। स्थिर रफ्तार, सही टायर प्रेशर और बेवजह इंजन चालू न रखने जैसी अच्छी आदतें मालिकों का डीज़ल खर्च और कम करती हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, AI route, wapsi load jisse khaali gaadi kam chale, aur maal ek jagah milana, in sab se diesel aur dhuaan kam hota hai. Ek rafftaar se chalana, tyre me sahi hawa aur bina wajah gaadi chalu na rakhna se bhi diesel bachta hai.
answer: AI route optimisation, return-load matching to cut empty running and consolidation of loads reduce fuel burn and emissions per tonne-kilometre. Good driving habits such as steady speed, proper tyre pressure and avoiding idling further reduce diesel cost for owners.

question: What safety checks should the driver do before starting a trip?
alternate_questions: Trip se pehle kya check karein|Pre trip inspection|Gaadi chalane se pehle jaanch|ट्रिप से पहले क्या जांचें|चलने से पहले गाड़ी की जांच|सेफ्टी चेकलिस्ट
answer_en: Check tyres including the spare, brakes, lights and indicators, horn, wipers, mirrors, coolant, engine oil, fuel, lashing and tarpaulin, and first-aid kit and fire extinguisher. Confirm all papers, FASTag balance and phone charge. Fix issues before departure; breakdowns on highways cost time and money.
answer_hi: टायर और स्टेपनी, ब्रेक, लाइट और इंडिकेटर, हॉर्न, वाइपर, शीशे, कूलेंट, इंजन ऑयल, ईंधन, बंधाई और तिरपाल, और प्राथमिक चिकित्सा किट और अग्निशामक जांचें। सभी कागज़, फास्टैग बैलेंस और फोन की चार्जिंग पक्की करें। निकलने से पहले दिक्कतें ठीक करें; हाईवे पर खराबी समय और पैसा दोनों खाती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, nikalne se pehle tyre aur stepney, brake, light-indicator, horn, wiper, sheeshe, coolant, engine oil, diesel, bandhai aur tirpal, aur first-aid aur fire extinguisher dekh lo. Kagaz, FASTag balance aur phone ki charging bhi. Kharabi pehle theek karo, highway pe kharab hui to time aur paisa dono jaata hai.
answer: Check tyres including the spare, brakes, lights and indicators, horn, wipers, mirrors, coolant, engine oil, fuel, lashing and tarpaulin, and first-aid kit and fire extinguisher. Confirm all papers, FASTag balance and phone charge. Fix issues before departure; breakdowns on highways cost time and money.

question: What emergency numbers should drivers keep handy?

answer_en: Keep [SUPPORT_PHONE] (RoadExpress 24/7 control centre), 112 for police, fire and ambulance, 108 for ambulance in many states, and 1033 for the national highway helpline handy. Save the vehicle owner's number and your insurance helpline as well.
answer_hi: [SUPPORT_PHONE] (रोडएक्सप्रेस 24/7 कंट्रोल सेंटर), पुलिस, फायर और एम्बुलेंस के लिए 112, कई राज्यों में एम्बुलेंस के लिए 108, और राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग हेल्पलाइन के लिए 1033 पास रखें। गाड़ी मालिक का नंबर और अपनी बीमा कंपनी की हेल्पलाइन भी सेव रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ye number phone me save rakho: [SUPPORT_PHONE] (RoadExpress 24 ghante), 112 police-fire-ambulance, 108 ambulance (kai states me), aur 1033 highway helpline. Gaadi maalik ka number aur insurance helpline bhi rakho.
answer: Keep [SUPPORT_PHONE] (RoadExpress 24/7 control centre), 112 for police, fire and ambulance, 108 for ambulance in many states, and 1033 for the national highway helpline handy. Save the vehicle owner's number and your insurance helpline as well.

question: How do I report a problem with a shipper, such as unsafe loading or harassment?
alternate_questions: Party ki shikayat|Report shipper issue|Unsafe loading complaint|पार्टी की शिकायत कैसे करें|असुरक्षित लोडिंग|लोडिंग पर परेशान कर रहे हैं
answer_en: Report immediately to [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID, location and details, and keep photos or recordings where safe. RoadExpress investigates with the shipper and can take action against repeated violations. Never loading unsafe or illegal cargo is your right; refuse and inform support.
answer_hi: तुरंत ट्रिप ID, लोकेशन और विवरण के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं, और सुरक्षित हो तो फोटो या रिकॉर्डिंग रखें। रोडएक्सप्रेस शिपर के साथ जांच करता है और बार-बार उल्लंघन पर कार्रवाई कर सकता है। असुरक्षित या अवैध माल न लादना आपका अधिकार है; मना करें और सपोर्ट को बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, turant Trip ID, jagah aur baat ke saath [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao, safe ho to photo ya recording rakho. RoadExpress party se jaanch karta hai aur baar-baar galti pe action leta hai. Asurakshit ya galat maal na chadhana aapka haq hai, mana karo aur support ko batao.
answer: Report immediately to [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the Trip ID, location and details, and keep photos or recordings where safe. RoadExpress investigates with the shipper and can take action against repeated violations. Never loading unsafe or illegal cargo is your right; refuse and inform support.

question: Can RoadExpress arrange loading and unloading labour?
alternate_questions: Hamali ka intezaam|Labour arrangement at site|Mazdoor chahiye|मज़दूरों का इंतज़ाम कर सकते हैं क्या|लोडिंग-अनलोडिंग के लिए लेबर|हमाल की व्यवस्था
answer_en: Labour is normally arranged by the consignor at loading and the consignee at unloading. For special cases, share your requirement with [SUPPORT_PHONE] before booking; any arranged labour and its cost will be shown in the quote as a separate item.
answer_hi: मज़दूर आम तौर पर लोडिंग पर भेजने वाला और अनलोडिंग पर पाने वाला लगाता है। खास स्थिति में बुकिंग से पहले अपनी ज़रूरत [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं; इंतज़ाम किए गए मज़दूर और उनका खर्च कोटेशन में अलग मद के रूप में दिखाया जाएगा।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aam taur pe loading pe bhejne wali party aur unloading pe lene wali party mazdoor lagati hai. Khaas zaroorat ho to booking se pehle [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko bata do, mazdoor ka kharcha quote me alag dikha denge.
answer: Labour is normally arranged by the consignor at loading and the consignee at unloading. For special cases, share your requirement with [SUPPORT_PHONE] before booking; any arranged labour and its cost will be shown in the quote as a separate item.

question: What is a gate pass and who issues it?
alternate_questions: Gate pass kya hai|Gate pass kaun deta hai|Entry exit slip|गेट पास क्या होता है|गेट पास कौन जारी करता है|गोदाम से निकलने की पर्ची
answer_en: A gate pass is the permission slip issued by the consignor or warehouse security allowing the loaded vehicle to leave the premises, listing vehicle number, goods and time. Keep a photo; it supports reporting, loading time and detention claims and proves when the truck was released.
answer_hi: गेट पास भेजने वाले या गोदाम की सिक्योरिटी द्वारा जारी अनुमति पर्ची है जो लदी गाड़ी को परिसर से निकलने की इजाज़त देती है, जिसमें गाड़ी नंबर, माल और समय लिखा होता है। इसकी फोटो रखें; यह रिपोर्टिंग, लोडिंग समय और डिटेंशन क्लेम में काम आती है और गाड़ी कब छूटी यह साबित करती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gate pass wo parchi hai jo party ya godown ki security deti hai ki ab gaadi nikal sakti hai, gaadi number, maal aur time likha hota hai. Iski photo rakho, reporting, loading time aur detention claim me kaam aati hai aur saboot hai ki gaadi kab chhuti.
answer: A gate pass is the permission slip issued by the consignor or warehouse security allowing the loaded vehicle to leave the premises, listing vehicle number, goods and time. Keep a photo; it supports reporting, loading time and detention claims and proves when the truck was released.

question: How do I handle consignor disputes about freight after delivery?
alternate_questions: Delivery ke baad freight par jhagda|Shipper dispute after delivery|Bhada vivad|डिलीवरी के बाद भाड़े पर विवाद|शिपर से हिसाब का झगड़ा|भाड़े को लेकर पार्टी की आपत्ति
answer_en: Freight disputes are handled between RoadExpress and the shipper; you don't need to negotiate with the shipper directly. Your settlement follows the agreed trip freight and verified deductions. If you believe a new deduction is unfair, raise it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days with your documents at [SUPPORT_EMAIL].
answer_hi: भाड़े के विवाद रोडएक्सप्रेस और शिपर के बीच सुलझाए जाते हैं; आपको शिपर से सीधे बात करने की ज़रूरत नहीं। आपका सेटलमेंट तय ट्रिप भाड़े और सत्यापित कटौती के अनुसार होता है। कोई नई कटौती गलत लगे तो अपने कागज़ों के साथ [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] दिन के अंदर [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर उठाएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bhade ka jhagda RoadExpress aur party ke beech nipta hai, aapko party se seedha baat karne ki zaroorat nahi. Aapka hisaab tay bhade aur check ki hui katoti se hota hai. Koi nayi katoti galat lage to kagaz ke saath [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] din me [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe likho.
answer: Freight disputes are handled between RoadExpress and the shipper; you don't need to negotiate with the shipper directly. Your settlement follows the agreed trip freight and verified deductions. If you believe a new deduction is unfair, raise it within [DISPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS] days with your documents at [SUPPORT_EMAIL].

question: What are typical reasons a load gets cancelled by the shipper?
alternate_questions: Party ne load cancel kar diya|Shipper cancelled load|Load cancel hone ki wajah|शिपर ने लोड कैंसल कर दिया|लोड कैंसिल क्यों होता है|आखिरी वक्त पर लोड रद्द
answer_en: Common reasons are production or stock delays, change in dispatch plan, buyer cancellation, payment or documentation issues, or truck availability. If a shipper cancels after your truck has been placed, a cancellation or placement charge of [CANCELLATION_CHARGE] may be paid to you. Report such cases to [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the reporting time.
answer_hi: आम कारण हैं उत्पादन या स्टॉक में देरी, डिस्पैच योजना में बदलाव, खरीदार का रद्द करना, पेमेंट या कागज़ की समस्या, या गाड़ी की उपलब्धता। अगर आपकी गाड़ी लगने के बाद शिपर कैंसल करता है, तो आपको [CANCELLATION_CHARGE] का कैंसलेशन या प्लेसमेंट चार्ज मिल सकता है। ऐसे मामले रिपोर्टिंग समय के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aksar maal ready nahi hota, party ka plan badal jaata hai, customer ne order roka, payment ya kagaz ki dikkat ya gaadi ka issue, isliye load cancel hota hai. Aapki gaadi lagne ke baad party ne cancel kiya to [CANCELLATION_CHARGE] placement charge mil sakta hai. Reporting time ke saath [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do.
answer: Common reasons are production or stock delays, change in dispatch plan, buyer cancellation, payment or documentation issues, or truck availability. If a shipper cancels after your truck has been placed, a cancellation or placement charge of [CANCELLATION_CHARGE] may be paid to you. Report such cases to [SUPPORT_PHONE] with the reporting time.

question: Can I get a vehicle replaced if my assigned truck breaks down before reaching pickup?
alternate_questions: Pickup se pehle gaadi kharab|Replacement truck booking|Dusri gaadi chahiye|पिकअप से पहले गाड़ी खराब हो गई|रिप्लेसमेंट ट्रक|गाड़ी खराब होने पर दूसरी गाड़ी
answer_en: Yes. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] immediately so a replacement can be arranged to protect the loading slot. Early notice avoids detention for the shipper and protects your rating. Repeated breakdowns before pickup may affect your priority for future loads.
answer_hi: हाँ। तुरंत [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं ताकि लोडिंग स्लॉट बचाने के लिए दूसरी गाड़ी का इंतज़ाम हो सके। जल्दी सूचना से शिपर का डिटेंशन बचता है और आपकी रेटिंग सुरक्षित रहती है। पिकअप से पहले बार-बार खराबी होने पर आगे के लोड की प्राथमिकता पर असर पड़ सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Haan bhai, turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe bata do, replacement gaadi laga denge taaki loading slot na jaye. Jaldi bataoge to party ka detention bachega aur aapki rating bhi. Baar-baar pickup se pehle kharabi hui to aage load milne me asar padega.
answer: Yes. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] immediately so a replacement can be arranged to protect the loading slot. Early notice avoids detention for the shipper and protects your rating. Repeated breakdowns before pickup may affect your priority for future loads.

question: What are common reasons for transit delays and how can they be avoided?
alternate_questions: Gaadi late kyun hoti hai|Reasons for delay|Delay kaise bachayein|गाड़ी देर से क्यों पहुँचती है|देरी की वजहें|देरी से कैसे बचें
answer_en: Common causes include late loading, missing documents, e-way bill errors, traffic, tolls and checks, weather, driver rest, breakdowns and consignee appointment delays. You can reduce them with complete documents, pre-trip checks, early reporting, timely updates in the app and quick escalation to [SUPPORT_PHONE].
answer_hi: आम कारण हैं लोडिंग में देरी, कागज़ की कमी, ई-वे बिल की गलती, ट्रैफिक, टोल और चेकिंग, मौसम, ड्राइवर का आराम, खराबी और पाने वाले के अपॉइंटमेंट में देरी। पूरे कागज़, ट्रिप से पहले जांच, जल्दी रिपोर्टिंग, ऐप में समय पर अपडेट और [SUPPORT_PHONE] को तुरंत बताने से इन्हें कम किया जा सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, der aksar loading late, kagaz adhure, e-way bill ki galti, traffic-toll-checking, mausam, driver ke aaram, kharabi ya party ki appointment ki wajah se hoti hai. Kagaz poore rakho, trip se pehle gaadi check karo, jaldi report karo, app me update do aur dikkat ho to turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe batao.
answer: Common causes include late loading, missing documents, e-way bill errors, traffic, tolls and checks, weather, driver rest, breakdowns and consignee appointment delays. You can reduce them with complete documents, pre-trip checks, early reporting, timely updates in the app and quick escalation to [SUPPORT_PHONE].

question: What does 'confirm vehicle' or 'vehicle assigned' mean for a booking?
alternate_questions: Gaadi confirm hui|Vehicle assigned meaning|Booking confirm kab hoti hai|वाहन असाइन होने का मतलब|बुकिंग कंफर्म कब होती है|गाड़ी तय हो गई
answer_en: Booking is confirmed when a verified vehicle and driver are assigned to your load and shown in the app with the vehicle number, driver details and expected reporting time. Until then, the request is open or being matched. You can still cancel per the cancellation terms before the vehicle reaches the pickup.
answer_hi: बुकिंग तब कन्फर्म होती है जब आपके लोड पर सत्यापित गाड़ी और ड्राइवर तय हो जाएं और ऐप में गाड़ी नंबर, ड्राइवर की जानकारी और अनुमानित रिपोर्टिंग समय दिखे। तब तक अनुरोध खुला है या मैच हो रहा है। गाड़ी के पिकअप पर पहुँचने से पहले आप कैंसलेशन शर्तों के अनुसार कैंसल कर सकते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, booking tab pakki hoti hai jab aapke load pe verified gaadi aur driver tay ho jaye aur app me gaadi number, driver ki detail aur pahunchne ka time dikhe. Tab tak request khuli hai ya match ho rahi hai. Gaadi pickup pe pahunchne se pehle cancellation ki shart ke hisaab se cancel kar sakte ho.
answer: Booking is confirmed when a verified vehicle and driver are assigned to your load and shown in the app with the vehicle number, driver details and expected reporting time. Until then, the request is open or being matched. You can still cancel per the cancellation terms before the vehicle reaches the pickup.

question: How do I find trip history for old shipments?
alternate_questions: Purani trip ki detail|Old trip history|Previous shipment records|पुरानी ट्रिप का रिकॉर्ड कैसे देखें|पुराने शिपमेंट की जानकारी|हिस्ट्री कहाँ मिलेगी
answer_en: Open the Trips or History section in the app to see past trips with LR, e-POD, invoices, payment status and vouchers. Filter by date, vehicle or lane. For very old records, request a statement at [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the period and vehicle number.
answer_hi: ऐप के Trips या History सेक्शन में पुरानी ट्रिप LR, e-POD, इनवॉइस, पेमेंट स्टेटस और वाउचर के साथ दिखती हैं। तारीख, गाड़ी या रूट से फिल्टर करें। बहुत पुराने रिकॉर्ड के लिए अवधि और गाड़ी नंबर के साथ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] से स्टेटमेंट मांगें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, app ke Trips ya History me purani trip bilty, e-POD, bill, payment aur voucher ke saath dikhti hai. Date, gaadi ya route se filter kar lo. Bahut purana chahiye to period aur gaadi number ke saath [SUPPORT_EMAIL] se statement maango.
answer: Open the Trips or History section in the app to see past trips with LR, e-POD, invoices, payment status and vouchers. Filter by date, vehicle or lane. For very old records, request a statement at [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the period and vehicle number.

question: Why is my vehicle showing as blocked or inactive?
alternate_questions: Gaadi block dikha rahi hai|Vehicle inactive in app|Truck deactivated|मेरी गाड़ी ब्लॉक क्यों है|गाड़ी इनएक्टिव|गाड़ी का स्टेटस बंद
answer_en: Common reasons are expired documents (insurance, fitness, permit), failed verification, repeated cancellations, serious complaints, or pending dues. The reason is shown in the vehicle's profile. Update documents or resolve the issue, then contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] to reactivate.
answer_hi: आम कारण हैं एक्सपायर कागज़ (बीमा, फिटनेस, परमिट), जांच में असफल होना, बार-बार कैंसलेशन, गंभीर शिकायतें या बकाया। कारण गाड़ी की प्रोफाइल में दिखता है। कागज़ अपडेट करें या मुद्दा सुलझाएं, फिर दोबारा चालू करवाने के लिए [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर संपर्क करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aksar kagaz (insurance, fitness, permit) expire hone, verification fail hone, baar-baar cancel karne, badi shikayat ya baaki raqam ki wajah se gaadi block hoti hai. Wajah gaadi ki profile me likhi hoti hai. Kagaz update karo ya muddha suljhao, phir [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karke chalu karwao.
answer: Common reasons are expired documents (insurance, fitness, permit), failed verification, repeated cancellations, serious complaints, or pending dues. The reason is shown in the vehicle's profile. Update documents or resolve the issue, then contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] to reactivate.

question: Can I add multiple drivers to one truck?
alternate_questions: Ek gaadi me kai driver|Multiple drivers one vehicle|Driver add karna|एक गाड़ी में कई ड्राइवर जोड़ सकते हैं क्या|दो ड्राइवर रजिस्टर|ड्राइवर जोड़ना
answer_en: Yes. Add each driver's name, mobile number and licence details under the vehicle in the Partner App. Select the correct driver for each trip so tracking and documents link properly. Drivers must have valid licences for the vehicle class.
answer_hi: हाँ। पार्टनर ऐप में गाड़ी के नीचे हर ड्राइवर का नाम, मोबाइल नंबर और लाइसेंस विवरण जोड़ें। हर ट्रिप के लिए सही ड्राइवर चुनें ताकि ट्रैकिंग और कागज़ सही जुड़ें। ड्राइवर के पास गाड़ी की श्रेणी का वैध लाइसेंस होना चाहिए।
answer_hinglish: Haan bhai, Partner App me gaadi ke neeche har driver ka naam, number aur licence daal do. Har trip pe sahi driver chuno taaki tracking aur kagaz sahi jude. Driver ke paas us gaadi ki category ka valid licence hona chahiye.
answer: Yes. Add each driver's name, mobile number and licence details under the vehicle in the Partner App. Select the correct driver for each trip so tracking and documents link properly. Drivers must have valid licences for the vehicle class.

question: What if the driver's phone has no data or is a basic phone?
alternate_questions: Driver ke paas smartphone nahi|Basic phone tracking|Without app tracking|ड्राइवर के पास स्मार्टफोन नहीं है|बिना ऐप ट्रैकिंग|साधारण फोन
answer_en: GPS tracking works best with a smartphone running the driver app. If a driver only has a basic phone, a GPS device installed in the vehicle or SIM-based tracking may be used where available, and the control centre may call for periodic updates. Ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] about options for your fleet.
answer_hi: GPS ट्रैकिंग ड्राइवर ऐप वाले स्मार्टफोन पर सबसे अच्छा काम करती है। ड्राइवर के पास सिर्फ साधारण फोन हो तो उपलब्धता के अनुसार गाड़ी में लगा GPS डिवाइस या SIM आधारित ट्रैकिंग इस्तेमाल हो सकती है, और कंट्रोल सेंटर समय-समय पर कॉल करके अपडेट ले सकता है। अपनी फ्लीट के विकल्प के लिए [SUPPORT_PHONE] से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, tracking smartphone me driver app se sabse achhi chalti hai. Driver ke paas sadharan phone ho to gaadi me GPS device ya SIM wali tracking lag sakti hai, aur control room kabhi-kabhi call karke update le sakta hai. Apni fleet ke liye kya option hai, [SUPPORT_PHONE] se pooch lo.
answer: GPS tracking works best with a smartphone running the driver app. If a driver only has a basic phone, a GPS device installed in the vehicle or SIM-based tracking may be used where available, and the control centre may call for periodic updates. Ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] about options for your fleet.

question: How do I report a detention or delay caused by the shipper through the app?
alternate_questions: App se detention kaise report karein|Report delay in app|Haltage entry in app|ऐप में डिटेंशन कैसे डालें|देरी की रिपोर्ट|हॉल्टेज की एंट्री
answer_en: Open the trip, mark Reported at Loading or Destination when you arrive, and upload the stamped arrival time or gate slip photo in Documents. Use Report Issue for delays, selecting Detention, and add notes. The record feeds your detention claim and is reviewed by Operations.
answer_hi: ट्रिप खोलें, पहुँचने पर Reported at Loading या Destination चुनें, और Documents में मोहर लगे पहुँचने के समय या गेट पर्ची की फोटो अपलोड करें। देरी के लिए Report Issue में Detention चुनकर नोट जोड़ें। यह रिकॉर्ड आपके डिटेंशन क्लेम में जाता है और ऑपरेशंस इसे जांचता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, trip kholo, pahunchte hi Reported at Loading ya Destination dabao, aur Documents me mohar wala time ya gate parchi ki photo daalo. Der ho to Report Issue me Detention chuno aur likh do. Ye record aapke detention claim me jaata hai aur Operations check karta hai.
answer: Open the trip, mark Reported at Loading or Destination when you arrive, and upload the stamped arrival time or gate slip photo in Documents. Use Report Issue for delays, selecting Detention, and add notes. The record feeds your detention claim and is reviewed by Operations.

question: What should I do if the consignor changes the weight or material after loading?
alternate_questions: Maal badal diya loading ke baad|Weight changed after booking|Material different from booking|बुकिंग से अलग माल लाद दिया|वज़न बढ़ा दिया|माल का प्रकार बदल गया
answer_en: Don't depart if the actual material, weight or packing differs significantly from the booking, as it can affect safety, legal limits, insurance and freight. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with photos and details; the team revises the booking or freight with the shipper, or arranges a suitable vehicle.
answer_hi: अगर असली माल, वज़न या पैकिंग बुकिंग से काफी अलग हो तो गाड़ी न निकालें, क्योंकि इसका असर सुरक्षा, कानूनी सीमा, बीमा और भाड़े पर पड़ता है। फोटो और विवरण के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें; टीम शिपर से बुकिंग या भाड़ा संशोधित करवाती है या सही गाड़ी का इंतज़ाम करती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, booking se alag maal, wazan ya packing ho to gaadi mat nikalo, safety, kanoon, insurance aur bhade sab pe asar padta hai. Photo aur detail leke [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo, team party se booking ya bhada badlwayegi ya sahi gaadi lagayegi.
answer: Don't depart if the actual material, weight or packing differs significantly from the booking, as it can affect safety, legal limits, insurance and freight. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] with photos and details; the team revises the booking or freight with the shipper, or arranges a suitable vehicle.

question: Where can I read the full terms and conditions of carriage?
alternate_questions: Terms and conditions kahan hain|T&C of freight contract|Rules of carriage|नियम और शर्तें कहाँ मिलेंगी|ट्रांसपोर्ट की शर्तें|एग्रीमेंट कहाँ से देखें
answer_en: Standard terms cover timely vehicle placement, valid permits and insurance, clean PODs without unauthorised endorsements, adherence to transit timelines, and acceptance of verified deductions for damage or shortage. The full agreement is available on the partner portal or app, or request it from [OPERATIONS_CONTACT]. Read it carefully before accepting loads.
answer_hi: मानक शर्तों में समय पर गाड़ी लगाना, वैध परमिट और बीमा, बिना अनधिकृत टिप्पणी की साफ POD, ट्रांज़िट समय का पालन और नुकसान या कमी की सत्यापित कटौती की स्वीकृति शामिल है। पूरा एग्रीमेंट पार्टनर पोर्टल या ऐप पर उपलब्ध है, या [OPERATIONS_CONTACT] से मांगें। लोड स्वीकार करने से पहले ध्यान से पढ़ें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, sharten ye hain: gaadi time pe lagana, permit aur insurance valid, bina galat remark ki saaf POD, tay time me delivery, aur shortage-damage ki check ki hui katoti maanna. Poora agreement partner portal ya app me hai, ya [OPERATIONS_CONTACT] se maango. Load lene se pehle achhe se padh lo.
answer: Standard terms cover timely vehicle placement, valid permits and insurance, clean PODs without unauthorised endorsements, adherence to transit timelines, and acceptance of verified deductions for damage or shortage. The full agreement is available on the partner portal or app, or request it from [OPERATIONS_CONTACT]. Read it carefully before accepting loads.

question: How can a shipper download the LR, e-POD and invoice for a completed trip?
alternate_questions: Trip ke documents download|Shipper POD download|Delivery proof kahan milega|पूरी हुई ट्रिप के दस्तावेज़ कैसे डाउनलोड करें|शिपर को POD कहाँ मिलेगी|LR और इनवॉइस की कॉपी
answer_en: Log in to the website or shipper app, open the trip under Completed or History, and go to Documents to download the LR, signed e-POD and invoice. If a document isn't visible after delivery, email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID or LR number.
answer_hi: वेबसाइट या शिपर ऐप में लॉग इन करें, Completed या History में ट्रिप खोलें और Documents में जाकर LR, साइन की हुई e-POD और इनवॉइस डाउनलोड करें। डिलीवरी के बाद कोई दस्तावेज़ न दिखे तो ट्रिप ID या LR नंबर के साथ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर ईमेल करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, website ya shipper app me login karo, Completed ya History me trip kholo aur Documents se bilty, signed e-POD aur bill download kar lo. Delivery ke baad koi kagaz na dikhe to Trip ID ya bilty number ke saath [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe mail karo.
answer: Log in to the website or shipper app, open the trip under Completed or History, and go to Documents to download the LR, signed e-POD and invoice. If a document isn't visible after delivery, email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID or LR number.

question: Can I repeat a previous booking quickly?
alternate_questions: Same route phir se book|Repeat order|Pichli booking dobara|पिछली बुकिंग दोबारा कैसे करें|वही रूट फिर से बुक|रिपीट बुकिंग
answer_en: Open the earlier trip in History and choose Rebook. Pickup, drop, vehicle type and material details are prefilled, so you only update the date, weight and special instructions. The rate is fresh and follows the current market.
answer_hi: History में पुरानी ट्रिप खोलें और Rebook चुनें। पिकअप, ड्रॉप, गाड़ी का प्रकार और माल की जानकारी पहले से भरी मिलेगी, आपको बस तारीख, वज़न और विशेष निर्देश बदलने होंगे। रेट नया होता है और मौजूदा बाज़ार के हिसाब से लगता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, History me purani trip kholo aur Rebook dabao. Pickup, drop, gaadi aur maal ki detail pehle se bhari milegi, bas date, wazan aur koi khaas baat badalni hai. Rate naya lagega, aaj ke bazaar ke hisaab se.
answer: Open the earlier trip in History and choose Rebook. Pickup, drop, vehicle type and material details are prefilled, so you only update the date, weight and special instructions. The rate is fresh and follows the current market.

question: Can I add multiple users from my company to the shipper account?
alternate_questions: Team members add karna|Multiple users business account|Staff login|कंपनी के कई लोगों को जोड़ना|टीम मेंबर जोड़ें|स्टाफ लॉगिन
answer_en: Yes. Business accounts can have several users such as logistics, plant and finance staff with different access levels. Ask [SUPPORT_EMAIL] or your account manager to add users or change roles, and remove users when staff leave the company.

answer: Yes. Business accounts can have several users such as logistics, plant and finance staff with different access levels. Ask [SUPPORT_EMAIL] or your account manager to add users or change roles, and remove users when staff leave the company.

question: How do I get the freight invoice in my company's GSTIN name?
alternate_questions: GST bill company ke naam|Invoice with GSTIN|ITC ke liye freight bill|मेरी कंपनी के GSTIN पर बिल|GST इनवॉइस में नाम सही|ITC के लिए फ्रेट बिल
answer_en: Add your correct legal name, address and GSTIN in the business profile before booking, because invoices are issued on those details. Corrections after invoicing may need a credit note and reissue, so verify the profile first. For input tax credit on freight, check with your tax advisor.
answer_hi: बुकिंग से पहले बिज़नेस प्रोफाइल में अपना सही कानूनी नाम, पता और GSTIN डालें, क्योंकि इनवॉइस इन्हीं विवरणों पर बनता है। इनवॉइस बनने के बाद सुधार में क्रेडिट नोट और दोबारा इनवॉइस लग सकता है, इसलिए पहले प्रोफाइल जांच लें। भाड़े पर इनपुट टैक्स क्रेडिट के लिए अपने टैक्स सलाहकार से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, booking se pehle business profile me company ka sahi naam, pata aur GSTIN daal do, bill unhi pe banta hai. Bill banne ke baad sudhaar me credit note aur dobara bill lagta hai, isliye pehle profile check kar lo. Bhade pe ITC milega ya nahi, apne CA se pooch lo.
answer: Add your correct legal name, address and GSTIN in the business profile before booking, because invoices are issued on those details. Corrections after invoicing may need a credit note and reissue, so verify the profile first. For input tax credit on freight, check with your tax advisor.

question: What if my warehouse isn't ready when the truck arrives?
