answer_en: Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] and your plant contact immediately and reschedule if needed. After the free period of [DETENTION_FREE_HOURS] hours, detention of [DETENTION_RATE_MIN] to [DETENTION_RATE_MAX] per day may be billed to the shipper for the waiting truck. Sharing slots and readiness in advance avoids this.
answer_hi: तुरंत [SUPPORT_PHONE] और अपने प्लांट के संपर्क को बताएं और ज़रूरत हो तो समय आगे करें। [DETENTION_FREE_HOURS] घंटे की छूट के बाद इंतज़ार कर रही गाड़ी का [DETENTION_RATE_MIN] से [DETENTION_RATE_MAX] प्रति दिन डिटेंशन शिपर को लग सकता है। पहले से स्लॉट और तैयारी बता देने से यह बचता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, turant [SUPPORT_PHONE] aur apne plant wale ko bata do, zaroorat ho to time aage kar lo. [DETENTION_FREE_HOURS] ghante ke free time ke baad khadi gaadi ka [DETENTION_RATE_MIN] se [DETENTION_RATE_MAX] roz detention party pe lag sakta hai. Slot aur tayyari pehle bata doge to ye nahi lagega.
answer: Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] and your plant contact immediately and reschedule if needed. After the free period of [DETENTION_FREE_HOURS] hours, detention of [DETENTION_RATE_MIN] to [DETENTION_RATE_MAX] per day may be billed to the shipper for the waiting truck. Sharing slots and readiness in advance avoids this.

question: How can I share driver and vehicle details with my gate security?
alternate_questions: Gate security ko driver detail|Pre-arrival driver info|Vehicle details share|गेट सिक्योरिटी को ड्राइवर की जानकारी|गाड़ी की डिटेल कैसे भेजें|ड्राइवर का नाम नंबर
answer_en: Once a vehicle is assigned, the trip page shows the vehicle number, driver name, phone and expected arrival time. Use the Share option to send this by WhatsApp, SMS or email, and ask security to match the driver ID and vehicle number at the gate.
answer_hi: गाड़ी लगने के बाद ट्रिप पेज पर गाड़ी नंबर, ड्राइवर का नाम, फोन और पहुँचने का अनुमानित समय दिखता है। Share विकल्प से इसे WhatsApp, SMS या ईमेल पर भेजें, और सिक्योरिटी से गेट पर ड्राइवर की ID और गाड़ी नंबर मिलाने को कहें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi lagte hi trip page pe gaadi number, driver ka naam, phone aur kab pahunchegi ye dikhta hai. Share dabake WhatsApp, SMS ya mail se gate security ko bhej do, aur bolo gate pe driver ki ID aur gaadi number milaye.
answer: Once a vehicle is assigned, the trip page shows the vehicle number, driver name, phone and expected arrival time. Use the Share option to send this by WhatsApp, SMS or email, and ask security to match the driver ID and vehicle number at the gate.

question: How do I book a return pickup for rejected or returned goods?
alternate_questions: Return pickup booking|Dealer se maal wapas|Reverse pickup process|वापसी माल का पिकअप कैसे बुक करें|रिजेक्ट माल उठवाना है|डीलर से वापसी
answer_en: Book it like a normal trip with pickup at the dealer or customer and drop at your warehouse, and write Return in the instructions. Keep the original invoice, return authorisation and a credit note or delivery challan ready. The driver counts the packages and notes their condition at pickup.
answer_hi: इसे सामान्य ट्रिप की तरह बुक करें जिसमें पिकअप डीलर या ग्राहक के यहाँ और ड्रॉप आपके गोदाम में हो, और निर्देशों में Return लिखें। ओरिजिनल इनवॉइस, वापसी की अनुमति और क्रेडिट नोट या डिलीवरी चालान तैयार रखें। ड्राइवर पिकअप पर पैकेट गिनता है और उनकी हालत दर्ज करता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, normal trip ki tarah booking karo, pickup dealer ya customer ke yahan aur drop apne godown me, aur instructions me 'Return' likh do. Asli bill, return ki permission aur credit note ya challan tayyar rakho. Driver pickup pe nag gin ke aur maal ki halat likh leta hai.
answer: Book it like a normal trip with pickup at the dealer or customer and drop at your warehouse, and write Return in the instructions. Keep the original invoice, return authorisation and a credit note or delivery challan ready. The driver counts the packages and notes their condition at pickup.

question: What happens if delivery fails and goods must return to origin?
alternate_questions: Delivery fail ho gayi|Return to origin|Undelivered goods wapas|डिलीवरी नहीं हुई माल वापस|माल वापस भेजना|RTO प्रक्रिया
answer_en: If the consignee is unavailable, refuses, or the address is wrong, the shipper decides whether to re-attempt, divert or return the goods. A return is a separate leg with its own LR, e-way bill and freight as per terms. Waiting time during this decision can attract detention, so respond quickly via [SUPPORT_PHONE].
answer_hi: अगर पाने वाला उपलब्ध नहीं है, मना कर दे या पता गलत हो, तो भेजने वाला तय करता है कि दोबारा कोशिश करनी है, रूट बदलना है या माल वापस करना है। वापसी अलग चरण है जिसका अपना LR, ई-वे बिल और शर्तों के अनुसार भाड़ा होता है। इस निर्णय के दौरान इंतज़ार पर डिटेंशन लग सकता है, इसलिए [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर जल्दी जवाब दें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, party na mile, maal lene se mana kare ya pata galat ho to bhejne wala tay karta hai dobara koshish karni hai, rasta badalna hai ya maal wapas bhejna hai. Wapsi alag leg hai, uski alag bilty, e-way bill aur bhada. Is beech gaadi khadi rahi to detention lag sakta hai, isliye [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe jaldi jawab do.
answer: If the consignee is unavailable, refuses, or the address is wrong, the shipper decides whether to re-attempt, divert or return the goods. A return is a separate leg with its own LR, e-way bill and freight as per terms. Waiting time during this decision can attract detention, so respond quickly via [SUPPORT_PHONE].

question: How should I pack goods for road transport?
alternate_questions: Packing tips for truck|Maal kaise pack karein|Safe packing for transit|ट्रक से भेजने के लिए पैकिंग कैसे करें|सुरक्षित पैकिंग|माल की पैकिंग के तरीके
answer_en: Use strong cartons, bags, crates or pallets suited to the goods, fill empty spaces, seal properly and label with consignee details and nag count. Keep heavy items at the bottom, stack within safe limits, shrink-wrap pallets and protect from moisture. Good packing sharply reduces shortage and damage deductions.
answer_hi: माल के हिसाब से मज़बूत कार्टन, बोरी, क्रेट या पैलेट इस्तेमाल करें, खाली जगह भरें, ठीक से सील करें और पाने वाले का विवरण और नग की गिनती लिखें। भारी सामान नीचे रखें, सुरक्षित सीमा में ही ऊपर रखें, पैलेट को श्रिंक-रैप करें और नमी से बचाएं। अच्छी पैकिंग से कमी और नुकसान की कटौती बहुत घटती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, maal ke hisaab se mazboot carton, bori, crate ya pallet lo, khaali jagah bharo, achhe se seal karo aur party ka naam aur nag likho. Bhaari maal neeche, ek limit tak hi upar rakho, pallet pe wrap lagao aur nami se bachao. Achhi packing se shortage aur toot-phoot ki katoti bahut kam hoti hai.
answer: Use strong cartons, bags, crates or pallets suited to the goods, fill empty spaces, seal properly and label with consignee details and nag count. Keep heavy items at the bottom, stack within safe limits, shrink-wrap pallets and protect from moisture. Good packing sharply reduces shortage and damage deductions.

question: How do I mark fragile or this-side-up goods?
alternate_questions: Fragile marking|Handle with care instruction|Maal ko up side rakhna|नाज़ुक माल पर निशान|हैंडल विद केयर|ऊपर नीचे का निशान
answer_en: Put standard labels such as Fragile, This Side Up and Keep Dry on several sides of each package, add the instructions in the booking notes and tell the driver at loading. Labels help but don't replace good packing. For high-value or delicate goods, ask for a closed container and transit insurance.
answer_hi: हर पैकेट की कई तरफ Fragile, This Side Up और Keep Dry जैसे मानक लेबल लगाएं, बुकिंग नोट्स में निर्देश लिखें और लोडिंग पर ड्राइवर को बताएं। लेबल मदद करते हैं पर अच्छी पैकिंग की जगह नहीं लेते। कीमती या नाज़ुक माल के लिए बंद कंटेनर और ट्रांज़िट बीमा मांगें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, har packet ke kai taraf 'Fragile', 'This Side Up', 'Keep Dry' ke label lagao, booking notes me likho aur loading pe driver ko bhi bata do. Label se madad milti hai par packing ki jagah nahi. Mehnga ya nazuk maal ho to container aur transit insurance maango.
answer: Put standard labels such as Fragile, This Side Up and Keep Dry on several sides of each package, add the instructions in the booking notes and tell the driver at loading. Labels help but don't replace good packing. For high-value or delicate goods, ask for a closed container and transit insurance.

question: Who seals the truck and why does the seal number matter?
alternate_questions: Seal kaun lagata hai|Seal number meaning|Container seal|सील कौन लगाता है|सील नंबर क्यों ज़रूरी|गाड़ी की सील
answer_en: For closed vehicles the consignor locks and seals the truck after loading and records the seal number on the LR or invoice. The consignee checks that the seal is intact on arrival. An intact, matching seal helps defend against shortage or theft claims, while a broken or mismatched seal means inspection and a joint count.
answer_hi: बंद गाड़ियों में लोडिंग के बाद भेजने वाला गाड़ी में ताला और सील लगाता है और सील नंबर LR या इनवॉइस पर लिखता है। पाने वाला पहुँचने पर सील सलामत है या नहीं जांचता है। सलामत और मिलती हुई सील कमी या चोरी के क्लेम से बचाव करती है, जबकि टूटी या अलग नंबर की सील का मतलब जांच और संयुक्त गिनती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, band gaadi me loading ke baad party taala aur seal lagati hai aur seal number bilty ya bill pe likhti hai. Party pahunchne pe dekhti hai seal theek hai ya nahi. Seal sahi aur number mila to shortage ya chori ke claim se bachav hota hai, tuti ya alag number ki seal ho to jaanch aur milke ginti hoti hai.
answer: For closed vehicles the consignor locks and seals the truck after loading and records the seal number on the LR or invoice. The consignee checks that the seal is intact on arrival. An intact, matching seal helps defend against shortage or theft claims, while a broken or mismatched seal means inspection and a joint count.

question: What does 'said to contain' mean on an LR?
alternate_questions: Said to contain meaning|STC on bilty|LR pe STC|LR पर said to contain का मतलब|बिल्टी पर एसटीसी|कहा गया माल
answer_en: It means the transporter has not opened or verified the contents, and the goods description is as declared by the consignor. The carrier counts packages (nag), not what is inside. This phrase matters in claim disputes, and for high-value goods you can request an inspection before sealing.
answer_hi: इसका मतलब है ट्रांसपोर्टर ने माल खोलकर जांचा नहीं है और माल का विवरण भेजने वाले के बताए अनुसार है। गाड़ी वाला पैकेट (नग) गिनता है, अंदर का सामान नहीं। क्लेम के विवाद में यह वाक्य मायने रखता है, और कीमती माल में सील से पहले जांच की मांग कर सकते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, 'said to contain' ka matlab transporter ne dabba khol ke nahi dekha, maal ka naam party ke bataye hisaab se likha hai. Gaadi wala sirf nag ginta hai, andar kya hai nahi. Claim ke jhagde me ye line kaam aati hai, mehnga maal ho to seal se pehle jaanch karwa lo.
answer: It means the transporter has not opened or verified the contents, and the goods description is as declared by the consignor. The carrier counts packages (nag), not what is inside. This phrase matters in claim disputes, and for high-value goods you can request an inspection before sealing.

question: What is chargeable weight versus actual weight?
alternate_questions: Volumetric weight|Charged weight kya hai|Weight vs space|चार्जेबल वज़न क्या है|वॉल्यूमेट्रिक वज़न|असली वज़न बनाम चार्ज वज़न
answer_en: For full-truckload bookings, freight is priced per vehicle, not per kilogram. For part loads, the chargeable weight is the higher of actual weight and volumetric weight (length x breadth x height divided by [VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR]), so light but bulky goods pay for the space they take.
answer_hi: फुल ट्रक लोड में भाड़ा गाड़ी के हिसाब से लगता है, किलो के हिसाब से नहीं। पार्ट लोड में चार्जेबल वज़न असली वज़न और वॉल्यूमेट्रिक वज़न (लंबाई x चौड़ाई x ऊँचाई को [VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR] से भाग) में से जो ज़्यादा हो वह होता है, इसलिए हल्का पर ज़्यादा जगह घेरने वाला माल जगह के हिसाब से भाड़ा देता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, full gaadi me bhada gaadi ke hisaab se lagta hai, kilo ke hisaab se nahi. Part load me asli wazan aur jagah ke wazan (lambai x chaudai x oonchai ko [VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR] se bhaag) me jo zyada ho wahi lagta hai, to halka par bada maal jagah ka paisa deta hai.
answer: For full-truckload bookings, freight is priced per vehicle, not per kilogram. For part loads, the chargeable weight is the higher of actual weight and volumetric weight (length x breadth x height divided by [VOLUMETRIC_DIVISOR]), so light but bulky goods pay for the space they take.

question: How are refunds handled when a booking is cancelled after payment?
alternate_questions: Cancel hone par refund|Advance refund shipper|Paisa wapas kab|कैंसल होने पर रिफंड|शिपर का एडवांस वापस|पैसा कब लौटेगा
answer_en: Amounts paid in advance are refunded after deducting any applicable cancellation or placement charge, to the original payment source within [REFUND_DAYS] working days. You can see the refund status in the payment history of your account.
answer_hi: एडवांस में दी गई रकम में से लागू कैंसलेशन या प्लेसमेंट चार्ज काटकर बाकी रकम [REFUND_DAYS] कार्य दिवस में मूल भुगतान माध्यम में लौटा दी जाती है। रिफंड की स्थिति अपने अकाउंट की पेमेंट हिस्ट्री में देख सकते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, advance me diya paisa, cancellation ya placement charge kaat ke, [REFUND_DAYS] working din me jis jariye se diya tha usi me wapas aa jaata hai. Refund ka status account ki payment history me dikh jaayega.
answer: Amounts paid in advance are refunded after deducting any applicable cancellation or placement charge, to the original payment source within [REFUND_DAYS] working days. You can see the refund status in the payment history of your account.

question: Does RoadExpress commit to a delivery TAT or SLA?
alternate_questions: Delivery guarantee|SLA for shippers|Time commitment|डिलीवरी की समय-सीमा तय होती है क्या|एसएलए|समय पर पहुँचने की गारंटी
answer_en: Contract shippers can agree lane-wise TATs in writing, with exceptions for force majeure, breakdowns and shipper-side delays. answer_hi: कॉन्ट्रैक्ट शिपर्स रूट के हिसाब से TAT लिखित में तय कर सकते हैं, जिसमें अप्रत्याशित घटना, ब्रेकडाउन और शिपर की तरफ की देरी अपवाद होते हैं। स्पॉट बुकिंग में कोटेशन की अनुमानित डिलीवरी तारीख एक अनुमान है जिसे सड़क, मौसम और ट्रैफिक प्रभावित कर सकते हैं। अपने रूट की SLA शर्तों के लिए [SALES_CONTACT] से बात करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, contract wale shipper route ke hisaab se TAT likhit me tay kar sakte hain, jisme force majeure, breakdown aur party ki taraf ki der alag rehti hai. Spot booking me quote ki delivery date andaza hoti hai, sadak, mausam aur traffic se badal sakti hai. SLA ke liye [SALES_CONTACT] se baat karo.
answer: Contract shippers can agree lane-wise TATs in writing, with exceptions for force majeure, breakdowns and shipper-side delays. For spot bookings, the expected delivery date in the quote is an estimate that road, weather and traffic conditions can affect. Talk to [SALES_CONTACT] for SLA terms on your lanes.

question: Can I upload many bookings together using a sheet or integration?
alternate_questions: Bulk booking upload|Excel se booking|API integration|एक साथ कई बुकिंग|शीट से बुकिंग अपलोड|इंटीग्रेशन
answer_en: Shippers with high volumes can request bulk upload or system integration support, subject to availability. Share your volumes and systems such as ERP or WMS with [SALES_CONTACT]. Until then, the Rebook option and saved addresses help speed up repeat bookings.
answer_hi: ज़्यादा मात्रा वाले शिपर्स उपलब्धता के अनुसार बल्क अपलोड या सिस्टम इंटीग्रेशन की सहायता मांग सकते हैं। अपनी मात्रा और ERP या WMS जैसे सिस्टम की जानकारी [SALES_CONTACT] को दें। तब तक Rebook विकल्प और सेव किए पते बार-बार की बुकिंग तेज़ करते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, jinka maal bahut jaata hai wo bulk upload ya system integration maang sakte hain, availability ke hisaab se. Apna volume aur ERP ya WMS ki jaankari [SALES_CONTACT] ko do. Tab tak Rebook aur saved address se baar-baar ki booking jaldi ho jaati hai.
answer: Shippers with high volumes can request bulk upload or system integration support, subject to availability. Share your volumes and systems such as ERP or WMS with [SALES_CONTACT]. Until then, the Rebook option and saved addresses help speed up repeat bookings.

question: What documents do shippers need to register a business account?
alternate_questions: Shipper KYC documents|Business account kaise banayein|Company registration for booking|शिपर के लिए कौन से दस्तावेज़|बिज़नेस अकाउंट के कागज़|कंपनी रजिस्ट्रेशन
answer_en: Typically you need the business PAN, GST certificate, address proof, ID of the authorised person, and bank details or a cancelled cheque for refunds. Large contracts may also need a signed agreement. Individuals can usually book with PAN and ID proof.
answer_hi: आम तौर पर बिज़नेस PAN, GST सर्टिफिकेट, पते का प्रमाण, अधिकृत व्यक्ति की ID और रिफंड के लिए बैंक विवरण या कैंसल चेक चाहिए। बड़े कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में साइन किया हुआ एग्रीमेंट भी लग सकता है। व्यक्तिगत शिपर आम तौर पर PAN और ID प्रमाण से बुक कर सकते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aam taur pe company ka PAN, GST certificate, pate ka saboot, authorised aadmi ki ID aur refund ke liye bank detail ya cancel cheque chahiye. Bade contract me signed agreement bhi lag sakta hai. Akela aadmi PAN aur ID se bhi booking kar leta hai.
answer: Typically you need the business PAN, GST certificate, address proof, ID of the authorised person, and bank details or a cancelled cheque for refunds. Large contracts may also need a signed agreement. Individuals can usually book with PAN and ID proof.

question: How can a shipper apply for credit terms?
alternate_questions: Credit period kaise milega|Udhaar par booking|Credit limit request|क्रेडिट पर बुकिंग कैसे|क्रेडिट सुविधा के लिए आवेदन|उधार की सुविधा
answer_en: Credit is evaluated after a booking track record or review of financial documents. Share your business details and expected volumes with [SALES_CONTACT]. Typical terms are up to [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] days subject to approval, and until then bookings are paid in advance.
answer_hi: क्रेडिट बुकिंग के रिकॉर्ड या वित्तीय दस्तावेज़ों की जांच के बाद तय होता है। अपने व्यवसाय की जानकारी और अपेक्षित मात्रा [SALES_CONTACT] को बताएं। आम तौर पर मंज़ूरी के अधीन [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] दिन तक की शर्तें होती हैं, और तब तक बुकिंग का पेमेंट एडवांस में होता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, credit tab milta hai jab booking ka record ya company ke financial kagaz check ho jaate hain. Apna business aur kitna maal bhejoge [SALES_CONTACT] ko batao. Manzoori ke baad aam taur pe [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] din tak ka udhaar milta hai, tab tak advance me payment karna hoga.
answer: Credit is evaluated after a booking track record or review of financial documents. Share your business details and expected volumes with [SALES_CONTACT]. Typical terms are up to [SHIPPER_CREDIT_DAYS] days subject to approval, and until then bookings are paid in advance.

question: Can I request priority or express dispatch?
alternate_questions: Urgent dispatch|Express truck|Jaldi gaadi nikalni hai|प्राथमिकता से गाड़ी|एक्सप्रेस डिस्पैच|जल्दी माल भेजना
answer_en: Mention that the load is urgent when booking. The team prioritises matching, may suggest a double-driver vehicle, and quotes any premium upfront. Keep the invoice, e-way bill and gate pass ready so loading and departure aren't delayed.
answer_hi: बुकिंग के समय बताएं कि माल अर्जेंट है। टीम गाड़ी मिलाने में प्राथमिकता देती है, डबल ड्राइवर वाली गाड़ी सुझा सकती है और अतिरिक्त शुल्क, अगर हो, पहले ही बता देती है। लोडिंग और रवानगी में देरी न हो इसलिए इनवॉइस, ई-वे बिल और गेट पास तैयार रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, booking pe bata do maal urgent hai. Team gaadi dhoondhne me pehle dhyan deti hai, double driver gaadi bata sakti hai aur upar ka charge ho to pehle bata deti hai. Bill, e-way bill aur gate pass tayyar rakho taaki loading aur nikalne me der na ho.
answer: Mention that the load is urgent when booking. The team prioritises matching, may suggest a double-driver vehicle, and quotes any premium upfront. Keep the invoice, e-way bill and gate pass ready so loading and departure aren't delayed.

question: How can I track many shipments at once as a shipper?
alternate_questions: All trips on one screen|Bulk tracking|Multiple shipments view|एक साथ कई शिपमेंट ट्रैक|सारी ट्रिप एक स्क्रीन पर|शिपर डैशबोर्ड
answer_en: The shipper dashboard lists all active trips with status, ETA and delay alerts. Filter by lane, date or status and export the list for your team. Notifications flag delays so you can act early.
answer_hi: शिपर डैशबोर्ड पर सारी चालू ट्रिप स्टेटस, ETA और देरी के अलर्ट के साथ दिखती हैं। रूट, तारीख या स्टेटस से फिल्टर करें और अपनी टीम के लिए लिस्ट एक्सपोर्ट करें। नोटिफिकेशन देरी की जानकारी देते हैं ताकि आप जल्दी कदम उठा सकें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, shipper dashboard pe saari chalti trip status, ETA aur delay alert ke saath dikhti hain. Route, date ya status se filter karo aur list apni team ke liye export kar lo. Der hone pe notification aata hai taaki jaldi action le sako.
answer: The shipper dashboard lists all active trips with status, ETA and delay alerts. Filter by lane, date or status and export the list for your team. Notifications flag delays so you can act early.

question: What should the driver do if a tyre bursts or gets punctured on the highway?
alternate_questions: Tyre phat gaya|Puncture on highway|Tyre burst what to do|टायर पंचर हो गया|हाईवे पर टायर फट गया|पंचर का खर्च कौन देगा
answer_en: Pull over safely, switch on hazard lights and place a reflector or triangle behind the truck. Change to the spare if it's safe, otherwise call a mechanic and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] with your location. Photograph the damage so the delay is recorded. Repair cost is the vehicle owner's, so always carry a good spare and tools.
answer_hi: सुरक्षित जगह गाड़ी रोकें, हैज़र्ड लाइट जलाएं और गाड़ी के पीछे रिफ्लेक्टर या ट्रायंगल रखें। सुरक्षित हो तो स्टेपनी लगाएं, नहीं तो मिस्त्री बुलाएं और लोकेशन के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं। नुकसान की फोटो लें ताकि देरी दर्ज हो। मरम्मत का खर्च गाड़ी मालिक का है, इसलिए अच्छी स्टेपनी और औज़ार हमेशा रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi side me lagao, parking light jalao aur peeche reflector ya triangle rakho. Safe ho to stepney lagao, nahi to mistri bulao aur location ke saath [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao. Kharabi ki photo kheench lo taaki der record me aaye. Marammat ka kharcha gaadi maalik ka hai, isliye achhi stepney aur tools hamesha rakho.
answer: Pull over safely, switch on hazard lights and place a reflector or triangle behind the truck. Change to the spare if it's safe, otherwise call a mechanic and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] with your location. Photograph the damage so the delay is recorded. Repair cost is the vehicle owner's, so always carry a good spare and tools.

question: What if the truck runs out of diesel on the road?
alternate_questions: Diesel khatam ho gaya|Out of fuel on trip|Raste me diesel nahi|रास्ते में डीज़ल खत्म|ईंधन खत्म हो गया|डीज़ल कैसे मंगवाएं
answer_en: Stop safely, call the nearest pump or roadside help and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Plan fill-ups in advance using your diesel card and pumps on the route. Delays caused by avoidable fuel shortage may not be treated as force majeure and can attract late-delivery penalties.
answer_hi: सुरक्षित रुकें, नज़दीकी पंप या रोडसाइड मदद को कॉल करें और [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं। डीज़ल कार्ड और रूट के पंपों से पहले से भराई की योजना बनाएं। बचने लायक ईंधन की कमी से हुई देरी को अप्रत्याशित घटना नहीं माना जा सकता और देर की पेनल्टी लग सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi safe jagah roko, paas ke pump ya roadside madad ko call karo aur [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao. Diesel card aur raste ke pump se pehle se plan karo kahan bharwana hai. Diesel khatam hone ki wajah se hui der ko force majeure nahi maante, late ki katoti lag sakti hai.
answer: Stop safely, call the nearest pump or roadside help and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Plan fill-ups in advance using your diesel card and pumps on the route. Delays caused by avoidable fuel shortage may not be treated as force majeure and can attract late-delivery penalties.

question: What if the driver's licence is expired, lost or not with him?
alternate_questions: Driver ka licence kho gaya|Licence expire hai|Licence nahi hai|ड्राइवर का लाइसेंस खो गया|लाइसेंस एक्सपायर|बिना लाइसेंस गाड़ी
answer_en: Never drive without a valid licence for the vehicle category. If it is lost, a digital copy on DigiLocker or mParivahan is generally accepted at checks, and a duplicate should be applied for. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so another driver can be arranged. Driving without a valid licence can lead to fines, detention of the vehicle and rejection of insurance claims.
answer_hi: गाड़ी की श्रेणी का वैध लाइसेंस के बिना कभी गाड़ी न चलाएं। खो जाए तो DigiLocker या mParivahan की डिजिटल कॉपी आम तौर पर चेकिंग में मान्य है, और डुप्लिकेट के लिए आवेदन करें। [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं ताकि दूसरा ड्राइवर लगाया जा सके। अवैध लाइसेंस पर चलाने से जुर्माना, गाड़ी रोके जाने और बीमा क्लेम रद्द होने का खतरा है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, valid licence ke bina gaadi kabhi mat chalao. Kho gaya ho to DigiLocker ya mParivahan ki digital copy aam taur pe checking me chal jaati hai, aur duplicate ke liye apply karo. [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao taaki dusra driver lag sake. Bina valid licence ke jurmana, gaadi rukna aur insurance claim reject hone ka khatra hai.
answer: Never drive without a valid licence for the vehicle category. If it is lost, a digital copy on DigiLocker or mParivahan is generally accepted at checks, and a duplicate should be applied for. Inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so another driver can be arranged. Driving without a valid licence can lead to fines, detention of the vehicle and rejection of insurance claims.

question: The LR shows less weight than the actual load. What should I do?
alternate_questions: Bilty pe weight kam likha|Weight mismatch LR|Underdeclared weight|LR पर वज़न कम लिखा है|बिल्टी का वज़न अलग है|वज़न में फर्क
answer_en: Weigh the loaded truck at a weighbridge before leaving, keep the slip and ask for the correct weight to be written on the LR and invoice. Don't depart with under-declared weight, because it risks overloading fines, insurance problems and freight disputes. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] if the consignor refuses.
answer_hi: निकलने से पहले लदी गाड़ी का वज़न कांटे पर कराएं, पर्ची रखें और LR और इनवॉइस पर सही वज़न लिखवाएं। कम लिखे वज़न के साथ न निकलें, क्योंकि ओवरलोडिंग जुर्माने, बीमा की दिक्कत और भाड़े के विवाद का खतरा है। भेजने वाला मना करे तो [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, nikalne se pehle bhari gaadi ka kanta karwao, parchi rakho aur bilty aur bill pe sahi wazan likhwao. Kam likhe wazan ke saath mat nikalo, overload challan, insurance aur bhade ke jhagde ka khatra hai. Party mana kare to [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo.
answer: Weigh the loaded truck at a weighbridge before leaving, keep the slip and ask for the correct weight to be written on the LR and invoice. Don't depart with under-declared weight, because it risks overloading fines, insurance problems and freight disputes. Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] if the consignor refuses.

question: The consignor added extra packages after we counted. What now?
alternate_questions: Ginti ke baad extra nag|Extra cartons added|Loading me nag badh gaye|गिनती के बाद एक्स्ट्रा नग|ज़्यादा कार्टन डाल दिए|लोडिंग के बाद माल बढ़ा
answer_en: Recount the packages and get the LR and loading slip updated with the new count and weight. If the total now exceeds the booked quantity or the vehicle's GVW, call [SUPPORT_PHONE] before departing, because the freight may need revision or a larger vehicle may be required.
answer_hi: पैकेट दोबारा गिनें और LR और लोडिंग स्लिप में नई गिनती और वज़न अपडेट करवाएं। अगर कुल माल बुक की मात्रा या गाड़ी के GVW से ज़्यादा हो जाए, तो निकलने से पहले [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें, क्योंकि भाड़ा संशोधित करना या बड़ी गाड़ी लगानी पड़ सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, nag dobara gino aur bilty aur loading slip pe nayi ginti aur wazan likhwao. Total booked maal ya gaadi ke GVW se upar ho gaya to nikalne se pehle [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko call karo, bhada badalna ya badi gaadi lagani pad sakti hai.
answer: Recount the packages and get the LR and loading slip updated with the new count and weight. If the total now exceeds the booked quantity or the vehicle's GVW, call [SUPPORT_PHONE] before departing, because the freight may need revision or a larger vehicle may be required.

question: Where and how do I get the truck weighed (kanta)?
alternate_questions: Kanta kahan karwayein|Weighbridge process|Dharam kanta kaise|कांटा कहाँ करवाएं|वज़न कैसे करवाएं|धर्म कांटा
answer_en: Use a licensed weighbridge (dharam kanta) near the plant or on the highway. Weigh the loaded truck and, where needed, the empty truck to get the net weight, and collect the printed slip showing vehicle number, date and time. Keep it and a photo for disputes or overload checks.
answer_hi: प्लांट के पास या हाईवे पर लाइसेंस वाला वज़न कांटा (धर्म कांटा) इस्तेमाल करें। लदी गाड़ी का और ज़रूरत हो तो खाली गाड़ी का वज़न कराकर शुद्ध वज़न निकालें, और गाड़ी नंबर, तारीख और समय वाली छपी पर्ची लें। विवाद या ओवरलोड जांच के लिए पर्ची और उसकी फोटो रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, plant ke paas ya highway pe licensed dharam kanta use karo. Bhari gaadi ka aur zaroorat ho to khaali gaadi ka kanta karwa ke maal ka asli wazan nikalo, aur gaadi number, date aur time wali chhapi parchi lo. Jhagde ya overload checking ke liye parchi aur uski photo rakho.
answer: Use a licensed weighbridge (dharam kanta) near the plant or on the highway. Weigh the loaded truck and, where needed, the empty truck to get the net weight, and collect the printed slip showing vehicle number, date and time. Keep it and a photo for disputes or overload checks.

question: Can I get money for urgent repairs during a trip?
alternate_questions: Raste me repair ke liye paisa|Emergency repair advance|Mistri ka kharcha|रास्ते में मरम्मत के लिए पैसा|इमरजेंसी रिपेयर एडवांस|मिस्त्री का खर्च
answer_en: Vehicle repairs are the owner's responsibility, and the trip advance is meant for fuel, toll and driver expenses. In a genuine emergency, call [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Any extra advance, if approved, is documented and adjusted in your settlement as per [EMERGENCY_ADVANCE_POLICY].
answer_hi: गाड़ी की मरम्मत की ज़िम्मेदारी मालिक की है, और ट्रिप एडवांस ईंधन, टोल और ड्राइवर के खर्च के लिए होता है। सच में इमरजेंसी हो तो [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करें। कोई अतिरिक्त एडवांस, अगर मंज़ूर हो, तो [EMERGENCY_ADVANCE_POLICY] के अनुसार लिखित दर्ज होकर आपके सेटलमेंट में एडजस्ट होता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi ki marammat gaadi maalik ki zimmedari hai, aur advance diesel, toll aur driver ke kharche ke liye hota hai. Sach me emergency ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karo. Extra advance manzoor hua to likhit me hoga aur [EMERGENCY_ADVANCE_POLICY] ke hisaab se settlement me adjust hoga.
answer: Vehicle repairs are the owner's responsibility, and the trip advance is meant for fuel, toll and driver expenses. In a genuine emergency, call [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Any extra advance, if approved, is documented and adjusted in your settlement as per [EMERGENCY_ADVANCE_POLICY].

question: Can I use my own LR (bilty) book instead of the RoadExpress LR?
alternate_questions: Apni bilty chalegi|Own LR book|Manual bilty|अपनी बिल्टी बुक चलेगी क्या|हाथ की बिल्टी|मैनुअल LR
answer_en: The trip is tracked and settled against the RoadExpress LR and Trip ID. If the shipper or consignee also needs your own consignment note, mention it in the booking and make sure both numbers are noted on the documents. A manual bilty with mismatched details can delay POD verification and payment.
answer_hi: ट्रिप की ट्रैकिंग और सेटलमेंट रोडएक्सप्रेस की LR और ट्रिप ID से होती है। अगर भेजने या पाने वाले को आपकी अपनी बिल्टी भी चाहिए, तो बुकिंग में बताएं और पक्का करें कि दोनों नंबर कागज़ों पर लिखे हों। अलग विवरण वाली हाथ की बिल्टी से POD जांच और पेमेंट में देरी हो सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, trip ka tracking aur hisaab RoadExpress ki bilty aur Trip ID se chalta hai. Party ko apni bilty bhi chahiye ho to booking me bata do aur dono number kagaz pe likhwa lo. Alag detail wali haath ki bilty se POD check aur payment me der ho sakti hai.
answer: The trip is tracked and settled against the RoadExpress LR and Trip ID. If the shipper or consignee also needs your own consignment note, mention it in the booking and make sure both numbers are noted on the documents. A manual bilty with mismatched details can delay POD verification and payment.

question: What if someone at a naka or check post demands money without a receipt?
alternate_questions: Naka pe paisa maang rahe|Informal payment at checkpoint|Bribe demand on highway|नाके पर बिना रसीद पैसे मांग रहे|चौकी पर रिश्वत|हाईवे पर वसूली
answer_en: Don't pay informal amounts. Show your valid documents, ask for the officer's name or ID, and request an official receipt for any genuine fine. Note the place, time and vehicle number, record if it is safe to do so, and call [SUPPORT_PHONE]. You can also report through the relevant state transport or police vigilance channels. RoadExpress does not reimburse informal payments.

question: What is the difference between a state permit and a National Permit?

question: Who bears the penalty if the e-way bill has wrong details?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, ye is pe depend karta hai bill kisne banaya aur galti kya hai. answer: It depends on who generated the bill and the nature of the mistake. answer_hinglish: Bhai, baarish me nikalne se pehle wiper, light, tyre aur brake dekh lo, dheere chalao aur gaadi se doori rakho, paani bhare underpass aur neeche pul se bacho. Tirpal achhe se baandho, kagaz plastic me rakho, extra time ka plan rakho aur rasta band ya paani bhara ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao taaki der record ho.
answer: Check wipers, lights, tyres and brakes before starting, drive slower and keep extra distance, and avoid flooded underpasses and low bridges. Secure the tarpaulin well, keep documents in a waterproof cover, plan extra time, and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] about road closures or waterlogging so the delay is recorded.

answer_en: Dense fog, typically in winter months in North India, reduces visibility and slows traffic. Use low beam or fog lamps, reduce speed, keep a safe gap, avoid overtaking and use reflectors on the vehicle. If visibility is very poor, halt at a safe place and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the delay is recorded and the shipper is updated.
answer_hi: घना कोहरा, खासकर उत्तर भारत में सर्दियों के महीनों में, दिखाई कम कर देता है और ट्रैफिक धीमा करता है। लो बीम या फॉग लैंप इस्तेमाल करें, रफ्तार घटाएं, सुरक्षित दूरी रखें, ओवरटेक न करें और गाड़ी पर रिफ्लेक्टर लगाएं। बहुत कम दिखे तो सुरक्षित जगह रुकें और [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं ताकि देरी दर्ज हो और शिपर को अपडेट मिले।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ghana kohra, khaas kar North me sardi me, dikhna kam kar deta hai aur traffic dheema. Low beam ya fog lamp lagao, speed kam rakho, doori banao, overtake mat karo aur gaadi pe reflector lagao. Bahut kam dikhe to safe jagah ruko aur [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao taaki der record ho aur party ko khabar mile.
answer: Dense fog, typically in winter months in North India, reduces visibility and slows traffic. Use low beam or fog lamps, reduce speed, keep a safe gap, avoid overtaking and use reflectors on the vehicle. If visibility is very poor, halt at a safe place and inform [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the delay is recorded and the shipper is updated.

question: What should drivers keep in mind on ghat or hilly sections?
alternate_questions: Ghat me gaadi chalana|Hill driving tips|Pahadi raste me truck|घाट में गाड़ी कैसे चलाएं|पहाड़ी रास्ते में सावधानी|ढलान पर ब्रेक
answer_en: Check the brakes before a descent, use engine braking in a low gear and never coast in neutral. Avoid overloading, sudden braking and overtaking on curves, give way to uphill traffic, take halts to let brakes cool, and watch for landslides or fog. Heavily loaded trucks on slopes are a leading cause of accidents.
answer_hi: ढलान से पहले ब्रेक जांचें, नीचे के गियर में इंजन ब्रेक इस्तेमाल करें और कभी न्यूट्रल में गाड़ी न उतारें। ओवरलोडिंग, अचानक ब्रेक और मोड़ पर ओवरटेक से बचें, चढ़ाई वाली गाड़ियों को रास्ता दें, ब्रेक ठंडे करने के लिए रुकें और भूस्खलन या कोहरे पर नज़र रखें। ढलान पर भारी लदे ट्रक दुर्घटनाओं की बड़ी वजह हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, dhalan se pehle brake check karo, neeche gear me engine brake lagao aur kabhi neutral me gaadi mat utaaro. Overload, achanak brake aur mod pe overtake se bacho, chadhai wali gaadi ko rasta do, brake thande karne ko ruko aur landslide ya kohre pe nazar rakho. Dhalan pe bhaari gaadi ke hi accident zyada hote hain.
answer: Check the brakes before a descent, use engine braking in a low gear and never coast in neutral. Avoid overloading, sudden braking and overtaking on curves, give way to uphill traffic, take halts to let brakes cool, and watch for landslides or fog. Heavily loaded trucks on slopes are a leading cause of accidents.

question: Why do freight rates go up around festivals like Diwali?
alternate_questions: Tyohaar pe bhada kyun badhta hai|Diwali freight rates|Festival season trucks|त्योहार पर भाड़ा क्यों बढ़ता है|दिवाली का भाड़ा|त्योहार में गाड़ी की कमी
answer_en: Demand surges for retail and FMCG stock, while many drivers go home for the festival, so supply of trucks shrinks and return loads fall. This pushes rates up on busy lanes. Book early, stay flexible on dates and vehicle size, and expect rates to ease after the festival.
answer_hi: खुदरा और FMCG माल की मांग बढ़ जाती है, जबकि कई ड्राइवर त्योहार पर घर चले जाते हैं, इसलिए गाड़ियाँ कम होती हैं और वापसी लोड घटता है। इससे व्यस्त रूट पर रेट बढ़ते हैं। जल्दी बुक करें, तारीख और गाड़ी के साइज़ में लचीले रहें, और त्योहार के बाद रेट कम होने की उम्मीद रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, tyohaar pe dukaan aur FMCG ka maal zyada jaata hai, aur bahut driver ghar chale jaate hain, to gaadi kam aur wapsi load bhi kam. Isliye busy route pe bhada badh jaata hai. Jaldi book karo, date aur gaadi me thoda lachila raho, tyohaar ke baad rate kam ho jaate hain.
answer: Demand surges for retail and FMCG stock, while many drivers go home for the festival, so supply of trucks shrinks and return loads fall. This pushes rates up on busy lanes. Book early, stay flexible on dates and vehicle size, and expect rates to ease after the festival.

question: Why is it hard to find trucks during harvest season?
alternate_questions: Fasal ke season me gaadi nahi|Harvest truck shortage|Rabi kharif transport|फसल के सीज़न में ट्रक की कमी|कटाई के समय गाड़ी|मंडी सीज़न
answer_en: Large agricultural movements of grain and produce pull trucks to mandi and procurement lanes, which raises rates and reduces availability elsewhere. Book early and stay flexible. Carriers can set preferred lanes in the Partner App to get alerts for these high-demand loads.
answer_hi: अनाज और उपज की बड़ी ढुलाई ट्रकों को मंडी और खरीद वाले रूट पर खींच लेती है, जिससे रेट बढ़ते हैं और दूसरी जगह गाड़ियाँ कम मिलती हैं। जल्दी बुक करें और लचीले रहें। गाड़ी वाले पार्टनर ऐप में पसंदीदा रूट सेट करके इन ज़्यादा मांग वाले लोड के अलर्ट पा सकते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, fasal ke season me anaaj aur upaj ki badi dhulai gaadiyon ko mandi aur kharid wale routes pe kheench leti hai, to bhada badhta hai aur dusre routes pe gaadi kam milti hai. Jaldi book karo aur thoda lachila raho. Gaadi wale Partner App me pasand ke route set karke in load ke alert le sakte hain.
answer: Large agricultural movements of grain and produce pull trucks to mandi and procurement lanes, which raises rates and reduces availability elsewhere. Book early and stay flexible. Carriers can set preferred lanes in the Partner App to get alerts for these high-demand loads.

question: Are there timing restrictions for heavy vehicles in cities or on highways?
alternate_questions: Bhaari gaadi ki entry timing|City no entry hours|Night entry only|भारी वाहनों के लिए समय की पाबंदी|शहर में नो एंट्री|रात की एंट्री
answer_en: Many cities restrict heavy goods vehicles during peak daytime hours and allow entry mainly at night. Rules differ by city and change from time to time. Tell support your destination city so arrival is planned around local timings, and check current rules before dispatch.
answer_hi: कई शहर दिन के व्यस्त समय में भारी माल गाड़ियों पर रोक लगाते हैं और मुख्य रूप से रात में एंट्री देते हैं। नियम शहर के हिसाब से अलग हैं और समय-समय पर बदलते हैं। सपोर्ट को अपना डेस्टिनेशन शहर बताएं ताकि पहुँचने का समय स्थानीय समय के हिसाब से तय हो, और निकलने से पहले मौजूदा नियम जांच लें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bahut shehron me din ke busy time me bhaari gaadi pe rok hoti hai aur zyada tar raat me entry milti hai. Niyam shehar ke hisaab se alag hain aur badalte rehte hain. Destination shehar support ko bata do taaki pahunchne ka time local timing ke hisaab se rakha jaye, aur nikalne se pehle ab ke niyam dekh lo.
answer: Many cities restrict heavy goods vehicles during peak daytime hours and allow entry mainly at night. Rules differ by city and change from time to time. Tell support your destination city so arrival is planned around local timings, and check current rules before dispatch.

question: Are there entry fees or green taxes for trucks entering certain cities?
alternate_questions: City entry charge|Green tax Delhi truck|Environment compensation charge|शहर में प्रवेश शुल्क|ग्रीन टैक्स|एंट्री टैक्स

answer_hi: कुछ शहर और राज्य व्यावसायिक वाहनों पर प्रवेश शुल्क या पर्यावरण से जुड़े शुल्क लेते हैं, और रकम व भुगतान का तरीका अलग-अलग है और बदलता रहता है। अपने रूट के लिए [CITY_ENTRY_CHARGES] देखें। यह भाड़े में शामिल है या अलग से देना है, यह आपकी बुकिंग पर निर्भर है, इसलिए निकलने से पहले पक्का करें और रसीद रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kuch shehar aur state commercial gaadi se entry fees ya environment charge lete hain, rakam aur bharne ka tareeka alag aur badalta rehta hai. Apne route ke liye [CITY_ENTRY_CHARGES] dekho. Ye bhade me shamil hai ya alag dena hai, booking pe depend karta hai, nikalne se pehle pakka kar lo aur raseed rakho.
answer: Some cities and states charge entry fees or environment-related charges on commercial vehicles, and the amount and payment method vary and change. Check [CITY_ENTRY_CHARGES] for your lane. Whether it is included in the freight or paid separately depends on your booking, so confirm before dispatch and keep the receipt.

answer_hinglish: Bhai, Delhi-NCR me environment ke naam pe purani gaadi pe rok aur commercial gaadi ke liye emission norms rahe hain. Niyam na maanne wali gaadi ruk ya zabt ho sakti hai, apni gaadi ke baare me doubt ho to [SUPPORT_PHONE] se pooch lo.
answer: Delhi-NCR has had restrictions on older vehicles on environmental grounds, along with emission norms for commercial vehicles. These rules are set by courts and authorities and can change, so verify the current position before booking NCR lanes. Vehicles that don't comply can be stopped or seized, so ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] if you are unsure about your truck.

question: What speed should trucks follow, and who pays overspeeding fines?
alternate_questions: Truck ki speed limit|Overspeeding challan|Speed fine|ट्रक की रफ्तार सीमा|ओवरस्पीड चालान|तेज़ चलाने पर जुर्माना
answer_en: Follow the speed limit posted on each road, as limits differ by road type and vehicle class. Overspeeding fines, including e-challans from cameras, are the responsibility of the vehicle owner or driver. Overspeeding also raises accident risk and can affect insurance claims.
answer_hi: हर सड़क पर लिखी रफ्तार सीमा का पालन करें, क्योंकि सीमा सड़क के प्रकार और गाड़ी की श्रेणी के हिसाब से अलग होती है। ओवरस्पीडिंग का जुर्माना, कैमरे से कटे ई-चालान समेत, गाड़ी मालिक या ड्राइवर की ज़िम्मेदारी है। तेज़ चलाने से दुर्घटना का खतरा भी बढ़ता है और बीमा क्लेम पर असर पड़ सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, har sadak pe jo speed limit likhi hai wahi maano, sadak aur gaadi ke type ke hisaab se alag hoti hai. Tez chalane ka challan, camera wala e-challan bhi, gaadi maalik ya driver ko bharna padta hai. Tez chalane se accident ka khatra badhta hai aur insurance claim pe bhi asar pad sakta hai.
answer: Follow the speed limit posted on each road, as limits differ by road type and vehicle class. Overspeeding fines, including e-challans from cameras, are the responsibility of the vehicle owner or driver. Overspeeding also raises accident risk and can affect insurance claims.

question: What is a PUC certificate and how often must it be renewed?
alternate_questions: PUC kya hai|Pollution certificate|PUC expire|PUC सर्टिफिकेट क्या है|प्रदूषण जांच प्रमाणपत्र|PUC कब बनवाएं
answer_en: PUC (Pollution Under Control) certificate shows that the vehicle's emissions are within permitted limits. Validity periods vary by vehicle type and state, so check yours and renew from an authorised centre before expiry. Driving without a valid PUC can attract fines.
answer_hi: PUC (पॉल्यूशन अंडर कंट्रोल) सर्टिफिकेट बताता है कि गाड़ी का उत्सर्जन तय सीमा में है। वैधता अवधि गाड़ी के प्रकार और राज्य के हिसाब से अलग होती है, इसलिए अपनी जांच लें और समाप्ति से पहले अधिकृत केंद्र से रिन्यू करवाएं। वैध PUC के बिना चलाने पर जुर्माना लग सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, PUC matlab pollution jaanch ka certificate, ki gaadi ka dhuaan limit ke andar hai. Kitne din chalta hai ye gaadi aur state pe depend karta hai, apna dekh lo aur khatam hone se pehle authorised centre se naya banwa lo. Bina valid PUC ke chalaoge to challan lag sakta hai.
answer: PUC (Pollution Under Control) certificate shows that the vehicle's emissions are within permitted limits. Validity periods vary by vehicle type and state, so check yours and renew from an authorised centre before expiry. Driving without a valid PUC can attract fines.

question: Who pays road tax, permit fees and fitness charges?

answer_en: These are the vehicle owner's recurring costs and are not part of the shipper's freight unless your booking says otherwise. Keep the receipts, renew on time and upload renewed documents in the Fleet Hub so your truck is not blocked from loads.
answer_hi: ये गाड़ी मालिक के नियमित खर्च हैं और जब तक बुकिंग में अलग न लिखा हो, शिपर के भाड़े का हिस्सा नहीं हैं। रसीदें संभालकर रखें, समय पर रिन्यू करें और Fleet Hub में नए दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें ताकि आपकी गाड़ी लोड से ब्लॉक न हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ye gaadi maalik ka apna kharcha hai, booking me alag na likha ho to party ke bhade me nahi aata. Raseed sambhal ke rakho, time pe renew karo aur Fleet Hub me naye kagaz daal do taaki gaadi load se block na ho.
answer: These are the vehicle owner's recurring costs and are not part of the shipper's freight unless your booking says otherwise. Keep the receipts, renew on time and upload renewed documents in the Fleet Hub so your truck is not blocked from loads.

question: How do I renew a fitness certificate and what happens if it lapses?
alternate_questions: Fitness certificate renew|Fitness expire ho gaya|Vehicle fitness test|फिटनेस सर्टिफिकेट कैसे रिन्यू करें|फिटनेस खत्म हो गई|गाड़ी की फिटनेस जांच
answer_en: Get the vehicle inspected at the RTO or an authorised testing station before the certificate expires, then upload the renewed certificate in the app. If it lapses, the truck cannot take new loads, and driving with an expired fitness certificate can lead to fines and insurance problems.
answer_hi: समाप्ति से पहले RTO या अधिकृत टेस्टिंग स्टेशन पर गाड़ी की जांच करवाएं और फिर नया सर्टिफिकेट ऐप में अपलोड करें। खत्म हो जाए तो ट्रक को नए लोड नहीं मिलते, और एक्सपायर फिटनेस पर चलाने से जुर्माना और बीमा की दिक्कत हो सकती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, certificate khatam hone se pehle RTO ya authorised testing station pe gaadi ki jaanch karwa lo aur naya certificate app me daal do. Khatam ho gaya to gaadi ko naye load nahi milenge, aur expire fitness pe chalane se challan aur insurance ki dikkat ho sakti hai.
answer: Get the vehicle inspected at the RTO or an authorised testing station before the certificate expires, then upload the renewed certificate in the app. If it lapses, the truck cannot take new loads, and driving with an expired fitness certificate can lead to fines and insurance problems.

question: Which driving licence does a truck driver need?
alternate_questions: Truck ka licence|HMV licence|Heavy vehicle licence|ट्रक चलाने के लिए कौन सा लाइसेंस|भारी वाहन लाइसेंस|कमर्शियल लाइसेंस
answer_en: A truck driver needs a valid driving licence in the correct category for the vehicle, such as medium or heavy goods vehicle, as per the Motor Vehicles Act. Check the exact category with your local RTO. Upload the licence in the driver profile so it can be verified.
answer_hi: ट्रक ड्राइवर के पास मोटर वाहन अधिनियम के अनुसार गाड़ी की सही श्रेणी, जैसे मध्यम या भारी माल वाहन, का वैध ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस होना चाहिए। सही श्रेणी अपने स्थानीय RTO से पक्की करें। जांच के लिए लाइसेंस ड्राइवर प्रोफाइल में अपलोड करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, truck chalane ke liye us gaadi ki sahi category ka valid licence chahiye, jaise medium ya heavy goods vehicle, Motor Vehicles Act ke hisaab se. Sahi category apne RTO se pakki kar lo. Verification ke liye licence driver profile me upload kar do.
answer: A truck driver needs a valid driving licence in the correct category for the vehicle, such as medium or heavy goods vehicle, as per the Motor Vehicles Act. Check the exact category with your local RTO. Upload the licence in the driver profile so it can be verified.

question: How do I take a clear photo of documents for upload?
alternate_questions: Document photo tips|Blurry photo problem|Bilty photo kaise lein|दस्तावेज़ की साफ फोटो कैसे लें|धुंधली फोटो|अपलोड के लिए फोटो
answer_en: Place the document on a flat surface in good light, avoid shadows and glare, and capture all four corners and every page. Hold the phone steady and check that the stamp, signature and date are readable. Use the app's scan option if available. Blurry or cropped photos are the most common reason for rejection.
answer_hi: दस्तावेज़ को अच्छी रोशनी में समतल जगह पर रखें, परछाई और चमक से बचें, और चारों कोने और हर पन्ना कैप्चर करें। फोन स्थिर रखें और जांचें कि मोहर, हस्ताक्षर और तारीख पढ़ने लायक हैं। ऐप में स्कैन विकल्प हो तो वही इस्तेमाल करें। धुंधली या कटी हुई फोटो रिजेक्शन की सबसे आम वजह है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kagaz ko achhi roshni me sapaat jagah pe rakho, parchhai aur chamak se bacho, chaaron kone aur har page aana chahiye. Phone seedha pakdo aur dekho mohar, sign aur date padhne me aa rahe hain. App me scan option ho to wahi lo. Dhundhli ya kati hui photo se hi sabse zyada reject hota hai.
answer: Place the document on a flat surface in good light, avoid shadows and glare, and capture all four corners and every page. Hold the phone steady and check that the stamp, signature and date are readable. Use the app's scan option if available. Blurry or cropped photos are the most common reason for rejection.

question: What file formats and sizes are accepted for uploads?
alternate_questions: Upload limit|PDF ya JPG|File size error|अपलोड की फाइल साइज़|कौन से फॉर्मेट चलते हैं|फाइल बहुत बड़ी है
answer_en: Clear photos or PDFs in common formats such as JPG, PNG and PDF are accepted, typically under [UPLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_MB] MB per file. If a file is too large, compress or retake it at a lower resolution, and upload one document per file so each can be verified separately.
answer_hi: साफ फोटो या JPG, PNG और PDF जैसे आम फॉर्मेट की फाइलें स्वीकार होती हैं, आम तौर पर हर फाइल [UPLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_MB] MB से कम। फाइल बहुत बड़ी हो तो कम रेज़ोल्यूशन में दोबारा खींचें या कंप्रेस करें, और हर दस्तावेज़ की अलग फाइल अपलोड करें ताकि हर एक की अलग जांच हो सके।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, saaf photo ya JPG, PNG, PDF jaisi aam files chal jaati hain, aam taur pe har file [UPLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_MB] MB se kam. File badi ho to chhoti resolution me dobara kheencho ya compress karo, aur har kagaz ki alag file daalo taaki alag-alag check ho sake.
answer: Clear photos or PDFs in common formats such as JPG, PNG and PDF are accepted, typically under [UPLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_MB] MB per file. If a file is too large, compress or retake it at a lower resolution, and upload one document per file so each can be verified separately.

question: What if the network is weak and uploads keep failing?
alternate_questions: Network kamzor upload fail|Offline upload|Slow internet document|नेटवर्क कमज़ोर है अपलोड नहीं हो रहा|ऑफलाइन अपलोड|धीमा इंटरनेट
answer_en: Retry on a better network or Wi-Fi, reduce the file size and keep the app open until the upload completes. You can save photos in your gallery and upload later when the signal improves. If it's urgent, email the documents to [SUPPORT_EMAIL] and tell [SUPPORT_PHONE] about the network problem so it is noted against upload deadlines such as the e-POD window.
answer_hi: बेहतर नेटवर्क या Wi-Fi पर दोबारा कोशिश करें, फाइल का साइज़ घटाएं और अपलोड पूरा होने तक ऐप खुला रखें। फोटो गैलरी में सेव करके सिग्नल सुधरने पर बाद में अपलोड कर सकते हैं। ज़रूरी हो तो दस्तावेज़ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर भेजें और नेटवर्क की समस्या [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं ताकि e-POD जैसी समय-सीमाओं में यह दर्ज हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, achhe network ya Wi-Fi pe dobara try karo, file chhoti karo aur upload poora hone tak app khula rakho. Photo gallery me save karke signal aane pe baad me bhi daal sakte ho. Jaldi ho to kagaz [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe mail kar do aur network ki dikkat [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko bata do taaki e-POD jaisi deadline me likha rahe.
answer: Retry on a better network or Wi-Fi, reduce the file size and keep the app open until the upload completes. You can save photos in your gallery and upload later when the signal improves. If it's urgent, email the documents to [SUPPORT_EMAIL] and tell [SUPPORT_PHONE] about the network problem so it is noted against upload deadlines such as the e-POD window.

question: How do I manage app notifications and alerts?
alternate_questions: Notification on off|Alerts band karna|Message settings|ऐप के नोटिफिकेशन कैसे बदलें|अलर्ट चालू बंद|सूचना सेटिंग
answer_en: Go to Settings then Notifications in the app to choose which alerts you want, such as new loads, trip updates, document requests and payments. Keep trip, document and payment alerts on, allow notifications in your phone settings, and turn off battery optimisation for the app so alerts arrive on time.
answer_hi: ऐप में Settings फिर Notifications में जाकर चुनें कि कौन से अलर्ट चाहिए, जैसे नए लोड, ट्रिप अपडेट, दस्तावेज़ की मांग और पेमेंट। ट्रिप, दस्तावेज़ और पेमेंट के अलर्ट चालू रखें, फोन की सेटिंग में नोटिफिकेशन की अनुमति दें, और ऐप के लिए बैटरी ऑप्टिमाइज़ेशन बंद रखें ताकि अलर्ट समय पर आएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, app me Settings phir Notifications me jaake chuno kaunse alert chahiye, jaise naye load, trip update, kagaz ki maang aur payment. Trip, kagaz aur payment ke alert on rakho, phone ki setting me notification allow karo aur app ke liye battery optimisation band rakho taaki alert time pe aaye.
answer: Go to Settings then Notifications in the app to choose which alerts you want, such as new loads, trip updates, document requests and payments. Keep trip, document and payment alerts on, allow notifications in your phone settings, and turn off battery optimisation for the app so alerts arrive on time.

question: The app says location permission denied. How do I fix it?
alternate_questions: Location permission|GPS permission allow|App location access|लोकेशन परमिशन डिनाई|लोकेशन की अनुमति|ऐप को लोकेशन एक्सेस
answer_en: Open your phone Settings, go to Apps, then RoadExpress, then Permissions and Location, and allow it (choose Allow all the time or the background option the app asks for during trips). Turn on GPS with high accuracy and switch off battery saver while driving. Tracking needs this during active trips.
answer_hi: फोन की Settings में Apps फिर RoadExpress फिर Permissions और Location में जाकर अनुमति दें (ट्रिप के दौरान Allow all the time या ऐप जो बैकग्राउंड विकल्प मांगे वह चुनें)। GPS को हाई एक्यूरेसी पर चालू करें और चलाते समय बैटरी सेवर बंद रखें। चालू ट्रिप में ट्रैकिंग के लिए यह ज़रूरी है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, phone ki Settings me Apps, phir RoadExpress, phir Permissions aur Location me jaake allow karo (trip me 'Allow all the time' ya app jo background option maange wo lo). GPS high accuracy pe on karo aur chalate waqt battery saver band rakho. Chalti trip me tracking ke liye ye zaroori hai.
answer: Open your phone Settings, go to Apps, then RoadExpress, then Permissions and Location, and allow it (choose Allow all the time or the background option the app asks for during trips). Turn on GPS with high accuracy and switch off battery saver while driving. Tracking needs this during active trips.

question: Do I need to upload photos of my truck?
alternate_questions: Gaadi ki photo|Vehicle photo upload|Truck photos for approval|गाड़ी की फोटो अपलोड|ट्रक की तस्वीरें|वाहन फोटो
answer_en: Photos of the front, sides, rear, number plate, cargo area and tarpaulin may be requested at onboarding or periodically to check condition. Take them in daylight with the whole vehicle visible. Clean, clear photos help faster approval and better load matching.
answer_hi: ऑनबोर्डिंग पर या समय-समय पर हालत जांचने के लिए गाड़ी के आगे, साइड, पीछे, नंबर प्लेट, माल वाले हिस्से और तिरपाल की फोटो मांगी जा सकती हैं। दिन की रोशनी में पूरी गाड़ी दिखे ऐसी फोटो लें। साफ फोटो से अप्रूवल जल्दी होता है और लोड मैचिंग बेहतर होती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, onboarding pe ya kabhi-kabhi gaadi ki halat dekhne ke liye aage, side, peeche, number plate, maal wale hisse aur tirpal ki photo maangi ja sakti hai. Din ki roshni me poori gaadi dikhe aisi photo lo. Saaf photo se approval jaldi hota hai aur load bhi behtar milte hain.
answer: Photos of the front, sides, rear, number plate, cargo area and tarpaulin may be requested at onboarding or periodically to check condition. Take them in daylight with the whole vehicle visible. Clean, clear photos help faster approval and better load matching.

question: What should I do if my phone with the app is lost or stolen?
alternate_questions: Phone kho gaya|Logout all devices|Account safe karna|फोन खो गया अकाउंट कैसे बचाएं|सारे डिवाइस से लॉगआउट|फोन चोरी
answer_en: Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] from another phone to have your account logged out or blocked, then log in again on your new phone using OTP on your registered number. Get the SIM blocked and duplicated, and inform your bank if banking apps were on the phone. Report any unknown activity immediately.
answer_hi: किसी दूसरे फोन से [SUPPORT_PHONE] पर कॉल करके अपना अकाउंट लॉगआउट या ब्लॉक करवाएं, फिर नए फोन पर रजिस्टर्ड नंबर के OTP से दोबारा लॉग इन करें। SIM ब्लॉक कराकर डुप्लिकेट लें और फोन में बैंकिंग ऐप थे तो बैंक को बताएं। कोई अनजान गतिविधि दिखे तो तुरंत बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, dusre phone se [SUPPORT_PHONE] pe call karke account logout ya block karwa lo, phir naye phone pe registered number ke OTP se login karo. SIM block karwake duplicate lo, aur phone me banking app the to bank ko bhi bata do. Koi anjaan activity dikhe to turant batao.
answer: Call [SUPPORT_PHONE] from another phone to have your account logged out or blocked, then log in again on your new phone using OTP on your registered number. Get the SIM blocked and duplicated, and inform your bank if banking apps were on the phone. Report any unknown activity immediately.

question: Can a transporter add attached or market vehicles to the app?
alternate_questions: Attached gaadi add karna|Market vehicle registration|Hired truck on my account|दूसरे मालिक की गाड़ी जोड़ें|अटैच्ड ट्रक|मार्केट व्हीकल
answer_en: Yes, transporters can add vehicles they control, with the owner's consent and valid vehicle documents plus an authorisation letter where the owner is a different person. Payments follow the contract and the PAN and bank details on record, and TDS rules apply as per the payee's status.
answer_hi: हाँ, ट्रांसपोर्टर अपने नियंत्रण वाली गाड़ियाँ जोड़ सकते हैं, मालिक की सहमति और वैध गाड़ी के कागज़ों के साथ, और मालिक दूसरा हो तो अधिकार पत्र भी। पेमेंट कॉन्ट्रैक्ट और रिकॉर्ड के PAN व बैंक विवरण के अनुसार होता है, और TDS नियम पाने वाले की स्थिति के अनुसार लगते हैं।
answer_hinglish: Haan bhai, transporter apne control wali gaadi jod sakta hai, maalik ki haan aur valid kagaz ke saath, aur maalik koi aur ho to authorisation letter bhi. Payment contract aur record ke PAN-bank ke hisaab se hota hai, aur TDS paane wale ki halat ke hisaab se lagta hai.
answer: Yes, transporters can add vehicles they control, with the owner's consent and valid vehicle documents plus an authorisation letter where the owner is a different person. Payments follow the contract and the PAN and bank details on record, and TDS rules apply as per the payee's status.

question: What if payment is delayed beyond the stated cycle?
alternate_questions: Payment late ho gaya|Balance delay beyond 10 days|Delay in settlement|तय समय से ज़्यादा पेमेंट में देरी|बैलेंस लेट|सेटलमेंट में देरी
answer_en: First check the trip's settlement page for a hold reason such as a flagged POD or pending claim. If there is no hold, email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID after [LATE_PAYMENT_ESCALATION_DAYS] days past the due date, and escalate to [ESCALATION_EMAIL] if there's no response. Interest or compensation for delay applies only if your contract provides for it.
answer_hi: पहले ट्रिप के सेटलमेंट पेज पर देखें कि कोई होल्ड कारण है या नहीं, जैसे आपत्ति वाली POD या लंबित क्लेम। होल्ड न हो तो देय तारीख के [LATE_PAYMENT_ESCALATION_DAYS] दिन बाद ट्रिप ID के साथ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर ईमेल करें, और जवाब न मिले तो [ESCALATION_EMAIL] तक ले जाएं। देरी पर ब्याज या मुआवज़ा तभी लागू होता है जब आपके कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में लिखा हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, pehle trip ke settlement page pe dekho koi hold to nahi, jaise POD me kami ya claim baaki. Hold na ho to due date ke [LATE_PAYMENT_ESCALATION_DAYS] din baad Trip ID ke saath [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe likho, jawab na aaye to [ESCALATION_EMAIL] pe aage badhao. Der par byaaj ya muavza tabhi milta hai jab contract me likha ho.
answer: First check the trip's settlement page for a hold reason such as a flagged POD or pending claim. If there is no hold, email [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID after [LATE_PAYMENT_ESCALATION_DAYS] days past the due date, and escalate to [ESCALATION_EMAIL] if there's no response. Interest or compensation for delay applies only if your contract provides for it.

question: On which days are balance payments released?
alternate_questions: Payment kis din aata hai|Payout schedule|Batch day|बैलेंस किस दिन आता है|पेमेंट का शेड्यूल|पेआउट बैच
answer_en: Balance payments go out in scheduled batches on working days, currently [PAYMENT_BATCH_DAYS], for PODs that were verified before the cut-off time. Bank holidays can shift a batch to the next working day, and the app shows the expected payout date once the POD is cleared.
answer_hi: बैलेंस पेमेंट कार्य दिवसों में तय बैच में जाते हैं, अभी [PAYMENT_BATCH_DAYS], उन POD के लिए जो कट-ऑफ समय से पहले सत्यापित हो गई हों। बैंक की छुट्टी से बैच अगले कार्य दिवस पर जा सकता है, और POD क्लियर होने पर ऐप में अनुमानित पेमेंट तारीख दिखती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, balance working din me tay batch me jaata hai, abhi [PAYMENT_BATCH_DAYS], un POD ka jo cut-off time se pehle verify ho gayi hon. Bank ki chhutti ho to batch agle working din chala jaata hai, aur POD clear hote hi app me payout ki date dikh jaati hai.
answer: Balance payments go out in scheduled batches on working days, currently [PAYMENT_BATCH_DAYS], for PODs that were verified before the cut-off time. Bank holidays can shift a batch to the next working day, and the app shows the expected payout date once the POD is cleared.

question: What is a credit note or adjustment in my settlement?
alternate_questions: Adjustment entry meaning|Credit note debit note settlement|Voucher me adjustment|सेटलमेंट में एडजस्टमेंट क्या है|क्रेडिट नोट|समायोजन
answer_en: An adjustment is a correction made after settlement. A credit adds money back, for example a wrongly deducted amount that was reversed, while a debit recovers money, such as an excess advance. It appears with a reference on your next voucher, so you can trace it to the original trip.
answer_hi: एडजस्टमेंट सेटलमेंट के बाद की गई सुधार प्रविष्टि है। क्रेडिट में पैसा वापस जुड़ता है, जैसे गलत कटी रकम का वापस होना, जबकि डेबिट में पैसा वसूला जाता है, जैसे ज़्यादा दिया गया एडवांस। यह आपके अगले वाउचर में रेफरेंस के साथ दिखता है ताकि आप इसे मूल ट्रिप से जोड़ सकें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, adjustment matlab hisaab ke baad ki sudhaar entry. Credit me paisa wapas judta hai, jaise galat kati katoti lauti, aur debit me paisa wapas liya jaata hai, jaise zyada gaya advance. Agle voucher me reference ke saath dikhta hai, taaki asli trip se jod sako.
answer: An adjustment is a correction made after settlement. A credit adds money back, for example a wrongly deducted amount that was reversed, while a debit recovers money, such as an excess advance. It appears with a reference on your next voucher, so you can trace it to the original trip.

question: Do contract transporters need to submit a monthly freight bill?
alternate_questions: Monthly bill submit|Freight invoice monthly|Transporter billing cycle|महीने का बिल जमा करना होता है क्या|मासिक फ्रेट बिल|बिलिंग साइकल
answer_en: Depending on your contract, you may raise a consolidated monthly invoice listing the trips, LR numbers, freight and PODs, and submit it by [BILL_SUBMISSION_DATE] for that cycle's payment. Spot-trip partners usually settle through per-trip vouchers and don't need a monthly bill unless asked.
answer_hi: आपके कॉन्ट्रैक्ट के अनुसार आप ट्रिप, LR नंबर, भाड़ा और POD की सूची वाला एकीकृत मासिक इनवॉइस बना सकते हैं और उस साइकल के पेमेंट के लिए [BILL_SUBMISSION_DATE] तक जमा करना होता है। स्पॉट ट्रिप वाले पार्टनर आम तौर पर हर ट्रिप के वाउचर से सेटल होते हैं और कहे बिना मासिक बिल की ज़रूरत नहीं होती।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, contract ke hisaab se mahine ka ek jama bill banana pad sakta hai jisme trip, bilty number, bhada aur POD ki list ho, aur [BILL_SUBMISSION_DATE] tak jama karna hota hai. Spot trip wale partner aam taur pe har trip ke voucher se hisaab karte hain, bina kahe monthly bill nahi dena padta.
answer: Depending on your contract, you may raise a consolidated monthly invoice listing the trips, LR numbers, freight and PODs, and submit it by [BILL_SUBMISSION_DATE] for that cycle's payment. Spot-trip partners usually settle through per-trip vouchers and don't need a monthly bill unless asked.

question: Is early or quick payment available?
alternate_questions: Jaldi payment option|Quick pay|Early balance|बैलेंस जल्दी लेने का विकल्प|क्विक पेमेंट|समय से पहले भुगतान
answer_en: Early or quick payment programmes, if offered, work under [EARLY_PAYMENT_OPTION] with their own eligibility and any fee, so ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] what applies to you. The standard path remains balance payment after POD verification.
answer_hi: जल्दी या क्विक पेमेंट की योजनाएं, अगर उपलब्ध हों, तो [EARLY_PAYMENT_OPTION] के अंतर्गत अपनी पात्रता और किसी शुल्क के साथ चलती हैं, इसलिए [SUPPORT_PHONE] से पूछें कि आपके लिए क्या लागू है। सामान्य तरीका POD जांच के बाद बैलेंस पेमेंट ही है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, jaldi ya quick payment ki scheme, agar hai, to [EARLY_PAYMENT_OPTION] ke tahat apni eligibility aur kabhi fees ke saath chalti hai, aapke liye kya lagu hai [SUPPORT_PHONE] se pooch lo. Aam raasta POD check ke baad balance hi hai.
answer: Early or quick payment programmes, if offered, work under [EARLY_PAYMENT_OPTION] with their own eligibility and any fee, so ask [SUPPORT_PHONE] what applies to you. The standard path remains balance payment after POD verification.

question: How are GST and TDS shown on my settlement voucher?
alternate_questions: Voucher me GST TDS|Tax details in settlement|TDS GST breakup|वाउचर में GST और TDS कैसे दिखता है|टैक्स का ब्रेकअप|सेटलमेंट में टैक्स
answer_en: The voucher shows freight, GST where applicable as per your invoice, the TDS deducted at the applicable rate on the taxable value, other deductions and the net amount paid. Check that your PAN and GSTIN are correct, because TDS is deposited against your PAN and can be claimed through Form 26AS.
answer_hi: वाउचर में भाड़ा, आपके इनवॉइस के अनुसार जहाँ लागू हो GST, कर योग्य मूल्य पर लागू दर से कटा TDS, अन्य कटौतियाँ और भुगतान की गई शुद्ध रकम दिखती है। जांचें कि आपका PAN और GSTIN सही है, क्योंकि TDS आपके PAN में जमा होता है और Form 26AS से क्लेम किया जा सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, voucher me bhada, aapke bill ke hisaab se GST (jahan lagta ho), taxable rakam pe lagu rate se kata TDS, baaki katoti aur net paisa dikhta hai. PAN aur GSTIN sahi hai ya nahi dekh lo, kyunki TDS aapke PAN me jama hota hai aur Form 26AS se claim hota hai.
answer: The voucher shows freight, GST where applicable as per your invoice, the TDS deducted at the applicable rate on the taxable value, other deductions and the net amount paid. Check that your PAN and GSTIN are correct, because TDS is deposited against your PAN and can be claimed through Form 26AS.

question: What is the difference between godown delivery and door delivery?
alternate_questions: Godown delivery meaning|Door delivery kya hai|Delivery type|गोडाउन डिलीवरी और डोर डिलीवरी में फर्क|डोर डिलीवरी क्या है|गोदाम तक डिलीवरी
answer_en: Godown delivery means the goods are delivered to the transporter's or hub's godown and the consignee collects them from there. Door delivery means the goods are delivered to the consignee's own address. Full-truckload bookings are normally door delivery unless agreed otherwise.
answer_hi: गोडाउन डिलीवरी में माल ट्रांसपोर्टर या हब के गोदाम तक पहुँचता है और पाने वाला वहाँ से उठाता है। डोर डिलीवरी में माल पाने वाले के अपने पते पर पहुँचाया जाता है। फुल ट्रक लोड बुकिंग आम तौर पर डोर डिलीवरी होती है, जब तक अलग तय न हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, godown delivery me maal transporter ya hub ke godown tak jaata hai aur party wahin se utha leti hai. Door delivery me maal seedha party ke pate pe pahunchta hai. Full gaadi booking aam taur pe door delivery hoti hai, jab tak alag tay na ho.
answer: Godown delivery means the goods are delivered to the transporter's or hub's godown and the consignee collects them from there. Door delivery means the goods are delivered to the consignee's own address. Full-truckload bookings are normally door delivery unless agreed otherwise.

question: What do 6-chakka, 10-chakka and 12-chakka trucks mean?
alternate_questions: Chakka ka matlab|10 chakka truck kitna maal|Wheeler count|6 चक्का 10 चक्का का मतलब|12 चक्का गाड़ी|पहियों के हिसाब से ट्रक
answer_en: Chakka means wheel, so a 6-chakka truck has six wheels, usually two axles. A 10-chakka has ten wheels, usually three axles, and 12-chakka and 14-chakka trucks have more axles and carry heavier loads. Actual capacity depends on the legal axle load and the vehicle's RC, so confirm it with support.
answer_hi: चक्का का मतलब पहिया है, इसलिए 6 चक्का ट्रक में छह पहिए होते हैं, आम तौर पर दो एक्सल। 10 चक्का में दस पहिए, आम तौर पर तीन एक्सल, और 12 और 14 चक्का में ज़्यादा एक्सल होते हैं और भारी माल उठाते हैं। असली क्षमता कानूनी एक्सल लोड और गाड़ी की RC पर निर्भर करती है, इसलिए सपोर्ट से पक्का करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chakka matlab pahiya, to 6 chakka me chhe pahiye, aam taur pe do axle. 10 chakka me das pahiye, aam taur pe teen axle, aur 12-14 chakka me aur zyada axle aur zyada maal. Asli capacity kanooni axle load aur RC pe depend karti hai, support se confirm kar lo.
answer: Chakka means wheel, so a 6-chakka truck has six wheels, usually two axles. A 10-chakka has ten wheels, usually three axles, and 12-chakka and 14-chakka trucks have more axles and carry heavier loads. Actual capacity depends on the legal axle load and the vehicle's RC, so confirm it with support.

question: How many kilograms are in a quintal and a tonne?
alternate_questions: Quintal ton kilo|Ton aur quintal me fark|Weight units transport|क्विंटल और टन में कितने किलो|टन का मतलब|वज़न की इकाइयाँ
answer_en: One quintal is 100 kg, and one tonne (metric ton) is 1,000 kg, which equals 10 quintals. Truck capacity and freight are usually quoted in tonnes, so mention the unit clearly when you give your load weight.
answer_hi: एक क्विंटल 100 किलो होता है, और एक टन (मीट्रिक टन) 1,000 किलो होता है, यानी 10 क्विंटल। गाड़ी की क्षमता और भाड़ा आम तौर पर टन में बताया जाता है, इसलिए माल का वज़न बताते समय इकाई साफ बोलें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ek quintal 100 kilo ka hota hai, aur ek ton (metric ton) 1,000 kilo, yaani 10 quintal. Gaadi ki capacity aur bhada aam taur pe ton me bataya jaata hai, isliye wazan batate waqt unit saaf bolo.
answer: One quintal is 100 kg, and one tonne (metric ton) is 1,000 kg, which equals 10 quintals. Truck capacity and freight are usually quoted in tonnes, so mention the unit clearly when you give your load weight.

question: What is dead freight?
alternate_questions: Dead freight meaning|Unused space charge|Kam maal bhara to bhada|डेड फ्रेट क्या है|खाली जगह का भाड़ा|कम माल पर पूरा किराया
answer_en: Dead freight is the payment for booked vehicle space that is left unused, for example when a shipper books a full truck but loads less than its capacity. In full-truckload pricing the freight is for the vehicle, so it is normally payable regardless of how much is loaded unless your agreement says otherwise. Choose the right vehicle size to avoid paying for empty space.
answer_hi: डेड फ्रेट बुक की गई गाड़ी की उस जगह का भुगतान है जो खाली रह गई, जैसे शिपर पूरी गाड़ी बुक करे पर क्षमता से कम माल भरे। फुल ट्रक लोड में भाड़ा गाड़ी का होता है, इसलिए जब तक एग्रीमेंट में अलग न लिखा हो, कितना भी माल भरें वह देय रहता है। खाली जगह का पैसा बचाने के लिए सही साइज़ की गाड़ी चुनें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, dead freight matlab booked gaadi ki jo jagah khaali reh gayi uska paisa, jaise party poori gaadi book kare par kam maal bhare. Full gaadi me bhada gaadi ka hota hai, to jab tak agreement me alag na likha ho, kitna bhi bharo wo dena padta hai. Khaali jagah ka paisa bachana ho to sahi size ki gaadi lo.
answer: Dead freight is the payment for booked vehicle space that is left unused, for example when a shipper books a full truck but loads less than its capacity. In full-truckload pricing the freight is for the vehicle, so it is normally payable regardless of how much is loaded unless your agreement says otherwise. Choose the right vehicle size to avoid paying for empty space.

question: What do 'maal malik', 'gaadi malik' and 'transport wala' mean?

answer_en: Maal malik is the owner of the goods, usually the consignor or shipper. Gaadi malik is the owner of the truck, the fleet owner or carrier partner. answer_hinglish: Bhai, maal malik matlab maal ka asli maalik, aam taur pe bhejne wali party. Gaadi malik matlab truck ka maalik, fleet owner ya carrier partner. Transport wala aam taur pe wo transport company ya agent jo gaadi lagata aur bilty kaatta hai. Ek hi aadmi in me se ek se zyada role bhi nibha sakta hai.
answer: Maal malik is the owner of the goods, usually the consignor or shipper. Gaadi malik is the owner of the truck, the fleet owner or carrier partner. Transport wala usually means the transport company or agent who arranges trucks and issues the LR. One business can play more than one of these roles.

question: What are the different meanings of 'challan' in trucking?
alternate_questions: Challan ka matlab|Delivery challan vs traffic challan|Challan kya hai|चालान के अलग-अलग मतलब|ट्रैफिक चालान और डिलीवरी चालान|चालान क्या है
answer_en: In trucking, challan can mean a delivery challan (a goods movement document used instead of an invoice for non-sale movement), a traffic or e-challan (a fine for a violation), or a tax or payment challan. The meaning depends on context, so say which one you mean when talking to support.
answer_hi: ट्रकिंग में चालान का मतलब डिलीवरी चालान (बिना बिक्री की ढुलाई में इनवॉइस की जगह इस्तेमाल होने वाला माल का दस्तावेज़), ट्रैफिक या ई-चालान (नियम तोड़ने पर जुर्माना), या टैक्स या भुगतान चालान हो सकता है। मतलब संदर्भ पर निर्भर है, इसलिए सपोर्ट से बात करते समय बताएं कि कौन सा चालान है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, trucking me challan ke teen matlab ho sakte hain: delivery challan (bina bikri ke maal ke saath jaane wala kagaz), traffic ya e-challan (jurmana), ya tax ka challan. Matlab baat ke hisaab se badalta hai, isliye support se baat karte waqt bata do kaunsa challan hai.
answer: In trucking, challan can mean a delivery challan (a goods movement document used instead of an invoice for non-sale movement), a traffic or e-challan (a fine for a violation), or a tax or payment challan. The meaning depends on context, so say which one you mean when talking to support.

answer_hinglish: Bhai, trip sheet matlab ek trip ka poora record: date, route, meter reading, diesel, toll, kharcha aur delivery ki halat, maalik hisaab ke liye rakhte hain. answer: A trip sheet is a record of a trip, listing dates, route, odometer readings, fuel, tolls, expenses and delivery status, and owners use it for accounts. The app's trip history and settlement voucher cover much of this, but keep fuel and toll receipts handy for your own books.

answer: The LR number identifies the consignment note, the Trip ID is RoadExpress's booking reference shown in the app, and the e-way bill number is the 12-digit number from the GST portal. For the fastest help, give the Trip ID and vehicle number to support. The LR number also works, and the e-way bill number is useful for tax and checking queries.

question: What is an RC and what details does it show?

answer_hinglish: Bhai, RC matlab gaadi ka asli sarkari record. Isme gaadi ka number, maalik ka naam, chassis aur engine number, make-model, gaadi ki category, laden weight aur registration-validity likhi hoti hai. Har trip pe copy ya digital copy saath rakho aur app me upload karo.
answer: RC (Registration Certificate) is the vehicle's official record. It shows the registration number, owner's name, chassis and engine numbers, make and model, vehicle class, laden weight and registration and validity details. Keep a copy or digital copy with you on every trip and upload it in the app.

question: How should a reefer be pre-cooled and loaded for perishables?

answer_en: Run the reefer and pre-cool the empty body to the set temperature for about [PRECOOL_MINUTES] minutes before loading, and load goods that are already at the right temperature. Leave airflow gaps between stacks, keep doors open only as long as needed, and avoid loading hot or wet produce. Wrong pre-cooling is a common cause of spoilage disputes.
answer_hi: लोडिंग से पहले रीफर चलाकर खाली बॉडी को तय तापमान पर लगभग [PRECOOL_MINUTES] मिनट पहले से ठंडा करें और ऐसा माल लादें जो पहले से सही तापमान पर हो। ढेरों के बीच हवा के लिए जगह छोड़ें, दरवाज़े केवल ज़रूरत भर खुले रखें और गर्म या गीला माल न लादें। गलत प्री-कूलिंग माल खराब होने के विवादों की आम वजह है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, loading se pehle reefer chala ke khaali body ko tay temperature pe lagbhag [PRECOOL_MINUTES] minute pehle thanda kar lo aur wahi maal chadhao jo pehle se sahi temperature pe ho. Dheron ke beech hawa ke liye jagah chhodo, darwaza zaroorat bhar hi kholo aur garam ya geela maal mat chadhao. Galat pre-cooling se hi aksar maal kharab hone ka jhagda hota hai.
answer: Run the reefer and pre-cool the empty body to the set temperature for about [PRECOOL_MINUTES] minutes before loading, and load goods that are already at the right temperature. Leave airflow gaps between stacks, keep doors open only as long as needed, and avoid loading hot or wet produce. Wrong pre-cooling is a common cause of spoilage disputes.

question: What hygiene rules apply when moving dairy, frozen or packaged food?

answer: Food must travel in a clean, dry, odour-free vehicle that has not recently carried chemicals or waste, with the right temperature for the product. question: How should glass, ceramics or tiles be loaded and carried?

answer: Glass is usually carried upright on A-frames or racks with padding and firm lashing, while tiles are stacked on edge or flat as suited to the product, on pallets within safe weight limits. question: What covering and paperwork rules apply to coal, ash, sand and similar bulk loads?
