answer_en: Loose bulk such as coal, fly ash and sand should be properly covered with a tarpaulin to prevent spillage and dust, and moved in tippers within the legal weight limit with weighbridge slips. Minerals like sand, stone and coal often need a valid transit pass or permit from the authorities, and rules differ by state. Check the paperwork with your shipper before loading, because uncovered or unpapered loads attract fines.
answer_hi: कोयला, फ्लाई ऐश और रेत जैसे खुले माल को गिरने और धूल रोकने के लिए तिरपाल से ठीक से ढकना चाहिए और टिपर में कानूनी वज़न सीमा के अंदर कांटा पर्ची के साथ ले जाना चाहिए। रेत, पत्थर और कोयले जैसे खनिजों के लिए अक्सर अधिकारियों से वैध ट्रांज़िट पास या परमिट चाहिए, और नियम राज्य के अनुसार अलग हैं। लोडिंग से पहले शिपर से कागज़ पक्के करें, क्योंकि बिना ढका या बिना कागज़ वाला माल जुर्माने में फँसता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, coal, fly ash aur ret jaise khule maal pe tirpal achhe se dhako taaki gire nahi aur dhool na ude, aur tipper me kanooni wazan ke andar kanta parchi ke saath le jao. Ret, patthar aur koyle jaise mineral ke liye aksar valid transit pass ya permit chahiye, state ke hisaab se alag hota hai. Loading se pehle party se kagaz pakke karo, bina dhaka ya bina kagaz ka maal challan me fansta hai.
answer: Loose bulk such as coal, fly ash and sand should be properly covered with a tarpaulin to prevent spillage and dust, and moved in tippers within the legal weight limit with weighbridge slips. Minerals like sand, stone and coal often need a valid transit pass or permit from the authorities, and rules differ by state. Check the paperwork with your shipper before loading, because uncovered or unpapered loads attract fines.

question: What are the permit and escort requirements for over-dimensional cargo?

answer: Over-dimensional cargo may need a route survey, permissions from road and transport authorities, special permits, escort or pilot vehicles, flags and reflectors, and movement only during allowed hours. question: What is a TREM card for hazardous goods?
alternate_questions: TREM card kya hai|Hazardous transport emergency card|Khatarnaak maal ka card|TREM कार्ड क्या है|खतरनाक माल का इमरजेंसी कार्ड|ट्रांसपोर्ट इमरजेंसी कार्ड
answer_en: A TREM card (Transport Emergency card) carries emergency information for the hazardous goods being carried, such as the product name, hazards, first aid, and what to do in a spill, fire or leak, with emergency contact numbers. The driver of a vehicle carrying hazardous goods must keep it in the cab and know how to use it. The shipper normally provides it.
answer_hi: TREM कार्ड (ट्रांसपोर्ट इमरजेंसी कार्ड) में ले जाए जा रहे खतरनाक माल की आपातकालीन जानकारी होती है, जैसे उत्पाद का नाम, खतरे, प्राथमिक उपचार, और रिसाव, आग या लीक में क्या करें, साथ में आपात संपर्क नंबर। खतरनाक माल ले जाने वाली गाड़ी का ड्राइवर इसे केबिन में रखे और इस्तेमाल करना जानता हो। यह आम तौर पर शिपर देता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, TREM card me khatarnaak maal ki emergency jaankari hoti hai, jaise maal ka naam, khatre, pehla ilaaj, aur leak, aag ya spill ho to kya karna hai, saath me emergency number. Khatarnaak maal wali gaadi ke driver ko ye cabin me rakhna hai aur use karna aana chahiye. Ye aam taur pe party deti hai.
answer: A TREM card (Transport Emergency card) carries emergency information for the hazardous goods being carried, such as the product name, hazards, first aid, and what to do in a spill, fire or leak, with emergency contact numbers. The driver of a vehicle carrying hazardous goods must keep it in the cab and know how to use it. The shipper normally provides it.

question: What is an MSDS or SDS and why is it asked for?
alternate_questions: MSDS kya hai|Safety data sheet kyun maangte hain|Chemical ki safety sheet|MSDS क्या होता है|सेफ्टी डेटा शीट क्यों मांगते हैं|केमिकल की सुरक्षा जानकारी
answer_en: An MSDS or SDS (Safety Data Sheet) describes a chemical's properties, hazards, safe handling, protective gear, firefighting and spill measures. answer_hi: MSDS या SDS (सेफ्टी डेटा शीट) किसी केमिकल के गुण, खतरे, सुरक्षित संभाल, सुरक्षा उपकरण, आग बुझाने और रिसाव रोकने के तरीके बताती है। रोडएक्सप्रेस इसे सही गाड़ी और ड्राइवर प्रशिक्षण चुनने, रूट की योजना बनाने और आपात कदम तय करने के लिए मांगता है। केमिकल या खतरनाक माल की बुकिंग से पहले इसे [SUPPORT_PHONE] को भेजें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, MSDS ya SDS (safety data sheet) me kisi chemical ke gun, khatre, safe sambhalne ka tareeka, safety saamaan aur aag ya leak ho to kya karna hai likha hota hai. RoadExpress ye isliye maangta hai taaki sahi gaadi aur trained driver lage, route tay ho aur emergency ka plan bane. Chemical ya khatarnaak maal ki booking se pehle ye [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko bhej do.
answer: An MSDS or SDS (Safety Data Sheet) describes a chemical's properties, hazards, safe handling, protective gear, firefighting and spill measures. question: What is a consolidated e-way bill and when is it needed?
alternate_questions: Consolidated e-way bill|Ek gaadi me kai e-way bill|EWB-02 kya hai|कंसोलिडेटेड ई-वे बिल क्या है|एक गाड़ी में कई ई-वे बिल|कई बिल का एक ई-वे बिल
answer_en: When one vehicle carries several consignments, each with its own e-way bill, the transporter can generate a consolidated e-way bill that links them for that trip, which makes checking easier. It is normally generated by the transporter on the GST portal with all the individual bill numbers. Ask support whether it is needed for your multi-consignment load.
answer_hi: जब एक गाड़ी में कई माल-खेप जाती हैं और हर एक का अपना ई-वे बिल है, तो ट्रांसपोर्टर उस ट्रिप के लिए इन्हें जोड़ने वाला कंसोलिडेटेड ई-वे बिल बना सकता है, जिससे चेकिंग आसान होती है। यह आम तौर पर ट्रांसपोर्टर GST पोर्टल पर सभी अलग-अलग बिल नंबरों के साथ बनाता है। अपने कई खेप वाले माल के लिए यह ज़रूरी है या नहीं, सपोर्ट से पूछें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, ek gaadi me kai party ka maal ho aur sabka alag e-way bill ho, to transporter un sabko jodne wala ek consolidated e-way bill GST portal pe bana sakta hai, checking me aasani hoti hai. Ye aam taur pe transporter saare bill number daal ke banata hai. Aapke multi-party maal ke liye zaroori hai ya nahi, support se pooch lo.
answer: When one vehicle carries several consignments, each with its own e-way bill, the transporter can generate a consolidated e-way bill that links them for that trip, which makes checking easier. It is normally generated by the transporter on the GST portal with all the individual bill numbers. Ask support whether it is needed for your multi-consignment load.

question: What documents are needed to file a transit insurance claim?
alternate_questions: Insurance claim ke kagaz|Claim documents list|Transit claim ke liye kya chahiye|ट्रांज़िट बीमा क्लेम के दस्तावेज़|क्लेम में कौन से कागज़ लगते हैं|बीमा क्लेम की सूची
answer_en: Typically you need the claim form, policy copy, LR, invoice, packing list, POD with shortage or damage remarks, photos, weighbridge slips, a survey report and, for theft or accident, an FIR. answer_hi: आम तौर पर क्लेम फॉर्म, पॉलिसी की कॉपी, LR, इनवॉइस, पैकिंग लिस्ट, कमी या नुकसान की टिप्पणी वाली POD, फोटो, कांटा पर्ची, सर्वे रिपोर्ट और चोरी या दुर्घटना में FIR चाहिए। कैरियर और बीमा कंपनी को सूचना देने का प्रमाण और नुकसान का अनुमान भी लगाएं। सब कुछ एक साथ जमा करने से काम जल्दी होता है, इसलिए ट्रिप फाइल के लिए कॉपी [SUPPORT_EMAIL] पर भेजें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, aam taur pe claim form, policy ki copy, bilty, bill, packing list, POD (shortage-damage ke remark ke saath), photo, kanta parchi, survey report aur chori ya accident me FIR lagti hai. Carrier aur insurance wale ko bataane ka saboot aur nuksaan ka estimate bhi lagao. Sab ek saath doge to jaldi hoga, trip file ke liye copy [SUPPORT_EMAIL] pe bhej do.
answer: Typically you need the claim form, policy copy, LR, invoice, packing list, POD with shortage or damage remarks, photos, weighbridge slips, a survey report and, for theft or accident, an FIR. Include proof of intimation to the carrier and insurer and a loss estimate. Submitting everything together speeds up processing, so email copies to [SUPPORT_EMAIL] for the trip file.

question: What is the time limit to inform the insurer after cargo loss or damage?
alternate_questions: Insurance ko kab batana hai|Claim intimation deadline|Kitne din me claim|नुकसान के बाद बीमा कंपनी को कब बताएं|क्लेम की समय-सीमा|इंटिमेशन कब करना है
answer_en: Inform the insurer and the carrier as soon as the loss or damage is noticed, ideally within [CLAIM_INTIMATION_HOURS] hours, because policies and contracts set strict notice periods and late intimation can lead to rejection. answer_hi: नुकसान या कमी दिखते ही बीमा कंपनी और कैरियर को बताएं, आदर्श रूप से [CLAIM_INTIMATION_HOURS] घंटे के अंदर, क्योंकि पॉलिसी और कॉन्ट्रैक्ट में सूचना की सख्त अवधि होती है और देर से सूचना पर क्लेम रद्द हो सकता है। अपनी पॉलिसी में सही अवधि देखें और सूचना लिखित में भेजें, तारीख का प्रमाण रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, nuksaan ya shortage dikhte hi insurance wale aur carrier ko bata do, achha ho [CLAIM_INTIMATION_HOURS] ghante ke andar, kyunki policy aur contract me notice ki sakht limit hoti hai aur der se bataya to claim reject ho sakta hai. Apni policy me exact limit dekho aur likhit me bhejo, date ka saboot rakho.
answer: Inform the insurer and the carrier as soon as the loss or damage is noticed, ideally within [CLAIM_INTIMATION_HOURS] hours, because policies and contracts set strict notice periods and late intimation can lead to rejection. question: Who files the transit insurance claim: the shipper, the carrier or RoadExpress?
alternate_questions: Claim kaun karega|Insurance claim kisko karna hai|Shipper ya carrier|क्लेम कौन दर्ज करेगा|बीमा क्लेम किसे करना है|शिपर या गाड़ी मालिक
answer_en: The claim is filed by the party with the insurable interest, usually the owner of the goods or the shipper holding the policy. RoadExpress supplies the trip records, LR, GPS data, POD and statements that the insurer asks for and coordinates with the insurer where the cover is arranged through [INSURANCE_PARTNER]. The truck's own motor insurance covers the vehicle and third-party liability, and that claim is filed by the vehicle owner.
answer_hi: क्लेम वही पक्ष दर्ज करता है जिसका बीमा योग्य हित हो, आम तौर पर माल का मालिक या पॉलिसी रखने वाला शिपर। रोडएक्सप्रेस बीमा कंपनी के मांगे ट्रिप रिकॉर्ड, LR, GPS डेटा, POD और बयान देता है और जहाँ कवर [INSURANCE_PARTNER] के ज़रिए लिया गया हो वहाँ बीमा कंपनी से तालमेल करता है। ट्रक का अपना मोटर बीमा गाड़ी और थर्ड-पार्टी देनदारी कवर करता है, और वह क्लेम गाड़ी मालिक दर्ज करता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, claim wahi karta hai jiska maal me hak ho, aam taur pe maal ka maalik ya policy rakhne wali party. RoadExpress trip ka record, bilty, GPS data, POD aur bayan insurance wale ko deta hai, aur jahan cover [INSURANCE_PARTNER] ke through hai wahan unse milke kaam karta hai. Truck ka apna motor insurance gaadi aur third party ke liye hai, uska claim gaadi maalik karta hai.
answer: The claim is filed by the party with the insurable interest, usually the owner of the goods or the shipper holding the policy. RoadExpress supplies the trip records, LR, GPS data, POD and statements that the insurer asks for and coordinates with the insurer where the cover is arranged through [INSURANCE_PARTNER]. The truck's own motor insurance covers the vehicle and third-party liability, and that claim is filed by the vehicle owner.

question: What is a policy excess or deductible in cargo insurance?
alternate_questions: Excess deductible kya hai|Insurance me apna hissa|Claim me kitna kat-ta hai|पॉलिसी एक्सेस क्या होता है|बीमा में डिडक्टिबल|क्लेम में अपनी हिस्सेदारी
answer_en: An excess or deductible is the part of each loss that you bear yourself before the insurer pays, set out in the policy schedule, see [POLICY_EXCESS]. Small claims below the excess may not be paid at all. Check this and any other conditions before you buy cover, so you know what is actually recoverable.
answer_hi: एक्सेस या डिडक्टिबल हर नुकसान का वह हिस्सा है जो बीमा कंपनी के भुगतान से पहले आप खुद वहन करते हैं, और यह पॉलिसी शेड्यूल में लिखा होता है, देखें [POLICY_EXCESS]। एक्सेस से कम के छोटे क्लेम का भुगतान नहीं भी हो सकता। कवर खरीदने से पहले यह और बाकी शर्तें जांच लें ताकि पता रहे कि असल में कितना वसूल हो सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, excess ya deductible nuksaan ka wo hissa hai jo insurance se pehle aapko khud sehna padta hai, policy me likha hota hai, dekho [POLICY_EXCESS]. Excess se chhote claim ka paisa mile bhi nahi sakta. Cover lene se pehle ye aur baaki sharten dekh lo taaki pata ho asli me kitna wapas aayega.
answer: An excess or deductible is the part of each loss that you bear yourself before the insurer pays, set out in the policy schedule, see [POLICY_EXCESS]. Small claims below the excess may not be paid at all. Check this and any other conditions before you buy cover, so you know what is actually recoverable.

question: Why do insurance claims get rejected?
alternate_questions: Claim reject kyun hota hai|Common reasons for claim rejection|Insurance claim fail|बीमा क्लेम रद्द क्यों होता है|क्लेम रिजेक्ट के कारण|क्लेम क्यों नहीं मिलता
answer_en: Common reasons are late intimation, missing documents, poor packing, overloading, an unlicensed driver or invalid permit, an unauthorised route or extra stops, undeclared or wrong goods value, an unrecorded broken seal, and a delayed FIR in theft cases. Keep papers in order, photograph loading and seals, and inform the insurer quickly to protect your claim.
answer_hi: आम कारण हैं देर से सूचना, कागज़ की कमी, खराब पैकिंग, ओवरलोडिंग, बिना लाइसेंस वाला ड्राइवर या अवैध परमिट, बिना अनुमति रूट या अतिरिक्त स्टॉप, घोषित न किया या गलत माल का मूल्य, बिना दर्ज की टूटी सील और चोरी में FIR में देरी। कागज़ ठीक रखें, लोडिंग और सील की फोटो लें और अपने क्लेम को बचाने के लिए बीमा कंपनी को जल्दी बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, claim aksar tab reject hota hai jab der se bataya, kagaz adhure, packing kharab, overload, driver ka licence ya permit invalid, galat rasta ya extra stop, maal ki keemat galat ya bataayi nahi, tuti seal ka record nahi, ya chori me FIR der se. Kagaz poore rakho, loading aur seal ki photo lo aur insurance wale ko jaldi batao.
answer: Common reasons are late intimation, missing documents, poor packing, overloading, an unlicensed driver or invalid permit, an unauthorised route or extra stops, undeclared or wrong goods value, an unrecorded broken seal, and a delayed FIR in theft cases. Keep papers in order, photograph loading and seals, and inform the insurer quickly to protect your claim.

question: Why does the declared value matter for cargo insurance?
alternate_questions: Declared value kya hota hai|Maal ki keemat kam batayi to|Underinsurance|घोषित मूल्य क्यों मायने रखता है|माल की कीमत कम बताई|कम बीमा का नुकसान
answer_en: Cargo is insured for the value you declare, normally the invoice value, and if you under-declare, the insurer can pay only a proportionate amount even on a partial loss. answer_hi: माल का बीमा उसी मूल्य पर होता है जो आप घोषित करते हैं, आम तौर पर इनवॉइस मूल्य, और कम घोषित करने पर आंशिक नुकसान में भी बीमा कंपनी अनुपात में ही भुगतान कर सकती है। माल का सही मूल्य और प्रकृति, कीमती चीज़ों समेत, घोषित करें और गाड़ी निकलने से पहले [INSURANCE_PARTNER] को बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, maal ka insurance utni keemat pe hota hai jo aap batate ho, aam taur pe bill ki keemat, aur kam bataya to thoda nuksaan hone pe bhi insurance wale anupat me hi paisa dete hain. Maal ki sahi keemat aur type, mehnge saman samet, batao aur nikalne se pehle [INSURANCE_PARTNER] ko bata do.
answer: Cargo is insured for the value you declare, normally the invoice value, and if you under-declare, the insurer can pay only a proportionate amount even on a partial loss. Declare the correct value and nature of the goods, including any high-value items, and share them with [INSURANCE_PARTNER] before dispatch.

question: Does transit insurance cover delay or loss of business?
alternate_questions: Delay ka insurance milega kya|Loss of market cover|Late delivery ka nuksaan|देरी का बीमा मिलता है क्या|कारोबार के नुकसान का कवर|देर से डिलीवरी का नुकसान
answer_en: Transit insurance normally covers physical loss or damage to goods, not delay, loss of market or other consequential losses, unless the policy specifically says so. Late-delivery consequences are dealt with under the freight contract and its TAT terms, not through the cargo policy.
answer_hi: ट्रांज़िट बीमा आम तौर पर माल के भौतिक नुकसान या खराबी को कवर करता है, देरी, बाज़ार के नुकसान या अन्य परिणामी नुकसान को नहीं, जब तक पॉलिसी में साफ न लिखा हो। देर से डिलीवरी के नतीजे भाड़ा कॉन्ट्रैक्ट और उसकी TAT शर्तों से तय होते हैं, कार्गो पॉलिसी से नहीं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, transit insurance aam taur pe maal ke asli nuksaan ya toot-phoot ko cover karta hai, der, bazaar ka nuksaan ya aage ke nuksaan ko nahi, jab tak policy me saaf na likha ho. Late delivery ka maamla freight contract aur uske TAT ki shart se dekha jaata hai, cargo policy se nahi.
tags: delay cover,consequential loss,loss of market,transit insurance,tat
answer: Transit insurance normally covers physical loss or damage to goods, not delay, loss of market or other consequential losses, unless the policy specifically says so. Late-delivery consequences are dealt with under the freight contract and its TAT terms, not through the cargo policy.

question: Are floods, landslides or fire covered by cargo insurance?
alternate_questions: Baadh aag ka insurance|Natural calamity cover|Fire flood claim|बाढ़ और आग का बीमा|प्राकृतिक आपदा में कवर|लैंडस्लाइड से नुकसान
answer_en: Cover depends on the type of policy: basic policies cover named perils such as fire, collision, overturning or flood, while wider all-risk policies cover more. Check which perils your policy includes. Keep photos, weather or road-closure proof, and inform the insurer promptly, because the cause of loss is verified in the survey.
answer_hi: कवर पॉलिसी के प्रकार पर निर्भर है: बुनियादी पॉलिसी आग, टक्कर, पलटना या बाढ़ जैसे नामित खतरों को कवर करती हैं, जबकि व्यापक ऑल-रिस्क पॉलिसी ज़्यादा कवर करती हैं। जांचें कि आपकी पॉलिसी में कौन से खतरे शामिल हैं। फोटो, मौसम या सड़क बंद होने का सबूत रखें और बीमा कंपनी को जल्दी बताएं, क्योंकि सर्वे में नुकसान का कारण जांचा जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, cover policy ke type pe hai: basic policy me aag, takkar, gaadi palatna ya baadh jaise tay khatre aate hain, aur all-risk policy me zyada kuch. Apni policy me dekho kaunse khatre shamil hain. Photo, mausam ya rasta band hone ka saboot rakho aur insurance wale ko jaldi batao, survey me nuksaan ki wajah dekhi jaati hai.
answer: Cover depends on the type of policy: basic policies cover named perils such as fire, collision, overturning or flood, while wider all-risk policies cover more. Check which perils your policy includes. Keep photos, weather or road-closure proof, and inform the insurer promptly, because the cause of loss is verified in the survey.

question: What if my truck injures someone or damages another person's property?
alternate_questions: Truck se kisi ko chot lag gayi|Third party accident|Doosre ka nuksaan ho gaya|मेरे ट्रक से किसी को चोट लग गई|थर्ड पार्टी का नुकसान|दूसरे की संपत्ति का नुकसान
answer_en: Stop, help the injured and call 112, then inform [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Don't settle matters privately, share the vehicle and driver details with the police and note witnesses. Third-party injury and property damage are covered by the truck's mandatory third-party motor insurance, so inform your insurer immediately and follow the legal process.
answer_hi: रुकें, घायलों की मदद करें और 112 पर कॉल करें, फिर [SUPPORT_PHONE] को बताएं। मामला निजी तौर पर न निपटाएं, पुलिस को गाड़ी और ड्राइवर का विवरण दें और गवाहों के नाम नोट करें। थर्ड-पार्टी की चोट और संपत्ति नुकसान ट्रक के अनिवार्य थर्ड-पार्टी मोटर बीमा से कवर होता है, इसलिए अपनी बीमा कंपनी को तुरंत बताएं और कानूनी प्रक्रिया का पालन करें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, gaadi roko, ghayal ki madad karo aur 112 pe call karo, phir [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko batao. Aapas me hi baat nipta kar mat jao, police ko gaadi aur driver ki detail do aur gawahon ka naam likh lo. Third party ki chot aur nuksaan truck ke zaroori third party motor insurance me aata hai, to apni insurance company ko turant batao aur kanooni prakriya maano.
answer: Stop, help the injured and call 112, then inform [SUPPORT_PHONE]. Don't settle matters privately, share the vehicle and driver details with the police and note witnesses. Third-party injury and property damage are covered by the truck's mandatory third-party motor insurance, so inform your insurer immediately and follow the legal process.

question: What happens to damaged goods after a claim: who keeps the salvage?
alternate_questions: Kharab maal ka kya hoga|Salvage meaning|Damaged goods disposal after claim|खराब माल का क्या होता है|सैल्वेज क्या है|क्लेम के बाद माल कौन रखेगा
answer_en: Salvage is the remaining value of damaged goods. The insurer may ask you to keep the goods for the survey and either dispose of them and deduct the salvage value from the claim or take them over. Don't sell, scrap or discard damaged goods until the insurer or surveyor approves, and store them safely meanwhile.
answer_hi: सैल्वेज खराब माल का बचा हुआ मूल्य है। बीमा कंपनी सर्वे के लिए माल रखने को कह सकती है और फिर या तो उसे बेचकर सैल्वेज मूल्य क्लेम से घटाती है या माल अपने कब्ज़े में ले लेती है। बीमा कंपनी या सर्वेयर की मंज़ूरी से पहले खराब माल को न बेचें, न कबाड़ में दें और न फेंकें, और तब तक उसे सुरक्षित रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, salvage matlab kharab maal ki bachi hui keemat. Insurance wale survey ke liye maal rakhne ko kehte hain aur phir ya to use bech ke salvage ki rakam claim se ghata dete hain ya maal apne paas le lete hain. Insurance ya surveyor ki haan se pehle kharab maal mat becho, mat phenko, aur tab tak safe rakho.
answer: Salvage is the remaining value of damaged goods. The insurer may ask you to keep the goods for the survey and either dispose of them and deduct the salvage value from the claim or take them over. Don't sell, scrap or discard damaged goods until the insurer or surveyor approves, and store them safely meanwhile.

question: How is the claim amount calculated?
alternate_questions: Claim ka paisa kaise nikalta hai|Claim valuation|Kitna paisa milega|क्लेम की रकम कैसे तय होती है|नुकसान की कीमत कैसे लगती है|क्लेम में कितना मिलेगा
answer_en: Claims are generally assessed on the invoice value or agreed value of the lost or damaged goods, less salvage and any policy excess, and the policy may allow related costs such as freight. Loss of profit is usually not included unless covered. The surveyor's report is the main basis, so keep invoices and records ready.
answer_hi: क्लेम आम तौर पर खोए या खराब माल के इनवॉइस मूल्य या तय मूल्य पर आंका जाता है, सैल्वेज और पॉलिसी एक्सेस घटाकर, और पॉलिसी के अनुसार भाड़ा जैसे संबंधित खर्च भी जुड़ सकते हैं। मुनाफे का नुकसान आम तौर पर शामिल नहीं होता जब तक कवर न हो। सर्वेयर की रिपोर्ट मुख्य आधार होती है, इसलिए इनवॉइस और रिकॉर्ड तैयार रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, claim aam taur pe kharab ya gayab maal ke bill ki keemat pe tay hota hai, salvage aur policy excess kaat ke, aur policy ho to freight jaisa kharcha bhi judta hai. Munafe ka nuksaan aam taur pe nahi milta jab tak cover na ho. Surveyor ki report mukhya aadhar hoti hai, isliye bill aur record tayyar rakho.
answer: Claims are generally assessed on the invoice value or agreed value of the lost or damaged goods, less salvage and any policy excess, and the policy may allow related costs such as freight. Loss of profit is usually not included unless covered. The surveyor's report is the main basis, so keep invoices and records ready.

question: Is the carrier responsible for every loss, even floods or other acts of God?
alternate_questions: Carrier kab zimmedar hai|Act of God liability|Baadh me maal kharab kiski galti|कैरियर कब ज़िम्मेदार होता है|प्राकृतिक आपदा में ज़िम्मेदारी|बाढ़ में माल खराब हुआ तो
answer_en: Subject to applicable law and the contract, a carrier is usually responsible for loss or damage caused by its negligence, such as overloading, a torn tarpaulin, poor security or a driver's fault. It is generally not liable for events beyond its control such as extreme natural events, defective packing or the goods' own nature. Each case is judged on its facts and documents, and the insurer decides covered claims.
answer_hi: लागू कानून और कॉन्ट्रैक्ट के अधीन, कैरियर आम तौर पर अपनी लापरवाही से हुए नुकसान का ज़िम्मेदार होता है, जैसे ओवरलोडिंग, फटा तिरपाल, खराब सुरक्षा या ड्राइवर की गलती। वह आम तौर पर अपने नियंत्रण से बाहर घटनाओं, जैसे भीषण प्राकृतिक घटनाएं, खराब पैकिंग या माल के अपने स्वभाव, का ज़िम्मेदार नहीं होता। हर मामला उसके तथ्यों और कागज़ों से तय होता है, और कवर किए गए क्लेम बीमा कंपनी तय करती है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kanoon aur contract ke hisaab se carrier aam taur pe apni laaparwahi se hue nuksaan ka zimmedar hota hai, jaise overload, phata tirpal, kamzor security ya driver ki galti. Uske control se bahar ki cheezein jaise bhayanak kudrati aafat, kharab packing ya maal ki apni prakriti ka wo aam taur pe zimmedar nahi. Har case uske tathya aur kagaz dekh ke tay hota hai, aur covered claim insurance wale tay karte hain.
answer: Subject to applicable law and the contract, a carrier is usually responsible for loss or damage caused by its negligence, such as overloading, a torn tarpaulin, poor security or a driver's fault. It is generally not liable for events beyond its control such as extreme natural events, defective packing or the goods' own nature. Each case is judged on its facts and documents, and the insurer decides covered claims.

question: Another vehicle hit my truck. Can I recover the damage from them?
alternate_questions: Dusri gaadi ne takkar mari|Third party recovery|Doosre ki galti se nuksaan|दूसरी गाड़ी ने टक्कर मारी|दूसरे की गलती का नुकसान|सामने वाले से रिकवरी
answer_en: Note the other vehicle's number, driver and insurance details, take photos, collect witness details and file an FIR. Inform your own insurer promptly. You can claim your own damage from your insurer, which may then recover from the other party's insurer, or claim from the other party directly. Share your evidence with [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the trip delay is recorded too.
answer_hi: दूसरी गाड़ी का नंबर, ड्राइवर और बीमा का विवरण नोट करें, फोटो लें, गवाहों का विवरण लें और FIR दर्ज कराएं। अपनी बीमा कंपनी को जल्दी बताएं। आप अपने नुकसान का क्लेम अपनी बीमा कंपनी से ले सकते हैं, जो फिर दूसरे पक्ष की बीमा कंपनी से वसूली कर सकती है, या सीधे दूसरे पक्ष से क्लेम कर सकते हैं। अपने सबूत [SUPPORT_PHONE] को भेजें ताकि ट्रिप की देरी भी दर्ज हो।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, dusri gaadi ka number, driver aur insurance ki detail likh lo, photo kheencho, gawahon ki jaankari lo aur FIR likhwao. Apni insurance company ko jaldi batao. Apne nuksaan ka claim apni insurance se kar sakte ho, wo aage dusre ki insurance se wasool kar sakti hai, ya seedha dusre se claim kar sakte ho. Saboot [SUPPORT_PHONE] ko bhi bhejo taaki trip ki der bhi record ho.
answer: Note the other vehicle's number, driver and insurance details, take photos, collect witness details and file an FIR. Inform your own insurer promptly. You can claim your own damage from your insurer, which may then recover from the other party's insurer, or claim from the other party directly. Share your evidence with [SUPPORT_PHONE] so the trip delay is recorded too.

question: How does first-mile pickup work for e-commerce sellers?
alternate_questions: E-commerce seller se pickup|Sellers ka maal fulfilment centre tak|Marketplace pickup truck|ई-कॉमर्स सेलर से पिकअप|सेलर का माल गोदाम तक|फर्स्ट माइल पिकअप
answer_en: Small vehicles or consolidated FTL runs collect parcels from multiple seller locations and take them to the fulfilment centre or sorting hub. Share the pickup list, time windows, packing norms and volumes in advance. Each pickup should carry its invoice and manifest, and e-POD is captured at the drop.
answer_hi: छोटी गाड़ियाँ या एकत्रित FTL फेरे कई सेलर के स्थानों से पार्सल उठाकर फुलफिलमेंट सेंटर या सॉर्टिंग हब तक ले जाते हैं। पिकअप की सूची, समय की खिड़की, पैकिंग मानक और मात्रा पहले से बताएं। हर पिकअप के साथ इनवॉइस और मैनिफेस्ट होना चाहिए, और ड्रॉप पर e-POD लिया जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, chhoti gaadi ya jodkar FTL phera kai seller ke yahan se parcel uthake fulfilment centre ya sorting hub tak le jaata hai. Pickup ki list, time window, packing ke niyam aur volume pehle se bata do. Har pickup ke saath bill aur manifest ho, aur drop pe e-POD li jaati hai.
answer: Small vehicles or consolidated FTL runs collect parcels from multiple seller locations and take them to the fulfilment centre or sorting hub. Share the pickup list, time windows, packing norms and volumes in advance. Each pickup should carry its invoice and manifest, and e-POD is captured at the drop.

question: How do delivery appointments or slots at fulfilment centres and DCs work?
alternate_questions: Slot booking warehouse delivery|FC appointment|Delivery slot miss ho gaya|फुलफिलमेंट सेंटर पर स्लॉट|डिलीवरी अपॉइंटमेंट|DC पर समय कैसे मिलता है
answer_en: Many fulfilment centres and distribution centres need a pre-booked delivery slot. Share the appointment ID and time with support so the truck is planned to reach on time. Late arrival can mean rescheduling or rejection. If the site makes the truck wait beyond its slot, get the reporting time stamped, because that waiting can count towards detention.
answer_hi: कई फुलफिलमेंट सेंटर और वितरण केंद्रों पर पहले से बुक डिलीवरी स्लॉट चाहिए होता है। अपॉइंटमेंट ID और समय सपोर्ट को बताएं ताकि गाड़ी समय पर पहुँचने की योजना बने। देर से पहुँचने पर समय दोबारा तय होना या माल रिजेक्ट होना संभव है। अगर साइट गाड़ी को स्लॉट से ज़्यादा इंतज़ार कराए, तो रिपोर्टिंग समय पर मोहर लगवाएं, क्योंकि वह इंतज़ार डिटेंशन में गिना जा सकता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bahut fulfilment centre aur DC me pehle se delivery slot book karna padta hai. Appointment ID aur time support ko bata do taaki gaadi time pe pahunche. Late pahunche to date aage ho sakti hai ya maal reject. Site khud slot ke baad gaadi ko rokti hai to reporting time pe mohar lagwao, wo intezaar detention me ginta hai.
answer: Many fulfilment centres and distribution centres need a pre-booked delivery slot. Share the appointment ID and time with support so the truck is planned to reach on time. Late arrival can mean rescheduling or rejection. If the site makes the truck wait beyond its slot, get the reporting time stamped, because that waiting can count towards detention.

question: Why are PO numbers and ASN references needed on the LR or booking?
alternate_questions: PO number LR pe kyun|ASN reference|Purchase order number bilty|PO नंबर LR पर क्यों|ASN रेफरेंस क्या है|खरीद ऑर्डर नंबर
answer_en: Many consignees match incoming goods against a purchase order (PO) or advance shipping notice (ASN) at the gate. Mention the PO, ASN or invoice numbers in the booking notes and on the LR as the consignee requires. Missing or wrong references are a common reason for gate rejection and unloading delay.
answer_hi: कई पाने वाले गेट पर आने वाले माल को खरीद ऑर्डर (PO) या एडवांस शिपिंग नोटिस (ASN) से मिलाते हैं। पाने वाले की मांग के अनुसार बुकिंग नोट्स और LR पर PO, ASN या इनवॉइस नंबर लिखें। नंबर न होना या गलत होना गेट पर रिजेक्शन और अनलोडिंग में देरी की आम वजह है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, bahut party gate pe aane wale maal ko purchase order (PO) ya ASN se milati hain. Party jaisa maange waise booking notes aur bilty pe PO, ASN ya bill number likh do. Number na ho ya galat ho to gate pe reject aur utarne me der aksar isi wajah se hoti hai.
answer: Many consignees match incoming goods against a purchase order (PO) or advance shipping notice (ASN) at the gate. Mention the PO, ASN or invoice numbers in the booking notes and on the LR as the consignee requires. Missing or wrong references are a common reason for gate rejection and unloading delay.

question: How are returnable crates, pallets or empties moved back?
alternate_questions: Empties wapas kaise jayenge|Returnable crates pallets|Khali crate pallet return|खाली क्रेट और पैलेट की वापसी|रिटर्नेबल पैकिंग|खाली बोरी कैरेट वापस
answer_en: Returnable packaging such as crates, pallets and drums is often carried back as a reverse leg or on the return trip. Count the empties at delivery and get the consignee to sign a challan for the exact number, and label them clearly. Missing empties can be charged to the party responsible, so keep records at both ends.
answer_hi: क्रेट, पैलेट और ड्रम जैसी लौटाने वाली पैकिंग अक्सर रिवर्स चरण या वापसी ट्रिप में वापस ले जाई जाती है। डिलीवरी पर खाली माल गिनें और पाने वाले से सही संख्या पर चालान साइन करवाएं, और उन पर साफ लेबल लगाएं। खोई हुई पैकिंग का खर्च ज़िम्मेदार पक्ष पर लग सकता है, इसलिए दोनों सिरों पर रिकॉर्ड रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, crate, pallet aur drum jaisi wapas aane wali packing aksar reverse trip ya wapsi me le jaayi jaati hai. Delivery pe khaali maal gino aur party se sahi ginti pe challan sign karwao, aur unpe saaf label lagao. Kam padi packing ka kharcha zimmedar party pe lag sakta hai, isliye dono taraf record rakho.
answer: Returnable packaging such as crates, pallets and drums is often carried back as a reverse leg or on the return trip. Count the empties at delivery and get the consignee to sign a challan for the exact number, and label them clearly. Missing empties can be charged to the party responsible, so keep records at both ends.

question: What is a milk-run pickup?
alternate_questions: Milk run kya hota hai|Consolidated supplier pickup|Ek gaadi se kai supplier|मिल्क रन क्या होता है|कई सप्लायर से एक गाड़ी में पिकअप|एकत्रित पिकअप
answer_en: A milk run is a fixed route in which one vehicle collects goods from several suppliers within set time windows and delivers them to a single plant or warehouse. It saves cost compared with several separate trucks and keeps supply regular. Share the supplier list, volumes, windows and drop point with [SALES_CONTACT] to plan it.
answer_hi: मिल्क रन एक तय रूट है जिसमें एक गाड़ी तय समय में कई सप्लायर से माल उठाकर एक प्लांट या गोदाम तक पहुँचाती है। कई अलग ट्रकों की तुलना में इससे खर्च बचता है और सप्लाई नियमित रहती है। योजना के लिए सप्लायर की सूची, मात्रा, समय और ड्रॉप पॉइंट [SALES_CONTACT] को बताएं।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, milk run matlab tay route jisme ek gaadi tay time me kai supplier se maal uthake ek plant ya godown tak le jaati hai. Kai alag gaadi se sasta padta hai aur supply regular rehti hai. Plan banane ke liye supplier ki list, volume, time aur drop point [SALES_CONTACT] ko bhej do.
answer: A milk run is a fixed route in which one vehicle collects goods from several suppliers within set time windows and delivers them to a single plant or warehouse. question: What is cross-docking?

answer_en: Cross-docking means goods arriving on an inbound vehicle are moved straight to outbound vehicles at a hub with little or no storage, which speeds up distribution. answer_hinglish: Bhai, cross-docking matlab aane wali gaadi ka maal hub pe bina ya bahut kam rakhe seedha jaane wali gaadiyon me badal dena, isse distribution jaldi hota hai. Iske liye sahi label aur manifest chahiye taaki har packet sahi gaadi me jaaye. Aapke route pe hub hain ya nahi [SALES_CONTACT] se pooch lo, dekho [CROSS_DOCK_HUBS].

question: How does POD work when one truck carries several invoices?

answer_en: Each invoice copy should be stamped and signed by the consignee, and the e-POD uploaded per invoice or per drop so each can be verified. Remarks must be written against the specific invoice, so a shortage or damage on one invoice doesn't hold up the others. Keep the invoice-wise copies together with the LR.
answer_hi: हर इनवॉइस की कॉपी पर पाने वाले की मोहर और हस्ताक्षर होने चाहिए, और e-POD हर इनवॉइस या हर ड्रॉप के हिसाब से अपलोड करें ताकि हर एक की जांच हो सके। टिप्पणी उसी इनवॉइस के सामने लिखी जाए, ताकि एक इनवॉइस की कमी या नुकसान दूसरों को न रोके। इनवॉइस के हिसाब की कॉपियाँ LR के साथ रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, har bill ki copy pe party ki mohar aur sign hone chahiye, aur e-POD har bill ya har drop ke hisaab se upload karo taaki sabki alag jaanch ho. Remark usi bill ke saamne likhwao, taaki ek bill ki shortage ya damage baaki ko na roke. Bill-wali copy bilty ke saath rakho.
answer: Each invoice copy should be stamped and signed by the consignee, and the e-POD uploaded per invoice or per drop so each can be verified. Remarks must be written against the specific invoice, so a shortage or damage on one invoice doesn't hold up the others. Keep the invoice-wise copies together with the LR.

answer: Yes. Shippers can export reports on on-time pickup and delivery, TAT, detention, shortage and damage cases, POD turnaround and freight spend by lane or period from the dashboard. Contract shippers can ask [SALES_CONTACT] for scheduled MIS in the format their team uses.

question: How do I arrange return to vendor (RTV) movements?

answer_en: Book a reverse leg from your warehouse or the dealer to the vendor and mention RTV in the instructions. answer_hinglish: Bhai, apne godown ya dealer se vendor tak reverse leg book karo aur instructions me RTV likh do. question: What documents are needed to move stock between my own warehouses?

answer_en: Stock transfers between your own locations still need proper documents: a tax invoice or delivery challan for the movement, and an e-way bill where the value and rules require it. Transfers between different states or different GSTINs can have specific tax treatment, so check with your tax advisor. Share the invoice or challan and e-way bill with the driver before dispatch.
answer_hi: अपने ही स्थानों के बीच स्टॉक ट्रांसफर में भी सही कागज़ चाहिए: ढुलाई के लिए टैक्स इनवॉइस या डिलीवरी चालान, और जहाँ मूल्य और नियमों के हिसाब से ज़रूरी हो वहाँ ई-वे बिल। अलग राज्यों या अलग GSTIN के बीच ट्रांसफर पर खास टैक्स व्यवहार हो सकता है, इसलिए अपने टैक्स सलाहकार से पूछें। निकलने से पहले इनवॉइस या चालान और ई-वे बिल ड्राइवर को दें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, apne hi godown ke beech maal bhejo tab bhi sahi kagaz chahiye: bill ya delivery challan, aur jahan value aur niyam ke hisaab se lagta ho wahan e-way bill. question: What documents are needed for job work or processing movements?

question: How should shippers plan capacity for sale events or peak season?

question: What is OTP-based delivery confirmation?

question: How can I identify a fake load or fake shipper?

question: How can drivers reduce the risk of cargo theft?

question: How can I avoid making a loss (ghata) on a trip?

answer_en: Work out the full trip cost before you bid: diesel, tolls, driver pay and batta, repairs, tyre wear, EMI, insurance and taxes, plus waiting time risk. Prefer lanes with return loads, reach on time to avoid delays, keep the truck in good condition for mileage, use diesel cards at partner pumps and avoid overloading fines. answer_hi: बोली लगाने से पहले पूरी ट्रिप लागत निकालें: डीज़ल, टोल, ड्राइवर की तनख्वाह और बत्ता, मरम्मत, टायर घिसाई, EMI, बीमा और टैक्स, और इंतज़ार के जोखिम। वापसी लोड वाले रूट चुनें, देरी से बचने के लिए समय पर पहुँचें, माइलेज के लिए गाड़ी ठीक रखें, पार्टनर पंप पर डीज़ल कार्ड इस्तेमाल करें और ओवरलोडिंग जुर्माने से बचें। ऐप में पसंदीदा रूट सेट करें ताकि वापसी लोड आप तक आए।

App me pasand ke route set karo taaki wapsi load khud aaye.
answer: Work out the full trip cost before you bid: diesel, tolls, driver pay and batta, repairs, tyre wear, EMI, insurance and taxes, plus waiting time risk. question: How do I calculate my profit on a trip?
alternate_questions: Trip ka munafa kaise nikalein|Trip profit formula|Kamai ka hisaab|ट्रिप का मुनाफा कैसे निकालें|कमाई का हिसाब|नफा नुकसान
answer_en: Net profit equals freight plus any approved extras such as detention, minus all trip costs: diesel, tolls, driver pay and batta, repairs and tyre wear, a share of EMI, insurance, permit and tax, and any deductions like TDS or verified shortage. Use the settlement voucher for the freight side and your fuel and toll receipts for costs, then divide by the days the truck was engaged to see earnings per day.
answer_hi: शुद्ध मुनाफा = भाड़ा और मंज़ूर अतिरिक्त रकम जैसे डिटेंशन, में से सारे ट्रिप खर्च घटाने पर, यानी डीज़ल, टोल, ड्राइवर की तनख्वाह और बत्ता, मरम्मत और टायर घिसाई, EMI, बीमा, परमिट और टैक्स का हिस्सा, और TDS या सत्यापित कमी जैसी कटौतियाँ। भाड़े के लिए सेटलमेंट वाउचर और खर्च के लिए डीज़ल व टोल की रसीदें इस्तेमाल करें, फिर गाड़ी जितने दिन लगी उससे भाग देकर रोज़ की कमाई देखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, net munafa = bhada + manzoor extra (jaise detention) minus poora trip kharcha: diesel, toll, driver ki tankhwah aur batta, marammat aur tyre, EMI-insurance-permit-tax ka hissa, aur TDS ya shortage jaisi katoti. Bhade ke liye settlement voucher aur kharche ke liye diesel-toll ki raseed lo, phir gaadi jitne din lagi usse bhaag do to roz ki kamai pata chal jayegi.
answer: Net profit equals freight plus any approved extras such as detention, minus all trip costs: diesel, tolls, driver pay and batta, repairs and tyre wear, a share of EMI, insurance, permit and tax, and any deductions like TDS or verified shortage. Use the settlement voucher for the freight side and your fuel and toll receipts for costs, then divide by the days the truck was engaged to see earnings per day.

question: What is driver batta?
alternate_questions: Batta kya hota hai|Driver ka daily allowance|Batta kitna dena hai|ड्राइवर बत्ता क्या है|रोज़ का भत्ता|ड्राइवर का खर्चा
answer_en: Batta is the daily or trip allowance paid to a driver, and sometimes the helper, for food and incidental expenses on the road, over and above salary. It is set by the vehicle owner and isn't part of RoadExpress's payment to you, though the trip advance can be used to fund it. Paying batta on time helps avoid drivers asking shippers or consignees for money.
answer_hi: बत्ता ड्राइवर और कभी-कभी सहायक को सफर में खाने और छोटे खर्चों के लिए तनख्वाह के अलावा दिया जाने वाला रोज़ का या ट्रिप का भत्ता है। इसे गाड़ी मालिक तय करता है और यह आपको रोडएक्सप्रेस के भुगतान का हिस्सा नहीं है, हालांकि ट्रिप एडवांस से इसे चुकाया जा सकता है। समय पर बत्ता देने से ड्राइवर शिपर या पाने वाले से पैसे नहीं मांगते।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, batta wo roz ya trip ka bhatta hai jo driver aur kabhi helper ko raste me khane aur chhote kharche ke liye tankhwah ke upar milta hai. Ise gaadi maalik tay karta hai aur ye RoadExpress ke aapko diye paise ka hissa nahi, par trip advance se de sakte ho. Time pe batta doge to driver party ya consignee se paise nahi maangega.
answer: Batta is the daily or trip allowance paid to a driver, and sometimes the helper, for food and incidental expenses on the road, over and above salary. It is set by the vehicle owner and isn't part of RoadExpress's payment to you, though the trip advance can be used to fund it. Paying batta on time helps avoid drivers asking shippers or consignees for money.

question: What is the difference between a per-tonne rate and a fixed (lumpsum) freight?
alternate_questions: Per ton bhada aur fix bhada|Lumpsum freight kya hai|Ton ke hisaab se rate|प्रति टन भाड़ा और तय भाड़ा में फर्क|लंपसम भाड़ा|टन के हिसाब से किराया
answer_en: A fixed or lumpsum freight is one agreed amount for the whole trip regardless of the exact weight loaded, within the vehicle's legal capacity. A per-tonne rate is the rate multiplied by the actual weight, as shown on the weighbridge slip. FTL bookings are normally fixed per vehicle unless booked per tonne, so check your booking confirmation and keep the weighbridge slips.
answer_hi: तय या लंपसम भाड़ा पूरी ट्रिप के लिए एक तय रकम है, चाहे लादा गया वज़न कितना भी हो, गाड़ी की कानूनी क्षमता के अंदर। प्रति टन रेट में रेट को असली वज़न से गुणा किया जाता है, जो कांटा पर्ची पर दिखता है। FTL बुकिंग आम तौर पर गाड़ी के हिसाब से तय होती है जब तक प्रति टन बुक न हो, इसलिए अपनी बुकिंग कन्फर्मेशन देखें और कांटा पर्ची रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, fix ya lumpsum bhada poori trip ka ek tay paisa hai, maal kitna bhi chadha ho, gaadi ki kanooni capacity ke andar. Per ton rate me rate ko asli wazan se guna karte hain, jo kanta parchi pe dikhta hai. FTL booking aam taur pe gaadi ke hisaab se fix hoti hai jab tak per ton book na ho, booking confirmation dekho aur kanta parchi sambhal ke rakho.
answer: A fixed or lumpsum freight is one agreed amount for the whole trip regardless of the exact weight loaded, within the vehicle's legal capacity. A per-tonne rate is the rate multiplied by the actual weight, as shown on the weighbridge slip. FTL bookings are normally fixed per vehicle unless booked per tonne, so check your booking confirmation and keep the weighbridge slips.

question: What if the gate refuses entry because of a vehicle number or document mismatch?

answer_en: Cross-border road movement involves customs clearance, special permits and often special or transhipment arrangements, and availability depends on the country and lane, see [CROSS_BORDER_AVAILABILITY]. Contact [SALES_CONTACT] with your route, cargo, volumes and documents to check feasibility and get a quote.

answer_hinglish: Bhai, border paar ki sadak dhulai me customs, special permit aur aksar alag gaadi ya transhipment ka intezaam lagta hai, aur milna desh aur route pe depend karta hai, dekho [CROSS_BORDER_AVAILABILITY]. Ho sakta hai ya nahi aur rate jaanne ke liye apna route, maal, volume aur kagaz [SALES_CONTACT] ko bhejo.
answer: Cross-border road movement involves customs clearance, special permits and often special or transhipment arrangements, and availability depends on the country and lane, see [CROSS_BORDER_AVAILABILITY]. Contact [SALES_CONTACT] with your route, cargo, volumes and documents to check feasibility and get a quote.

question: The app asks me to update. Do I have to?
alternate_questions: App update karna padega|Force update message|Purana version nahi chal raha|ऐप अपडेट मांग रहा है|नया वर्ज़न ज़रूरी है क्या|पुराना ऐप क्यों बंद|
answer_en: Yes, if the app shows a required update. Newer versions carry security fixes, new features and compatibility with the platform, and older versions may stop working or show wrong information. Update from the Play Store over Wi-Fi if possible, and make sure your phone has enough storage. If the update fails, clear the Play Store cache and try again.
answer_hi: हाँ, अगर ऐप ज़रूरी अपडेट दिखाए। नए वर्ज़न में सुरक्षा सुधार, नई सुविधाएं और प्लेटफॉर्म से तालमेल होता है, और पुराने वर्ज़न बंद हो सकते हैं या गलत जानकारी दिखा सकते हैं। हो सके तो Wi-Fi पर Play Store से अपडेट करें और देखें कि फोन में पर्याप्त स्टोरेज हो। अपडेट न हो तो Play Store का कैश साफ करके दोबारा कोशिश करें।
answer_hinglish: Haan bhai, app ne zaroori update dikhaya ho to karna padega. Naye version me security sudhaar, nayi suvidha aur platform ke saath tal-mel hota hai, aur purana version band ho sakta hai ya galat jaankari dikha sakta hai. Ho sake to Wi-Fi pe Play Store se update karo aur phone me storage dekh lo. Update na ho to Play Store ka cache saaf karke dobara try karo.
answer: Yes, if the app shows a required update. Newer versions carry security fixes, new features and compatibility with the platform, and older versions may stop working or show wrong information. Update from the Play Store over Wi-Fi if possible, and make sure your phone has enough storage. If the update fails, clear the Play Store cache and try again.

question: How do I remove a vehicle I have sold or no longer use?
alternate_questions: Gaadi hatana hai|Sold truck remove|Fleet se vehicle delete|बेची हुई गाड़ी कैसे हटाएं|फ्लीट से गाड़ी हटाना|वाहन डिलीट
answer_en: Go to Fleet Management Hub, select the vehicle and choose Remove or Deactivate, making sure it has no active trip. For a sold vehicle, also tell [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the sale or transfer details so the vehicle record and tracking are closed correctly. Past trip records are kept for accounts and compliance.
answer_hi: Fleet Management Hub में जाएं, गाड़ी चुनें और Remove या Deactivate चुनें, और पक्का करें कि उस पर कोई चालू ट्रिप न हो। बेची गई गाड़ी के लिए बिक्री या ट्रांसफर के विवरण के साथ [SUPPORT_EMAIL] को भी बताएं ताकि गाड़ी का रिकॉर्ड और ट्रैकिंग सही से बंद हो। पुरानी ट्रिप का रिकॉर्ड हिसाब और नियमों के लिए रखा जाता है।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, Fleet Management Hub me jaao, gaadi chuno aur Remove ya Deactivate dabao, dhyan rakho us pe koi chalti trip na ho. Gaadi bech di ho to bikri ya transfer ki detail ke saath [SUPPORT_EMAIL] ko bhi batao taaki gaadi ka record aur tracking sahi band ho. Purani trip ka record hisaab aur niyam ke liye rakha jaata hai.
answer: Go to Fleet Management Hub, select the vehicle and choose Remove or Deactivate, making sure it has no active trip. For a sold vehicle, also tell [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the sale or transfer details so the vehicle record and tracking are closed correctly. Past trip records are kept for accounts and compliance.

question: The app can't open the camera. How do I fix it?
alternate_questions: Camera permission|Photo upload nahi ho raha|Camera access|कैमरा परमिशन|ऐप में कैमरा नहीं खुल रहा|फोटो लेने की अनुमति
answer_en: Open your phone Settings, go to Apps, then RoadExpress, then Permissions, and allow Camera and Photos or Files. Restart the app and try again. If the camera still doesn't open, free some phone storage, close other apps using the camera and update the app. Photos are needed for documents such as the loading slip and e-POD.
answer_hi: फोन की Settings में Apps फिर RoadExpress फिर Permissions में जाकर Camera और Photos या Files की अनुमति दें। ऐप दोबारा खोलकर कोशिश करें। फिर भी कैमरा न खुले तो फोन में कुछ स्टोरेज खाली करें, कैमरा इस्तेमाल करने वाले दूसरे ऐप बंद करें और ऐप अपडेट करें। लोडिंग स्लिप और e-POD जैसे दस्तावेज़ों के लिए फोटो चाहिए।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, phone ki Settings me Apps, phir RoadExpress, phir Permissions me jaake Camera aur Photos ya Files allow karo. App band karke dobara kholo. Phir bhi camera na khule to phone ka thoda storage khaali karo, camera chalane wale dusre app band karo aur app update karo. Loading slip aur e-POD jaise kagaz ke liye photo chahiye hoti hai.
answer: Open your phone Settings, go to Apps, then RoadExpress, then Permissions, and allow Camera and Photos or Files. Restart the app and try again. If the camera still doesn't open, free some phone storage, close other apps using the camera and update the app. Photos are needed for documents such as the loading slip and e-POD.

question: Does the app use a lot of mobile data?
alternate_questions: App kitna data khata hai|Data usage|Net khatam ho jata hai|ऐप कितना डेटा खाता है|मोबाइल डेटा की खपत|इंटरनेट जल्दी खत्म
answer_en: Location tracking uses only a small amount of data, while uploading photos and documents uses more. Use Wi-Fi for uploads when possible, take photos at a moderate resolution, and avoid restricting the app's background data, since tracking needs it during active trips. Keep enough data on the driver's phone for the whole trip.
answer_hi: लोकेशन ट्रैकिंग में डेटा बहुत कम लगता है, जबकि फोटो और दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करने में ज़्यादा लगता है। हो सके तो अपलोड के लिए Wi-Fi इस्तेमाल करें, मध्यम रेज़ोल्यूशन में फोटो लें और ऐप का बैकग्राउंड डेटा सीमित न करें, क्योंकि चालू ट्रिप में ट्रैकिंग को इसकी ज़रूरत होती है। ड्राइवर के फोन में पूरी ट्रिप के लिए पर्याप्त डेटा रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, location tracking me data bahut kam lagta hai, photo aur kagaz upload karne me zyada. Ho sake to upload Wi-Fi pe karo, photo medium resolution me kheencho aur app ka background data band mat karo, chalti trip me tracking ko wo chahiye. Driver ke phone me poori trip ka data rakho.
answer: Location tracking uses only a small amount of data, while uploading photos and documents uses more. Use Wi-Fi for uploads when possible, take photos at a moderate resolution, and avoid restricting the app's background data, since tracking needs it during active trips. Keep enough data on the driver's phone for the whole trip.

question: I uploaded the wrong document. What should I do?
alternate_questions: Galat kagaz upload ho gaya|Wrong file uploaded|Document replace kaise karein|गलत दस्तावेज़ अपलोड हो गया|फाइल कैसे बदलें|गलत फोटो डाल दी
answer_en: If the document isn't verified yet, open the trip or profile Documents section and delete or replace it with the correct file. If it has already been verified or submitted, contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] or [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID so it can be unlocked or corrected. Don't upload another person's documents or edited files, and keep the original paper safe.
answer_hi: अगर दस्तावेज़ अभी सत्यापित नहीं हुआ है, तो ट्रिप या प्रोफाइल के Documents सेक्शन में जाकर उसे हटाएं या सही फाइल से बदलें। अगर वह पहले ही सत्यापित या जमा हो चुका है, तो ट्रिप ID के साथ [SUPPORT_PHONE] या [SUPPORT_EMAIL] से संपर्क करें ताकि उसे खोला या सुधारा जा सके। किसी और के दस्तावेज़ या बदली हुई फाइल अपलोड न करें, और असली कागज़ सुरक्षित रखें।
answer_hinglish: Bhai, kagaz abhi verify nahi hua ho to trip ya profile ke Documents me jaake delete karo ya sahi file se badal do. Verify ya jama ho chuka ho to Trip ID ke saath [SUPPORT_PHONE] ya [SUPPORT_EMAIL] se baat karo taaki khulwa ke theek ho sake. Kisi aur ke kagaz ya badli hui file mat daalo, aur asli kagaz sambhal ke rakho.
answer: If the document isn't verified yet, open the trip or profile Documents section and delete or replace it with the correct file. If it has already been verified or submitted, contact [SUPPORT_PHONE] or [SUPPORT_EMAIL] with the Trip ID so it can be unlocked or corrected. Don't upload another person's documents or edited files, and keep the original paper safe.

answer: If your issue remains unresolved after the normal support and escalation steps, write to the grievance officer at [GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_EMAIL] with your ticket number, Trip ID, vehicle number and a short description of the problem and the earlier replies.
